      (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C) n).toIntLinearMap.baseChange ℚ,
    fun a ↦ pullbackAQ_apply C sX sY f hf a n⟩⟩

/-- Pullback of an integral total class is the integral restriction. -/
theorem pullbackAQ_ofTotalChowClass (c : TotalChowClass C sY) :
    pullbackAQ C sX sY f hf (RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass c) =
      RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass (TotalChowClass.res f hf c) :=
  RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ by
    rw [pullbackAQ_apply, RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass_apply,
      RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
      AddMonoidHom.coe_toIntLinearMap, TotalChowClass.res_apply_eq_chowCohomologyRestrictionOfEq]

/-- **The Chern character commutes with pullback**: `f^* ch(a) = ch(f^* a)`. -/
theorem pullbackAQ_ch (a : VectorBundleKZero Y) :
    pullbackAQ C sX sY f hf (ch C sY a) = ch C sX (VectorBundleKZero.pullback f a) :=
  RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ by
    rw [pullbackAQ_apply, ch_apply, ch_apply,
      rationalChowCohomologyRestriction_chernCharacterVectorBundle]

/-- **The Todd class commutes with pullback**: `f^* td(a) = td(f^* a)`. -/
theorem pullbackAQ_toddClass (a : VectorBundleKZero Y) :
    pullbackAQ C sX sY f hf (toddClass C sY a) =
      toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.pullback f a) := by
  rw [toddClass, toddClass, (isGradedHom_pullbackAQ C sX sY f hf).map_toddOf, pullbackAQ_ch]

/-- **The projection formula for the cap action**: for proper `f` and `δ` bounded below on `X`
and on `Y`, `f_* (f^* c ∩ γ) = c ∩ f_* γ` for `c ∈ ∏_p A^p(Y) ⊗ ℚ` and `γ ∈ CH_*(X) ⊗ ℚ`. -/
theorem rationalProperChowPushforward_totalRationalChowCap_pullbackAQ [IsProper f]
    (hX : BddBelow (Set.range (relativeDimension C.dimensionFunction sX)))
    (hY : BddBelow (Set.range (relativeDimension C.dimensionFunction sY)))
    (c : RationalTotalChowClass C sY)
    (γ : DirectSum ℤ fun j : ℤ ↦ ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sX j) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward C sX sY hf
        (totalRationalChowCap C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX
          (RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily.symm (pullbackAQ C sX sY f hf c)) γ) =
      totalRationalChowCap C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sY
        (RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily.symm c) (rationalProperChowPushforward C sX sY hf γ) := by
  obtain ⟨loX, hX'⟩ : ∃ lo : ℤ, ∀ x : X, lo ≤ relativeDimension C.dimensionFunction sX x :=
    hX.imp fun _ h x ↦ h ⟨x, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨loY, hY'⟩ : ∃ lo : ℤ, ∀ y : Y, lo ≤ relativeDimension C.dimensionFunction sY y :=
    hY.imp fun _ h y ↦ h ⟨y, rfl⟩
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun (f := rationalProperChowPushforward C sX sY hf ∘ₗ
      totalRationalChowCap C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sX
        (RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily.symm (pullbackAQ C sX sY f hf c)))
    (g := totalRationalChowCap C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sY
        (RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily.symm c) ∘ₗ rationalProperChowPushforward C sX sY hf)
    (DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun k ↦ LinearMap.ext fun t ↦ ?_) γ
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [totalRationalChowCap_lof_eq_sum C _ sX loX hX' _ k t
      (Finset.range ((k - loX).toNat + (k - loY).toNat + 1))
      (fun p hp ↦ by rw [Finset.mem_range]; omega), map_sum,
    rationalProperChowPushforward_lof, totalRationalChowCap_lof_eq_sum C _ sY loY hY' _ k _
      (Finset.range ((k - loX).toNat + (k - loY).toNat + 1))
      (fun p hp ↦ by rw [Finset.mem_range]; omega)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  rw [RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily_symm_apply, RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily_symm_apply,
    pullbackAQ_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, rationalProperChowPushforward_comp_rationalChowCap,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, rationalProperChowPushforward_lof]

end GRR

import Mathlib
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Perfect.GrothendieckGroup
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.ProperCoherenceWitness.ChowStalk
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImageQcqs.UniformVanishing
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImage.DimensionShifting
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.DerivedAffineSystemKZero
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.ClosedImmersionRelativeLeray.Basic
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.AdamsOperator.SupportedCoherentKGroup
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteDirectImageCoherent.Basic
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentAbelian.Basic

/-!
# The pushforward `f_!` on Grothendieck groups of coherent sheaves

For a proper morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` to a quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme, the higher direct
images `R^i f_* F` of a coherent module are coherent (Stacks 02O5) and vanish for `i` beyond a
bound independent of `F` (Stacks 01XJ). This file defines

  `f_! : K'₀(X) ⟶ K'₀(Y)`,  `f_! [F] = ∑_i (-1)^i [R^i f_* F]`,

as `GRR.pushforwardK f`, proves that it is well defined (additive on short exact sequences, by the
long exact sequence of higher direct images), that `i_! [F] = [i_* F]` for a closed immersion `i`,
and that `(i ≫ g)_! = g_! ∘ i_!` for a closed immersion `i` followed by a proper morphism `g`.
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory

universe u

namespace GRR

attribute [local instance 10000] HasDerivedCategory.standard

variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}}

/-- The higher direct image `R^i f_* F` of a module (Stacks 01XJ): the value of the `i`-th right
derived functor of `f_*`. -/
noncomputable def higherDirectImage (f : X ⟶ Y) (F : X.Modules) (i : ℕ) : Y.Modules :=
  ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus (i : ℤ)).obj F

/-! ### The Euler characteristic of a cohomological long exact sequence -/

section LongExactSequence

variable {𝒜 : Type*} [Category 𝒜] [Abelian 𝒜]

/-- For an exact sequence `X₁ → X₂ → X₃`, `[X₂] = [im f] + [im g]` in `K₀(𝒜)`. -/
theorem kZero_mk_eq_mk_image_add_mk_image (S : ShortComplex 𝒜) (hS : S.Exact) :
    KZero.mk 𝒜 S.X₂ = KZero.mk 𝒜 (Abelian.image S.f) + KZero.mk 𝒜 (Abelian.image S.g) := by
  rw [KZero.mk_eq_kernel_add_image S.g, ← KZero.mk_image_eq_mk_kernel _ hS]

/-- **The Euler characteristic of a cohomological long exact sequence vanishes.** For an exact
sequence `0 → A₀ → B₀ → C₀ → A₁ → B₁ → C₁ → A₂ → ⋯` in an abelian category with `A_N = 0`,
`∑_{j < N} (-1)ʲ ([Aⱼ] - [Bⱼ] + [Cⱼ]) = 0` in `K₀(𝒜)`. -/
theorem kZero_sum_range_neg_one_pow_zsmul_eq_zero {A B C : ℕ → 𝒜} (a : ∀ j, A j ⟶ B j)
    (b : ∀ j, B j ⟶ C j) (d : ∀ j, C j ⟶ A (j + 1)) (hab : ∀ j, a j ≫ b j = 0)
    (hbd : ∀ j, b j ≫ d j = 0) (hda : ∀ j, d j ≫ a (j + 1) = 0)
    (h₂ : ∀ j, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ (hab j)).Exact)
    (h₃ : ∀ j, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ (hbd j)).Exact)
    (h₁ : ∀ j, (ShortComplex.mk _ _ (hda j)).Exact) [Mono (a 0)] (N : ℕ)
    (hN : Limits.IsZero (A N)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (-1 : ℤ) ^ j •
      (KZero.mk 𝒜 (A j) - KZero.mk 𝒜 (B j) + KZero.mk 𝒜 (C j)) = 0 := by
  obtain _ | M := N
  · simp
  have hA : KZero.mk 𝒜 (A 0) = KZero.mk 𝒜 (Abelian.image (a 0)) := by
    rw [KZero.mk_eq_kernel_add_image (a 0),
      KZero.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (Limits.isZero_kernel_of_mono _), zero_add]
  rw [KZero.sum_range_neg_one_pow_zsmul_telescope _ (fun j => KZero.mk 𝒜 (Abelian.image (d j)))
    (by
      rw [hA, kZero_mk_eq_mk_image_add_mk_image _ (h₂ 0),
        kZero_mk_eq_mk_image_add_mk_image _ (h₃ 0)]
      abel)
    (fun j => by
      rw [kZero_mk_eq_mk_image_add_mk_image _ (h₁ j),
        kZero_mk_eq_mk_image_add_mk_image _ (h₂ (j + 1)),
        kZero_mk_eq_mk_image_add_mk_image _ (h₃ (j + 1))]
      abel) M,
    KZero.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero (hN.of_mono (Abelian.image.ι (d M))), smul_zero]

end LongExactSequence

/-! ### Higher direct images as a δ-functor -/

/-- The higher direct images `R^n f_*`, in the indexing of `higherDirectImage`, as a cohomological
δ-functor: the δ-functor of Mathlib's right derived functors of `f_*`, transported along the
comparison of the two indexings. -/
noncomputable def higherDirectImageDelta (f : X ⟶ Y) : DeltaFunctor X.Modules Y.Modules :=
  Stacks.DerivedIndexing.deltaFunctorOfNatIso
    (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImage.pushforwardDeltaFunctor f)
    (fun n => (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).rightDerivedPlus (n : ℤ))
    (fun n => Stacks.DerivedIndexing.rightDerivedIso (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f) n)

theorem higherDirectImageDelta_functor_obj (f : X ⟶ Y) (F : X.Modules) (n : ℕ) :
    ((higherDirectImageDelta f).functor n).obj F = higherDirectImage f F n :=
  rfl

/-! ### Coherent higher direct images -/

/-- The inclusion of coherent modules into all modules. -/
abbrev coherentInclusion (X : Scheme.{u}) :=
  (Stacks.SheafOfModules.coherentModules X.ringCatSheaf).ι

/-- A coherent module is quasi-coherent. -/
theorem isQuasicoherent_obj {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf) : F.obj.IsQuasicoherent :=
  haveI : F.obj.IsCoherent := CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent F.property
  _root_.isQuasicoherent_of_isCoherent F.obj

attribute [local instance] isQuasicoherent_obj

/-- The higher direct image `R^i f_* F` of a coherent module along a proper morphism to a locally
Noetherian scheme, as a coherent module (Stacks 02O5). -/
noncomputable def higherDirectImageCoh (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf) (i : ℕ) :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules Y.ringCatSheaf :=
  ⟨higherDirectImage f F.obj i, CoherentAbelian.stacksIsCoherent_of_isCoherent
    (ProperCoherenceWitness.higherDirectImageIsCoherent X Y f inferInstance inferInstance F.obj
      (CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent F.property) i)⟩

theorem higherDirectImageCoh_obj (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf) (i : ℕ) :
    (higherDirectImageCoh f F i).obj = higherDirectImage f F.obj i := by
  rfl

/-- `R^i f_* F` vanishes as a coherent module exactly when it vanishes as a module. -/
theorem isZero_higherDirectImageCoh_iff (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf) (i : ℕ) :
    Limits.IsZero (higherDirectImageCoh f F i) ↔ Limits.IsZero (higherDirectImage f F.obj i) :=
  ⟨fun h => (coherentInclusion Y).map_isZero h,
    fun h => Limits.IsZero.of_full_of_faithful_of_isZero (coherentInclusion Y) _ h⟩

/-- If `R^i f_* F ≅ G` for a coherent `G`, then `[R^i f_* F] = [G]` in `K'₀(Y)`. -/
theorem mk_higherDirectImageCoh_eq_of_iso (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf) (i : ℕ)
    (G : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules Y.ringCatSheaf)
    (e : higherDirectImage f F.obj i ≅ G.obj) :
    KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f F i) = KZero.mk _ G :=
  KZero.mk_eq_of_iso (ObjectProperty.isoMk (Stacks.SheafOfModules.coherentModules Y.ringCatSheaf) e)

/-- A bound beyond which all higher direct images of quasi-coherent modules along `f` vanish. -/
noncomputable def cohomologicalBound (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [CompactSpace Y] : ℕ :=
  (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImageQcoh.exists_isZero_rightDerivedNat_pushforward
    f).choose

theorem isZero_higherDirectImage_of_cohomologicalBound_le (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [CompactSpace Y]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (i : ℕ) (hi : cohomologicalBound f ≤ i) :
    Limits.IsZero (higherDirectImage f F i) := by
  exact (Stacks.DerivedIndexing.isZero_rightDerived_obj_iff (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f) i F).1
    ((Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImageQcoh.exists_isZero_rightDerivedNat_pushforward
      f).choose_spec F inferInstance i hi)

/-! ### Additivity along short exact sequences -/

/-- **The long exact sequence of higher direct images in `K'₀(Y)`.** For a short exact sequence
`0 → F₁ → F₂ → F₃ → 0` of coherent modules and `N` with `R^N f_* F₁ = 0`,
`∑_{j < N} (-1)ʲ ([R^j f_* F₁] - [R^j f_* F₂] + [R^j f_* F₃]) = 0`. -/
theorem sum_range_higherDirectImageCoh_eq_zero (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    {S : ShortComplex (Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf)} (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : Limits.IsZero (higherDirectImage f S.X₁.obj N)) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (-1 : ℤ) ^ j •
      (KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₁ j) - KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₂ j) +
        KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₃ j)) = 0 := by
  have : Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits (coherentInclusion X) :=
    ObjectProperty.preservesFiniteLimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass _
  have : Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits (coherentInclusion X) :=
    ObjectProperty.preservesFiniteColimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass _
  have hS' : (S.map (coherentInclusion X)).ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  let D := higherDirectImageDelta f
  let a : ∀ j, higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₁ j ⟶ higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₂ j :=
    fun j => ObjectProperty.homMk ((D.functor j).map (S.map (coherentInclusion X)).f)
  let b : ∀ j, higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₂ j ⟶ higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₃ j :=
    fun j => ObjectProperty.homMk ((D.functor j).map (S.map (coherentInclusion X)).g)
  let d : ∀ j, higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₃ j ⟶ higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₁ (j + 1) :=
    fun j => ObjectProperty.homMk (D.δ hS' j)
  have hab : ∀ j, a j ≫ b j = 0 := fun j => (coherentInclusion Y).map_injective (by
    rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_zero]
    exact D.map_f_comp_map_g j)
  have hbd : ∀ j, b j ≫ d j = 0 := fun j => (coherentInclusion Y).map_injective (by
    rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_zero]
    exact D.map_g_δ hS' j)
  have hda : ∀ j, d j ≫ a (j + 1) = 0 := fun j => (coherentInclusion Y).map_injective (by
    rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_zero]
    exact D.δ_map_f hS' j)
  have : Mono (a 0) := (coherentInclusion Y).mono_of_mono_map (D.mono_map_f hS')
  exact kZero_sum_range_neg_one_pow_zsmul_eq_zero a b d hab hbd hda
    (fun j => (coherentInclusion Y).reflects_exact_of_faithful _ (D.exact_map hS' j))
    (fun j => (coherentInclusion Y).reflects_exact_of_faithful _ (D.exact_δ₁ hS' j))
    (fun j => (coherentInclusion Y).reflects_exact_of_faithful _ (D.exact_δ₂ hS' j)) N
    ((isZero_higherDirectImageCoh_iff f S.X₁ N).2 hN)

/-- The alternating sum `∑_{i < N} (-1)^i [R^i f_* F]` is additive along short exact sequences of
coherent modules. -/
theorem sum_range_higherDirectImageCoh_add (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    [CompactSpace Y]
    {S : ShortComplex (Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (cohomologicalBound f),
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₂ i) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (cohomologicalBound f),
          ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₁ i) +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (cohomologicalBound f),
          ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f S.X₃ i) := by
  have key := sum_range_higherDirectImageCoh_eq_zero f hS (cohomologicalBound f)
    (isZero_higherDirectImage_of_cohomologicalBound_le f S.X₁.obj _ le_rfl)
  simp only [smul_add, smul_sub, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at key
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← neg_eq_zero, ← key]
  abel

/-! ### The pushforward -/

/-- **The pushforward `f_! : K'₀(X) ⟶ K'₀(Y)`** of a proper morphism to a quasi-compact locally
Noetherian scheme: `f_! [F] = ∑_i (-1)^i [R^i f_* F]`. -/
noncomputable def pushforwardK (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [CompactSpace Y] :
    CoherentKZero X →+ CoherentKZero Y :=
  KZero.lift (fun F => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (cohomologicalBound f),
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f F i))
    fun _ hS => sum_range_higherDirectImageCoh_add f hS

/-- `f_! [F] = ∑_{i < N} (-1)^i [R^i f_* F]`, for the uniform bound `N`. -/
theorem pushforwardK_mk (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf) :
    pushforwardK f (KZero.mk _ F) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (cohomologicalBound f),
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f F i) := by
  exact KZero.lift_mk _ _ F

/-- Terms of the alternating sum beyond a vanishing bound contribute nothing. -/
theorem sum_range_higherDirectImageCoh_eq_of_le (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf) {N M : ℕ} (hNM : N ≤ M)
    (hN : ∀ i, N ≤ i → Limits.IsZero (higherDirectImage f F.obj i)) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range M, ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f F i) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f F i) := by
  refine (Finset.sum_subset (Finset.range_subset_range.2 hNM) fun i _ hi => ?_).symm
  rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hi
  rw [KZero.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero ((isZero_higherDirectImageCoh_iff f F i).2 (hN i hi)),
    smul_zero]

/-- `f_! [F] = ∑_{i < N} (-1)^i [R^i f_* F]` for any `N` beyond which the `R^i f_* F` vanish. -/
theorem pushforwardK_mk_of_isZero (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf) (N : ℕ)
    (hN : ∀ i, N ≤ i → Limits.IsZero (higherDirectImage f F.obj i)) :
    pushforwardK f (KZero.mk _ F) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • KZero.mk _ (higherDirectImageCoh f F i) := by
  rw [pushforwardK_mk]
  exact (sum_range_higherDirectImageCoh_eq_of_le f F (le_max_right N (cohomologicalBound f))
    fun i hi => isZero_higherDirectImage_of_cohomologicalBound_le f F.obj i hi).symm.trans
    (sum_range_higherDirectImageCoh_eq_of_le f F (le_max_left N (cohomologicalBound f)) hN)

/-- `f_! [F] = ∑_{i < N} (-1)^i [G_i]` when `R^i f_* F ≅ G_i` for `i < N` and `R^i f_* F = 0`
for `i ≥ N`. -/
theorem pushforwardK_mk_eq_sum_of_iso (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    [CompactSpace Y] (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf) (N : ℕ)
    (hN : ∀ i, N ≤ i → Limits.IsZero (higherDirectImage f F.obj i))
    (G : ℕ → Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules Y.ringCatSheaf)
    (e : ∀ i, i < N → Nonempty (higherDirectImage f F.obj i ≅ (G i).obj)) :
    pushforwardK f (KZero.mk _ F) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) • KZero.mk _ (G i) := by
  rw [pushforwardK_mk_of_isZero f F N hN]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  rw [mk_higherDirectImageCoh_eq_of_iso f F i (G i) (e i (Finset.mem_range.1 hi)).some]

/-! ### Closed immersions -/

/-- For a closed immersion `i`, `i_! [F] = [i_* F]`. -/
theorem pushforwardK_mk_of_isClosedImmersion {Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules Z.ringCatSheaf) :
    pushforwardK i (KZero.mk _ F) = KZero.mk _ ((pushforwardCoherentModules i).obj F) := by
  rw [pushforwardK_mk_of_isZero i F 1 fun n hn =>
    Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteDirectImageCoherent.isZero_higherDirectImage_of_isFinite i
      F.obj (n : ℤ) (by omega)]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_one, pow_zero, one_smul]
  exact mk_higherDirectImageCoh_eq_of_iso i F 0 _
    (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.HigherDirectImage.higherDirectImageZeroIso i F.obj)

/-- `R^n (i ≫ g)_* F ≅ R^n g_* (i_* F)` for a closed immersion `i`. -/
noncomputable def higherDirectImageCompIso {Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (g : X ⟶ Y) (F : Z.Modules) (n : ℕ) :
    higherDirectImage (i ≫ g) F n ≅
      higherDirectImage g ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F) n :=
  ((Stacks.DerivedIndexing.rightDerivedIso (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (i ≫ g)) n).app F).symm ≪≫
    (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ClosedImmersionRelativeLeray.rightDerivedPushforwardCompIso
      i g n).app F ≪≫
    (Stacks.DerivedIndexing.rightDerivedIso (Scheme.Modules.pushforward g) n).app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F)

/-- **`(i ≫ g)_! = g_! ∘ i_!`** for a closed immersion `i` followed by a proper morphism `g`. -/
theorem pushforwardK_comp_of_isClosedImmersion {Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper g] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    [CompactSpace Y] :
    pushforwardK (i ≫ g) = (pushforwardK g).comp (pushforwardK i) := by
  refine KZero.hom_ext fun F => ?_
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, pushforwardK_mk_of_isClosedImmersion i F,
    pushforwardK_mk g ((pushforwardCoherentModules i).obj F),
    pushforwardK_mk_of_isZero (i ≫ g) F (cohomologicalBound g) fun n hn =>
      (isZero_higherDirectImage_of_cohomologicalBound_le g
        ((pushforwardCoherentModules i).obj F).obj n hn).of_iso
        (higherDirectImageCompIso i g F.obj n)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
  rw [mk_higherDirectImageCoh_eq_of_iso (i ≫ g) F n
    (higherDirectImageCoh g ((pushforwardCoherentModules i).obj F) n)
    (higherDirectImageCompIso i g F.obj n)]

end GRR

/-!
# The statement of Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch

Let `k` be a field. For a smooth separated scheme `X` of finite type over `k` (`GRR.IsSmoothFT`;
every smooth quasi-projective variety is one) this file assembles, from Stacks,

* `GRR.CHQ k sX = CH_*(X) ⊗ ℚ`, the rational Chow group, on which `∏_p A^p(X) ⊗ ℚ` acts by cap
  product (`GRR.cap`), with the fundamental class `GRR.fundamentalClass k sX = [X]`;
* `GRR.chK k sX : K'₀(X) → ∏_p A^p(X) ⊗ ℚ`, the Chern character of a coherent class, through the
  identification `K₀(Vect X) ≅ K'₀(X)` of a regular scheme;
* `GRR.tangentClass k sX = [T_X] ∈ K₀(Vect X)`, the class of the dual of `Ω_{X/k}`;
* `GRR.tau k sX : K'₀(X) → CH_*(X) ⊗ ℚ`, `τ_X(α) = (ch(α) · td(T_X)) ∩ [X]`.

`GRR.RiemannRochFor k sX sY f hf` says `f_* (τ_X α) = τ_Y (f_! α)` for all `α ∈ K'₀(X)`: this is
the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch formula `ch(f_! α) · td(T_Y) = f_*(ch(α) · td(T_X))` read in
`CH_*(Y) ⊗ ℚ = A^*(Y) ⊗ ℚ` by capping with `[Y]`.

The reduction: `RiemannRochFor` is stable under composing a closed immersion with a proper
morphism (`riemannRochFor_comp`), so it holds for every projective morphism as soon as it holds
for closed immersions and for the projections `ℙⁿ_Y → Y` (`riemannRochFor_of_isProjectiveMorphism`).
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Stacks.Chow
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u

namespace GRR

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]

/-- `X` is a smooth scheme, separated and of finite type over the field `k`. Every smooth
quasi-projective variety over `k` is one; integrality and quasi-projectivity are not needed. -/
class IsSmoothFT {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) : Prop where
  smooth : Smooth sX
  isSeparated : IsSeparated sX
  quasiCompact : QuasiCompact sX

attribute [instance] IsSmoothFT.smooth IsSmoothFT.isSeparated IsSmoothFT.quasiCompact

/-- A smooth variety over `k` (integral, separated, of finite type, smooth) is smooth, separated
and of finite type. -/
instance isSmoothFT_of_isSmoothVariety {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsSmoothVariety k sX] : IsSmoothFT k sX where
  smooth := inferInstance
  isSeparated := inferInstance
  quasiCompact := inferInstance

section Objects

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))

/-- The rational Chow group `CH_*(X) ⊗ ℚ = ⨁_j CH_j(X) ⊗ ℚ` of a scheme locally of finite type
over `k`, graded by dimension. -/
abbrev CHQ [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] : Type u :=
  DirectSum ℤ fun j : ℤ ↦ ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) sX j

/-- The rational Chow cohomology ring `A^*(X) ⊗ ℚ = ∏_p A^p(X) ⊗ ℚ` of Stacks. -/
abbrev AQ [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] : Type (u + 1) :=
  RationalTotalChowClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX

/-- The cap product: the action of `c ∈ ∏_p A^p(X) ⊗ ℚ` on `CH_*(X) ⊗ ℚ`, `α ↦ ∑_p c_p ∩ α`. -/
noncomputable def cap [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (c : AQ k sX) : Module.End ℚ (CHQ k sX) :=
  totalRationalChowCap (fieldChowSituation k) (gysinSystemOfInvertible (fieldChowSituation k)) sX
    (RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily.symm c)

variable [IsSmoothFT k sX]

include k sX in
theorem isNoetherian : IsNoetherian X := isNoetherian_of_quasiCompact_fieldChowSituation (sX := sX)

include k sX in
theorem compactSpace : CompactSpace X := (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace sX).mp inferInstance

include k sX in
theorem isAffineHom_diagonal :
    IsAffineHom (Limits.pullback.diagonal (Limits.terminal.from X)) :=
  isAffineHom_diagonal_of_isSeparated_fieldChowSituation (sX := sX)

include k sX in
theorem isRegular : IsRegular X := isRegular_of_smooth_over_field sX

/-- The fundamental class `[X] ∈ CH_*(X) ⊗ ℚ`. -/
noncomputable def fundamentalClass : CHQ k sX :=
  haveI := isNoetherian k sX
  rationalFundamentalClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX

/-- The identification `K₀(Vect X) ≅ K'₀(X)` of a smooth scheme over a field (Stacks 0FDJ, 0FDI):
it sends the class of a finite locally free module to its class as a coherent sheaf. -/
noncomputable def vectorBundleEquiv : VectorBundleKZero X ≃+ CoherentKZero X :=
  haveI := compactSpace k sX
  haveI := isAffineHom_diagonal k sX
  regularVectorBundleKZeroAddEquiv X (isRegular k sX)

/-- The identification `K₀(Vect X) ≅ K'₀(X)` sends the class of a finite locally free module to
its class as a coherent sheaf. -/
theorem vectorBundleEquiv_classOf (E : X.Modules)
    (hE : Stacks.FiniteLocallyFree.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R := X.ringCatSheaf) E) :
    ∃ hcoh : Stacks.SheafOfModules.IsCoherent E,
      vectorBundleEquiv k sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) = KZero.mk _ ⟨E, hcoh⟩ :=
  haveI := compactSpace k sX
  haveI := isAffineHom_diagonal k sX
  ⟨_, regularVectorBundleKZeroAddEquiv_classOf' X (isRegular k sX) E hE⟩

/-- **The Chern character of a coherent class**, `ch : K'₀(X) → ∏_p A^p(X) ⊗ ℚ`: the Chern
character of Stacks 0FEM through the identification `K₀(Vect X) ≅ K'₀(X)`. -/
noncomputable def chK : CoherentKZero X →+ AQ k sX :=
  (ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX : VectorBundleKZero X →+ AQ k sX).comp
    (vectorBundleEquiv k sX).symm.toAddMonoidHom

/-- The tangent sheaf `T_X`, the dual of the sheaf of differentials `Ω_{X/k}`. -/
noncomputable def tangentSheaf : X.Modules :=
  Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials sX)

/-- The class `[T_X] ∈ K₀(Vect X)` of the tangent sheaf. -/
noncomputable def tangentClass : VectorBundleKZero X :=
  VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (tangentSheaf k sX)

/-- The Todd class `td(T_X) ∈ ∏_p A^p(X) ⊗ ℚ` of the tangent sheaf. -/
noncomputable def toddTangent : AQ k sX :=
  toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (tangentClass k sX)

/-- **The Riemann–Roch map** `τ_X : K'₀(X) → CH_*(X) ⊗ ℚ`, `τ_X(α) = (ch(α) · td(T_X)) ∩ [X]`. -/
noncomputable def tau : CoherentKZero X →+ CHQ k sX where
  toFun α := cap k sX (chK k sX α * toddTangent k sX) (fundamentalClass k sX)
  map_zero' := by
    rw [map_zero, zero_mul]
    unfold cap
    rw [map_zero, map_zero]
    rfl
  map_add' a b := by
    rw [map_add, add_mul]
    unfold cap
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    rfl

theorem tau_apply (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    tau k sX α = cap k sX (chK k sX α * toddTangent k sX) (fundamentalClass k sX) := rfl

end Objects

section Statement

variable {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
  [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sY]

/-- **The Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch formula for `f : X ⟶ Y`** (a proper morphism of smooth
separated schemes of finite type over `k`): for every `α ∈ K'₀(X)`,

  `f_* ((ch(α) · td(T_X)) ∩ [X]) = (ch(f_! α) · td(T_Y)) ∩ [Y]`  in `CH_*(Y) ⊗ ℚ`,

where `f_*` is proper pushforward of cycles and `f_! [F] = ∑_i (-1)^i [R^i f_* F]`. -/
def RiemannRochFor (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (hf : f ≫ sY = sX) : Prop :=
  haveI := compactSpace k sY
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := (isNoetherian k sY).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  ∀ α : CoherentKZero X,
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sY hf (tau k sX α) =
      tau k sY (pushforwardK f α)

end Statement

section Reduction

variable {X P Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k))
  (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP] [IsSmoothFT k sY]

/-- Proper pushforward on rational Chow groups is functorial. -/
theorem rationalProperChowPushforward_comp (i : X ⟶ P) [IsProper i] (p : P ⟶ Y) [IsProper p]
    (hi : i ≫ sP = sX) (hp : p ≫ sY = sP) (hip : (i ≫ p) ≫ sY = sX) (γ : CHQ k sX) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sY hip γ =
      rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sP sY hp
        (rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi γ) := by
  have h : rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sY hip =
      (rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sP sY hp).comp
        (rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi) := by
    refine rationalChowHomology_linearMap_ext (fieldChowSituation k) sX fun j q α ↦ ?_
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul,
      rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul, rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul]
    congr 2
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (properChowPushforward_comp (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP sY i p hi
      hp j (properPushforwardDescends _ _ _ _ _ _) (properPushforwardDescends _ _ _ _ _ _)) α).symm
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h γ

/-- **Riemann–Roch composes**: if the formula holds for a closed immersion `i : X ⟶ P` and for a
proper morphism `p : P ⟶ Y`, it holds for `i ≫ p`. -/
theorem riemannRochFor_comp (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (p : P ⟶ Y) [IsProper p]
    (hi : i ≫ sP = sX) (hp : p ≫ sY = sP) (hip : (i ≫ p) ≫ sY = sX)
    (hI : RiemannRochFor k sX sP i hi) (hP : RiemannRochFor k sP sY p hp) :
    RiemannRochFor k sX sY (i ≫ p) hip := by
  have := compactSpace k sP
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  have := compactSpace k sY
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := (isNoetherian k sY).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  intro α
  have h1 := hI α
  have h2 := hP (pushforwardK i α)
  rw [rationalProperChowPushforward_comp k sX sP sY i p hi hp hip, h1, h2,
    pushforwardK_comp_of_isClosedImmersion i p]
  rfl

end Reduction

section Projective

variable {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sY]

/-- Projective space over a smooth separated scheme of finite type over `k` is again one. -/
instance isSmoothFT_projectiveSpaceOver (n : ℕ) :
    IsSmoothFT k ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) :=
  haveI : IsProper (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) := isProper_projectiveSpaceOver n Y
  { smooth := inferInstance
    isSeparated := inferInstance
    quasiCompact := inferInstance }

/-- The projection `ℙⁿ_Y ⟶ Y` is proper. -/
instance isProper_projectiveSpaceOver_hom (n : ℕ) : IsProper (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) :=
  isProper_projectiveSpaceOver n Y

/-- **Reduction of Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch to closed immersions and projections.** Suppose the
Riemann–Roch formula holds for every closed immersion of smooth separated schemes of finite type
over `k` into `ℙⁿ_Y`, and for every projection `ℙⁿ_Y ⟶ Y`. Then it holds for every projective
morphism `f : X ⟶ Y`, i.e. every `f` factoring as a closed immersion `X ⟶ ℙⁿ_Y` followed by the
projection. -/
theorem riemannRochFor_of_isProjectiveMorphism
    (hE : ∀ {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] (n : ℕ)
      (i : X ⟶ projectiveSpaceOver n Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
      (hi : i ≫ (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY = sX),
      RiemannRochFor k sX ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) i hi)
    (hP : ∀ n : ℕ, RiemannRochFor k ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) sY
      (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) rfl)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (hf : f ≫ sY = sX) (hproj : IsProjectiveMorphism f) :
    RiemannRochFor k sX sY f hf := by
  obtain ⟨n, i, hi, hfac⟩ := hproj
  subst hfac
  have := hi
  exact riemannRochFor_comp k sX ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) sY i
    (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans hf) rfl hf
    (hE sX n i ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans hf)) (hP n)

end Projective

end GRR

import Mathlib
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Constructions.ProjTwistTensorPow
import GRR.Statement

/-!
# Riemann–Roch for the projection `ℙⁿ_Y → Y`: reduction to three statements

Let `Y` be a smooth separated scheme of finite type over a field `k`, `π : ℙⁿ_Y → Y` the
projection and `𝒪(d)` the twisting sheaves. On the classes

  `g_j(β) = [𝒪(-j)] · π^* β ∈ K₀(Vect ℙⁿ_Y) ≅ K'₀(ℙⁿ_Y)`,  `0 ≤ j ≤ n`, `β ∈ K₀(Vect Y)`

(`GRR.twistedPullback`), both sides of the Riemann–Roch formula can be computed:

* `GRR.ProjectionPushforwardFormula`: `π_! g_j(β) = β` if `j = 0` and `0` otherwise
  (cohomology of the twists and the projection formula);
* `GRR.ProjectionTauFormula`: `π_* τ(g_j(β)) = τ_Y(β)` if `j = 0` and `0` otherwise
  (the Todd class of `ℙⁿ_Y`, the projective bundle formula and the coefficients of
  `e^{-jx} (x / (1 - e^{-x}))^{n+1}`);
* `GRR.ProjectionGeneration`: the `g_j(β)` generate `K'₀(ℙⁿ_Y)` rationally: a positive multiple
  of every class is a sum of them.

`GRR.riemannRochFor_projection_of` deduces the Riemann–Roch formula for `π` from the three.
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Stacks.Chow
open Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ProjTwistTensorPow (twistOver)
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u

namespace GRR

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sY]
  (n : ℕ)

/-- The class `[𝒪(d)] ∈ K₀(Vect ℙⁿ_Y)` of the twisting sheaf `𝒪(d)` on `ℙⁿ_Y`. -/
noncomputable def twistClass (Y : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) (d : ℤ) :
    VectorBundleKZero (projectiveSpaceOver n Y) :=
  VectorBundleKZero.classOf (projectiveSpaceOver n Y) (twistOver n Y d)

/-- The class `g_j(β) = [𝒪(-j)] · π^* β` of `K₀(Vect ℙⁿ_Y)`, read in `K'₀(ℙⁿ_Y)`. -/
noncomputable def twistedPullback (j : ℕ) (β : VectorBundleKZero Y) :
    CoherentKZero (projectiveSpaceOver n Y) :=
  vectorBundleEquiv k ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY)
    (twistClass Y n (-(j : ℤ)) * VectorBundleKZero.pullback (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) β)

/-- **The pushforward of the twisted classes**: `π_! ([𝒪(-j)] · π^* β) = β` for `j = 0` and `0`
for `1 ≤ j ≤ n`. -/
def ProjectionPushforwardFormula : Prop :=
  haveI := compactSpace k sY
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := (isNoetherian k sY).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ n → ∀ β : VectorBundleKZero Y,
    pushforwardK (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) (twistedPullback k sY n j β) =
      if j = 0 then vectorBundleEquiv k sY β else 0

/-- **The Riemann–Roch map on the twisted classes**: `π_* τ([𝒪(-j)] · π^* β) = τ_Y(β)` for
`j = 0` and `0` for `1 ≤ j ≤ n`. -/
def ProjectionTauFormula : Prop :=
  ∀ j : ℕ, j ≤ n → ∀ β : VectorBundleKZero Y,
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) sY rfl
        (tau k ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) (twistedPullback k sY n j β)) =
      if j = 0 then tau k sY (vectorBundleEquiv k sY β) else 0

/-- **The twisted classes generate `K'₀(ℙⁿ_Y)` rationally**: a positive multiple of every class
of `K'₀(ℙⁿ_Y)` is a sum of classes `[𝒪(-j)] · π^* β_j`, `0 ≤ j ≤ n`. -/
def ProjectionGeneration : Prop :=
  ∀ α : CoherentKZero (projectiveSpaceOver n Y),
    ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ ∃ β : ℕ → VectorBundleKZero Y,
      N • α = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), twistedPullback k sY n j (β j)

/-- **Riemann–Roch for the projection `ℙⁿ_Y → Y`, from its three inputs.** -/
theorem riemannRochFor_projection_of (h1 : ProjectionPushforwardFormula k sY n)
    (h2 : ProjectionGeneration k sY n) (h3 : ProjectionTauFormula k sY n) :
    RiemannRochFor k ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) sY (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) rfl := by
  have := compactSpace k sY
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := (isNoetherian k sY).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  intro α
  obtain ⟨N, hN, β, hβ⟩ := h2 α
  have hgen : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
          ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) sY rfl
          (tau k ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) (twistedPullback k sY n j (β j))) =
        tau k sY (pushforwardK (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) (twistedPullback k sY n j (β j))) := by
    intro j hj
    have hj' : j ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    rw [h3 j hj' (β j), h1 j hj' (β j)]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · rw [map_zero]
  have key : N • rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) sY rfl
        (tau k ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) α) =
      N • tau k sY (pushforwardK (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) α) := by
    rw [← map_nsmul, ← map_nsmul, ← map_nsmul, ← map_nsmul, hβ, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum,
      map_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl hgen
  have hN' : (N : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN.ne'
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℚ, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℚ] at key
  exact smul_right_injective _ hN' key

end GRR

import Mathlib
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.ConormalSequenceRight.SchemeShortExact
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ChernClassDerived.DualComplexChern
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Perfect.GenericFreeCohomology
import GRR.Statement
import GRR.Pullback

/-!
# Riemann–Roch for closed immersions: reduction to the formula without tangent bundles

Let `i : X ⟶ P` be a closed immersion of smooth separated schemes of finite type over a field
`k`, with conormal sheaf `C_{X/P}` and normal sheaf `N = C_{X/P}^∨`. The conormal sequence
`0 → C_{X/P} → i^* Ω_P → Ω_X → 0` gives `td(T_X) = i^* td(T_P) · td(N)⁻¹`
(`GRR.toddTangent_eq`). With the projection formula, the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch formula for
`i` then follows from the formula without tangent bundles (`GRR.ClosedImmersionFormula`)

  `ch(i_! α) ∩ [P] = i_* ((ch(α) · td(N)⁻¹) ∩ [X])`,

which is `GRR.riemannRochFor_of_closedImmersionFormula`.

The input on duals is the sign rule `ch_p(E^∨) = (-1)^p ch_p(E)` for the Chern character of a
finite locally free module (`GRR.ch_classOf_dualSheaf`), from Stacks 0FA5 on rank loci.
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Stacks.Chow
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u

namespace GRR

section DualSign

open Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules (dualSheaf)

variable (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY]

/-- The power sums of the dual of a module of constant rank are the `(-1)^p`-scalings of those of
the module: `signScale` is a ring map carrying `c(E)` to `c(E^∨)` (Stacks 0FA5), hence Newton's
polynomials in the `c_j(E)` to those in the `c_j(E^∨)`. -/
theorem powerSumTotal_dualSheaf (E : Y.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r] (p : ℕ) :
    powerSumTotal C sY (dualSheaf E) r p =
      TotalChowClass.signScale (powerSumTotal C sY E r p) := by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 0 with rfl | hp
  · rw [powerSumTotal_zero, powerSumTotal_zero, ← TotalChowClass.signScaleRingHom_apply,
      map_natCast]
  · rw [powerSumTotal_of_ne_zero C sY _ _ hp, powerSumTotal_of_ne_zero C sY _ _ hp,
      ← TotalChowClass.signScaleRingHom_apply]
    symm
    refine AlgebraicGeometry.map_coe_powerSumEval_closure TotalChowClass.signScaleRingHom
      (chernSet_commute C sY) (chernSet_commute C sY) _
      (homPart_totalChern_mem_chernSet C sY E r) _
      (homPart_totalChern_mem_chernSet C sY (dualSheaf E) r) (fun j ↦ ?_) ?_ p
    · rw [TotalChowClass.signScaleRingHom_apply, ← TotalChowClass.homComponent_signScale,
        totalChern_dualSheaf]
    · rintro _ ⟨F, s, hF, j, rfl⟩
      rw [TotalChowClass.signScaleRingHom_apply, ← TotalChowClass.homComponent_signScale,
        ← totalChern_dualSheaf]
      exact Subring.subset_closure (homPart_totalChern_mem_chernSet C sY _ s j)

/-- The power sums of the dual of a finite locally free module are the `(-1)^p`-scalings of those
of the module, checked on the rank loci. -/
theorem powerSumOfFiniteLocallyFree_dualSheaf (E : Y.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] (p : ℕ) :
    powerSumOfFiniteLocallyFree C sY (dualSheaf E) p =
      TotalChowClass.signScale (powerSumOfFiniteLocallyFree C sY E p) := by
  refine TotalChowClass.eq_of_res_eq (isClopenDecomposition_rankLociFamily E) fun r ↦ ?_
  let := isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_pullback_rankLociFamily E r
  let e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (rankLociFamily E r).ι).obj (dualSheaf E) ≅
      dualSheaf ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (rankLociFamily E r).ι).obj E) :=
    VectorBundleKZero.pullbackDualSheafIso (rankLociFamily E r).ι E
      (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree E)
  have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (rankLociFamily E r).ι).obj (dualSheaf E)) r.down :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.of_iso.{u, u, u} e.symm
      inferInstance
  rw [TotalChowClass.res_signScale, res_powerSumOfFiniteLocallyFree_rankLocus C sY E r p,
    res_powerSumOfFiniteLocallyFree_of_rank C sY (dualSheaf E) _ rfl r.down p,
    powerSumTotal_congr C _ e rfl p]
  exact powerSumTotal_dualSheaf C _ _ r.down p

/-- **The sign rule for the Chern character of a dual**: `ch_p(E^∨) = (-1)^p ch_p(E)` for a
finite locally free module `E`. -/
theorem ch_classOf_dualSheaf (E : Y.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] :
    ch C sY (VectorBundleKZero.classOf Y (dualSheaf E)) =
      (chowGraded C sY).weight (fun n ↦ (-1 : ℚ) ^ n)
        (ch C sY (VectorBundleKZero.classOf Y E)) := by
  refine RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [chowGraded_weight_apply, ch_apply, ch_apply, chernCharacterVectorBundle_classOf,
    chernCharacterVectorBundle_classOf, chernCharacterOfFiniteLocallyFree,
    chernCharacterOfFiniteLocallyFree, powerSumClassOfFiniteLocallyFree,
    powerSumClassOfFiniteLocallyFree, powerSumOfFiniteLocallyFree_dualSheaf,
    TotalChowClass.signScale_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
    show ((-1 : ℚ) ^ n) = ((((-1 : ℤ) ^ n : ℤ) : ℚ)) by push_cast; ring, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]

end DualSign

section Cap

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))

/-- Over a field `δ` is bounded below, by `0`. -/
theorem bddBelow_relativeDimension_field :
    BddBelow (Set.range (relativeDimension (fieldChowSituation k).dimensionFunction sY)) :=
  ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩; exact relativeDimension_fieldChowSituation_nonneg k sY y⟩

/-- **The cap action is multiplicative**: `(c d) ∩ - = c ∩ (d ∩ -)`. -/
theorem cap_mul [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (c d : AQ k sY) :
    cap k sY (c * d) = cap k sY c * cap k sY d :=
  totalRationalChowCap_mul (fieldChowSituation k) sY 0
    (relativeDimension_fieldChowSituation_nonneg k sY) c d

/-- The Chern character of a coherent class is that of the corresponding class in
`K₀(Vect Y)`. -/
theorem chK_eq_ch [IsSmoothFT k sY] (β : CoherentKZero Y) :
    chK k sY β = ch (fieldChowSituation k) sY ((vectorBundleEquiv k sY).symm β) := by
  simp only [chK, AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, AddMonoidHom.coe_ofClass,
    AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom]

end Cap

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
  (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP]
  (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i]

/-- The conormal sheaf `C_{X/P}` of a closed immersion `i : X ⟶ P`: the first term of the
conormal sequence `0 → C_{X/P} → i^* Ω_{P/k} → Ω_{X/k} → 0` of Stacks 06AA. -/
noncomputable def conormalSheaf : X.Modules :=
  (Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.conormalShortComplex i sP).X₁

/-- The normal sheaf `N_{X/P}`, the dual of the conormal sheaf. -/
noncomputable def normalSheaf : X.Modules :=
  Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf (conormalSheaf k sP i)

/-- The class `[N_{X/P}] ∈ K₀(Vect X)` of the normal sheaf. -/
noncomputable def normalClass : VectorBundleKZero X :=
  VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (normalSheaf k sP i)

variable (hi : i ≫ sP = sX)

include sX hi in
/-- The conormal sheaf of a closed immersion of smooth schemes is finite locally free. -/
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_conormalSheaf :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
      (conormalSheaf k sP i) := by
  have hsm : Smooth (i ≫ sP) := by rw [hi]; infer_instance
  have := Scheme.Hom.isFiniteLocallyFree_relativeDifferentials sP
  exact isFiniteLocallyFree_X₁_of_shortExact
    (Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.conormalShortComplex_shortExact i sP hsm)
    (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackObj _ i)
    (Scheme.Hom.isFiniteLocallyFree_relativeDifferentials (i ≫ sP))

/-- **`td(T_X) = i^* td(T_P) · td(N)⁻¹`** for a closed immersion `i : X ⟶ P` of smooth schemes
with normal sheaf `N` (from the conormal sequence and multiplicativity of the Todd class). -/
theorem toddTangent_eq :
    toddTangent k sX =
      pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi (toddTangent k sP) *
        toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i) := by
  have hC := isFiniteLocallyFree_conormalSheaf k sX sP i hi
  subst hi
  have hS := Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.conormalShortComplex_shortExact i sP inferInstance
  have hΩP := Scheme.Hom.isFiniteLocallyFree_relativeDifferentials sP
  have hΩX := Scheme.Hom.isFiniteLocallyFree_relativeDifferentials (i ≫ sP)
  have h₂ := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackObj (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials sP) i
  have := hS.mono_f
  have := hS.epi_g
  have hK := VectorBundleKZero.classOf_shortExact
    (Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.conormalShortComplex i sP).f
    (Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.conormalShortComplex i sP).g
    (Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.conormalShortComplex i sP).zero hC h₂ hΩX hS.exact
  change VectorBundleKZero.classOf X
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials sP)) =
    VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (conormalSheaf k sP i) +
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials (i ≫ sP)) at hK
  have hσ := (isGradedHom_pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) (i ≫ sP) sP i rfl).map_weight
    (fun n ↦ (-1 : ℚ) ^ n)
  -- `ch(i^* [T_P]) = σ ch([i^* Ω_P])`, `σ` the sign rescaling
  have hpb : ch (fieldChowSituation k) (i ≫ sP)
      (VectorBundleKZero.pullback i (tangentClass k sP)) =
      (chowGraded (fieldChowSituation k) (i ≫ sP)).weight (fun n ↦ (-1 : ℚ) ^ n)
        (ch (fieldChowSituation k) (i ≫ sP) (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback i).obj (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials sP)))) := by
    rw [← pullbackAQ_ch (fieldChowSituation k) (i ≫ sP) sP i rfl, tangentClass, tangentSheaf,
      ch_classOf_dualSheaf, hσ, pullbackAQ_ch, VectorBundleKZero.pullback_classOf]
  -- `ch[T_X] = σ ch[Ω_X] = σ (ch[i^* Ω_P] - ch[C]) = ch(i^*[T_P]) - ch[N]`
  have key : ch (fieldChowSituation k) (i ≫ sP) (tangentClass k (i ≫ sP)) =
      ch (fieldChowSituation k) (i ≫ sP)
        (VectorBundleKZero.pullback i (tangentClass k sP) + -normalClass k sP i) := by
    rw [map_add, map_neg, hpb, normalClass, normalSheaf, ch_classOf_dualSheaf, tangentClass,
      tangentSheaf, ch_classOf_dualSheaf, ← GradedComplete.weight_neg,
      ← GradedComplete.weight_add, hK, map_add]
    congr 1
    abel
  calc toddTangent k (i ≫ sP)
      = toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) (i ≫ sP)
          (VectorBundleKZero.pullback i (tangentClass k sP) + -normalClass k sP i) :=
        congrArg (chowGraded (fieldChowSituation k) (i ≫ sP)).toddOf key
    _ = _ := by
        rw [toddClass_add, ← pullbackAQ_toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) (i ≫ sP) sP i rfl]
        rfl

/-- **The projection formula for `i`**: `i_* (i^* c ∩ γ) = c ∩ i_* γ`. -/
theorem rationalProperChowPushforward_cap_pullbackAQ (c : AQ k sP) (γ : CHQ k sX) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi
        (cap k sX (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi c) γ) =
      cap k sP c (rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi γ) :=
  rationalProperChowPushforward_totalRationalChowCap_pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi
    (bddBelow_relativeDimension_field k sX) (bddBelow_relativeDimension_field k sP) c γ

/-- **Riemann–Roch for a closed immersion without tangent bundles**: for every `α ∈ K'₀(X)`,

  `ch(i_! α) ∩ [P] = i_* ((ch(α) · td(N_{X/P})⁻¹) ∩ [X])`  in `CH_*(P) ⊗ ℚ`. -/
def ClosedImmersionFormula : Prop :=
  haveI := compactSpace k sP
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  ∀ α : CoherentKZero X,
    cap k sP (chK k sP (pushforwardK i α)) (fundamentalClass k sP) =
      rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi
        (cap k sX (chK k sX α * toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i))
          (fundamentalClass k sX))

/-- **Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch for a closed immersion follows from the formula without tangent
bundles.** -/
theorem riemannRochFor_of_closedImmersionFormula
    (h : ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi) : RiemannRochFor k sX sP i hi := by
  have := compactSpace k sP
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  intro α
  have hα := h α
  have hcX : Commute (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi (toddTangent k sP))
      (chK k sX α) := by
    rw [toddTangent, pullbackAQ_toddClass, chK_eq_ch k sX]
    exact commute_toddClass_ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX _ _
  have hcP : Commute (toddTangent k sP) (chK k sP (pushforwardK i α)) := by
    rw [toddTangent, chK_eq_ch k sP]
    exact commute_toddClass_ch (fieldChowSituation k) sP _ _
  have hring : chK k sX α * (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi (toddTangent k sP) *
        toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i)) =
      pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi (toddTangent k sP) *
        (chK k sX α * toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i)) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, hcX.eq]
  rw [tau_apply, tau_apply, toddTangent_eq k sX sP i hi, hring,
    cap_mul k sX (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi (toddTangent k sP)),
    Module.End.mul_apply, rationalProperChowPushforward_cap_pullbackAQ k sX sP i hi, ← hα,
    ← hcP.eq, cap_mul k sP (toddTangent k sP), Module.End.mul_apply]

end GRR

/-!
# Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch for projective morphisms, from its four remaining inputs

This file assembles the reductions of the project. The Riemann–Roch formula
`f_* ((ch(α) · td(T_X)) ∩ [X]) = (ch(f_! α) · td(T_Y)) ∩ [Y]` for a projective morphism
`f : X ⟶ Y` of smooth separated schemes of finite type over a field (`GRR.RiemannRochFor`) is
deduced from four statements:

* `GRR.ClosedImmersionFormula` for closed immersions (Riemann–Roch without tangent bundles);
* `GRR.ProjectionPushforwardFormula`, `GRR.ProjectionGeneration` and `GRR.ProjectionTauFormula`
  for the projections `ℙⁿ_Y ⟶ Y`.

`GRR.grothendieck_riemann_roch_of` is that implication; it is a reduction, not the theorem.
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Stacks.Chow

universe u

namespace GRR

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]

/-- **Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch for projective morphisms, assuming the four remaining inputs**:
the formula without tangent bundles for closed immersions, and the three statements about the
twisted classes on projective spaces. -/
theorem grothendieck_riemann_roch_of
    (hE : ∀ {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX]
      [IsSmoothFT k sP] (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ sP = sX),
      ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi)
    (h1 : ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sY] (n : ℕ),
      ProjectionPushforwardFormula k sY n)
    (h2 : ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sY] (n : ℕ),
      ProjectionGeneration k sY n)
    (h3 : ∀ {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sY] (n : ℕ),
      ProjectionTauFormula k sY n)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX]
    [IsSmoothFT k sY] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (hf : f ≫ sY = sX)
    (hproj : IsProjectiveMorphism f) :
    RiemannRochFor k sX sY f hf :=
  riemannRochFor_of_isProjectiveMorphism k sY
    (fun sX' _ _ i _ hi ↦ riemannRochFor_of_closedImmersionFormula k sX' _ i hi (hE sX' _ i hi))
    (fun n ↦ riemannRochFor_projection_of k sY n (h1 sY n) (h2 sY n) (h3 sY n)) sX f hf hproj

end GRR

/-!
# Hirzebruch–Riemann–Roch as the case `Y = Spec k`

For a proper smooth scheme `X` over a field `k`, the Euler characteristic
`χ(X, F) = ∑_i (-1)^i dim_k H^i(X, F)` is additive, hence a homomorphism
`GRR.eulerK k sX : K'₀(X) → ℤ`. It is compatible with the pushforward to the point
(`eulerK_pushforwardK`), and on the point the Riemann–Roch map is `τ(γ) = χ(γ) · [Spec k]`
(`tau_point`). Hence the Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch formula for `X → Spec k` gives
Hirzebruch–Riemann–Roch:

  `(s_X)_* ((ch(α) · td(T_X)) ∩ [X]) = χ(X, α) · [Spec k]`  in `CH_*(Spec k) ⊗ ℚ`,

i.e. `∫_X ch(α) · td(T_X) = χ(X, α)` (`hirzebruch_riemann_roch_of`).
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Stacks.Chow
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u

namespace GRR

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]

/-- The point `Spec k` is smooth, separated and of finite type over `k`. -/
instance isSmoothFT_id : IsSmoothFT k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) :=
  ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

section Euler

/-- The Euler characteristic is additive on short exact sequences of coherent modules: the
inclusion of coherent modules into all modules is exact. -/
theorem eulerCharacteristic_add_coherent {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper sX]
    {S : ShortComplex (Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf)} (hS : S.ShortExact) :
    @eulerCharacteristic k _ X sX _ S.X₂.obj
        (CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent S.X₂.property) =
      @eulerCharacteristic k _ X sX _ S.X₁.obj
          (CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent S.X₁.property) +
        @eulerCharacteristic k _ X sX _ S.X₃.obj
          (CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent S.X₃.property) := by
  have : Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits (coherentInclusion X) :=
    ObjectProperty.preservesFiniteLimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass _
  have : Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits (coherentInclusion X) :=
    ObjectProperty.preservesFiniteColimits_ι_of_isWeakSerreClass _
  have hS' : (S.map (coherentInclusion X)).ShortExact := hS.map_of_exact _
  have : (S.map (coherentInclusion X)).X₁.IsCoherent :=
    CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent S.X₁.property
  have : (S.map (coherentInclusion X)).X₂.IsCoherent :=
    CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent S.X₂.property
  have : (S.map (coherentInclusion X)).X₃.IsCoherent :=
    CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent S.X₃.property
  exact eulerCharacteristic_add_of_shortExact k sX hS'

/-- **The Euler characteristic as a homomorphism** `χ : K'₀(X) → ℤ`,
`χ([F]) = ∑_i (-1)^i dim_k H^i(X, F)`, for `X` proper over `k`. -/
noncomputable def eulerK {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper sX] :
    CoherentKZero X →+ ℤ :=
  KZero.lift (fun F => @eulerCharacteristic k _ X sX _ F.obj
      (CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent F.property))
    fun _ hS => eulerCharacteristic_add_coherent k sX hS

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper sX]

/-- `χ([F])` is the Euler characteristic of the coherent module `F`. -/
theorem eulerK_mk (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules X.ringCatSheaf) :
    eulerK k sX (KZero.mk _ F) =
      @eulerCharacteristic k _ X sX _ F.obj
        (CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent F.property) := by
  exact KZero.lift_mk _ _ F

/-- Euler characteristics along equal structure morphisms agree. -/
theorem eulerCharacteristic_congr_hom {f g : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)} (h : f = g) [IsProper f]
    [IsProper g] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    eulerCharacteristic k f F = eulerCharacteristic k g F := by
  subst h
  rfl

/-- **`χ(Spec k, (s_X)_! α) = χ(X, α)`**: the Euler characteristic is compatible with the
pushforward to the point. -/
theorem eulerK_pushforwardK (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    eulerK k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) (pushforwardK sX α) = eulerK k sX α := by
  have h : (eulerK k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))).comp (pushforwardK sX) = eulerK k sX := by
    refine KZero.hom_ext fun F => ?_
    have : F.obj.IsCoherent := CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent F.property
    have : F.obj.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_obj F
    rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, pushforwardK_mk, map_sum, eulerK_mk,
      ← eulerCharacteristic_congr_hom k (Category.comp_id sX) F.obj,
      eulerCharacteristic_eq_finsum_higherDirectImage k sX (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) F.obj,
      finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ (s := Finset.range (cohomologicalBound sX)) ?_]
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [map_zsmul, eulerK_mk, smul_eq_mul]
      rfl
    · intro i hi
      rw [Function.mem_support] at hi
      rw [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio]
      by_contra hle
      refine hi ?_
      have hz := isZero_higherDirectImage_of_cohomologicalBound_le sX F.obj i (not_lt.1 hle)
      have h0 := KZero.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero ((isZero_higherDirectImageCoh_iff sX F i).2 hz)
      have h1 := congrArg (eulerK k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))) h0
      rw [eulerK_mk, map_zero] at h1
      exact mul_eq_zero_of_right _ h1
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h α

end Euler

/-! ### Chow groups and cap products on the point -/

section Point

/-- Every point of `Spec k` has relative dimension `0` over `Spec k`. -/
theorem relativeDimension_point (x : Spec (.of k)) :
    relativeDimension (fieldChowSituation k).dimensionFunction (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) x = 0 :=
  (relativeDimension_id _ x).trans (fieldChowSituation_dimensionFunction k x)

/-- `CH_j(Spec k) = 0` for `j ≠ 0`. -/
theorem chowGroup_point_eq_zero {j : ℤ} (hj : j ≠ 0)
    (α : chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) j) : α = 0 :=
  chowGroup_eq_zero _ _ (fun x => by rw [relativeDimension_point]; exact fun h => hj h.symm) α

/-- `CH_j(Spec k) ⊗ ℚ = 0` for `j ≠ 0`. -/
theorem rationalChow_point_eq_zero {j : ℤ} (hj : j ≠ 0)
    (t : ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) j) : t = 0 := by
  induction t using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul q a => rw [chowGroup_point_eq_zero k hj a, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [hx, hy, add_zero]

/-- On `CH_*(Spec k) ⊗ ℚ` the cap product with `c ∈ ∏_p A^p(Spec k) ⊗ ℚ` only depends on the
degree-`0` component of `c`: the components of degree `p > 0` land in `CH_{-p}(Spec k) = 0`. -/
theorem cap_point_congr {c c' : AQ k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))} (h : c 0 = c' 0) :
    cap k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) c = cap k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) c' := by
  have hlo : ∀ x : Spec (.of k), (0 : ℤ) ≤
      relativeDimension (fieldChowSituation k).dimensionFunction (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) x :=
    fun x => (relativeDimension_point k x).ge
  have hs : ∀ p : ℕ, (p : ℤ) ≤ 0 - 0 → p ∈ ({0} : Finset ℕ) := fun p hp => by
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton]
    omega
  have e : ∀ d : AQ k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))), (RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily.symm d) 0 = d 0 :=
    fun d => (RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily_apply (RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily.symm d)
      0).symm.trans (by rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply])
  unfold cap
  refine DirectSum.linearMap_ext ℚ fun j => LinearMap.ext fun t => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rcases eq_or_ne j 0 with rfl | hj
  · rw [totalRationalChowCap_lof_eq_sum _ _ _ 0 hlo _ 0 t {0} hs,
      totalRationalChowCap_lof_eq_sum _ _ _ 0 hlo _ 0 t {0} hs,
      Finset.sum_singleton, Finset.sum_singleton, e, e, h]
  · rw [rationalChow_point_eq_zero k hj t]
    simp only [map_zero]

/-- The cap product with the integer `n` is multiplication by `n`. -/
theorem cap_natCast {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (n : ℕ)
    (x : CHQ k sX) : cap k sX (n : AQ k sX) x = n • x := by
  unfold cap
  rw [← nsmul_one, map_nsmul, map_nsmul, totalRationalChowCap_one, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    Module.End.one_apply]

end Point

/-! ### Degree-zero components of the Chern character and the Todd class -/

section DegreeZero

variable {C : ChowSituation.{u}} {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX]

/-- The degree-`0` component of a Todd class is that of `1`. -/
theorem toddClass_apply_zero (a : VectorBundleKZero X) :
    toddClass C sX a 0 = (1 : RationalTotalChowClass C sX) 0 := by
  change (chowGraded C sX).comp 0 ((chowGraded C sX).gexp _) = (chowGraded C sX).comp 0 1
  rw [GradedComplete.comp_gexp, Finset.sum_range_one, pow_zero, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one,
    inv_one, one_smul]

/-- Multiplying by a Todd class does not change the degree-`0` component. -/
theorem mul_toddClass_apply_zero (c : RationalTotalChowClass C sX) (a : VectorBundleKZero X) :
    (c * toddClass C sX a) 0 = c 0 := by
  have h := (chowGraded C sX).mul_congr 0 c c (toddClass C sX a) 1 (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun p hp => by
      obtain rfl : p = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hp
      exact toddClass_apply_zero sX a)
  rw [mul_one] at h
  exact h

/-- The degree-`0` component of `ch(E)` is the rank of `E` (`P_0(E) = r`). -/
theorem ch_classOf_apply_zero (E : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r] :
    ch C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) 0 = (r : RationalTotalChowClass C sX) 0 := by
  change rationalTotalChernCharacterRingHom C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) 0 = _
  rw [rationalTotalChernCharacterRingHom_classOf, rationalTotalChernCharacter_apply,
    chernCharacterOfFiniteLocallyFree, powerSumClassOfFiniteLocallyFree,
    powerSumOfFiniteLocallyFree_eq_powerSumTotal C sX E r, powerSumTotal_zero,
    Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one, inv_one,
    ← map_natCast (RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass (C := C) (sX := sX)) r,
    RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass_apply]

end DegreeZero

/-! ### Coherent modules on the point -/

section Modules

/-- The global sections of a module on `Spec k`, with `k` acting through `Γ(Spec k, 𝒪)`, are its
global sections with `k` acting through the structure morphism `𝟙 (Spec k)`. -/
noncomputable def sectionsLinearEquiv (M : (Spec (.of k)).Modules) :
    (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of k)).obj M ≃ₗ[k]
      (restrictScalarsOverBase k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))).obj
        ((SheafOfModules.evaluation (Spec (.of k)).ringCatSheaf (Opposite.op ⊤)).obj M) where
  toFun x := x
  invFun x := x
  map_add' _ _ := rfl
  map_smul' _ _ := rfl
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

/-- On `Spec k` the Euler characteristic of a coherent module is the dimension of its `H⁰`: the
higher cohomology of a quasi-coherent module on an affine scheme vanishes. -/
theorem eulerCharacteristic_point (F : (Spec (.of k)).Modules) [F.IsCoherent] :
    eulerCharacteristic k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) F =
      Module.finrank k (cohomologyOverField k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) F 0) := by
  have : F.IsQuasicoherent :=
    (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.CoherentTFAE.isQuasicoherent_isFiniteType_of_isCoherent F).1
  have hz : ∀ m, 1 ≤ m →
      Module.finrank k (cohomologyOverField k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) F m) = 0 := fun m hm =>
    have := ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      ((isZero_cohomologyOverField_iff_isZero_hgroup k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) F m).mpr
        (Stacks.Cohomology.Cech.isZero_hgroup_of_isAffineOpen _ F ⊤ (isAffineOpen_top _) m hm))
    Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  rw [eulerCharacteristic_eq_finsum, finsum_eq_sum_of_support_subset (s := Finset.range 1) _
    fun m hm => ?_]
  · rw [Finset.sum_range_one]
    ring
  · by_contra hn
    simp only [Finset.coe_range, Set.mem_Iio, not_lt] at hn
    simp [hz m hn] at hm

/-- A coherent module on `Spec k` is finite locally free of rank `r = dim_k H⁰`, and its Euler
characteristic is `r`. -/
theorem exists_rank_point
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules (Spec (.of k)).ringCatSheaf) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} F.obj r ∧
      eulerK k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) (KZero.mk _ F) = r := by
  have : F.obj.IsCoherent := CoherentAbelian.isCoherent_of_stacksIsCoherent F.property
  have hqc : F.obj.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_obj F
  have : FiniteDimensional k (cohomologyOverField k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) F.obj 0) :=
    finiteDimensional_cohomologyOverField_of_isProper k _ F.obj 0
  let e : (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of k)).obj F.obj ≃ₗ[k]
      cohomologyOverField k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) F.obj 0 :=
    (sectionsLinearEquiv k F.obj).trans
      (cohomologyOverFieldZeroLinearIso k _ F.obj).symm.toLinearEquiv
  refine ⟨Module.finrank k (cohomologyOverField k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) F.obj 0), ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hfin : Module.Finite k ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of k)).obj F.obj) :=
      Module.Finite.equiv e.symm
    have h := (Module.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_iff_finrank_eq _ _).mpr ⟨hfin, e.finrank_eq⟩
    have : IsIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ F.obj) :=
      (isQuasicoherent_iff_isIso_fromTildeΓ F.obj).mp hqc
    exact (Scheme.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_iff F.obj _).mp <|
      Scheme.Modules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.of_iso (asIso (Scheme.Modules.fromTildeΓ F.obj))
        ((tilde_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_iff k ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := .of k)).obj F.obj)
          _).mpr h)
  · rw [eulerK_mk]
    exact eulerCharacteristic_point k F.obj

end Modules

/-- **Riemann–Roch on the point**: `τ(γ) = χ(γ) · [Spec k]` for `γ ∈ K'₀(Spec k)`. -/
theorem tau_point (γ : CoherentKZero (Spec (.of k))) :
    tau k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) γ =
      ((eulerK k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) γ : ℤ) : ℚ) • fundamentalClass k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) := by
  let R : CoherentKZero (Spec (.of k)) →+ CHQ k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) :=
    { toFun := fun γ => ((eulerK k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) γ : ℤ) : ℚ) •
        fundamentalClass k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
      map_zero' := by rw [map_zero, Int.cast_zero, zero_smul]
      map_add' := fun a b => by rw [map_add, Int.cast_add, add_smul] }
  have h : tau k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) = R := by
    refine KZero.hom_ext fun F => ?_
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hχ⟩ := exists_rank_point k F
    have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} F.obj :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree F.obj r
    have hθ : (vectorBundleEquiv k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))).symm (KZero.mk _ F) =
        VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ F.obj := by
      rw [AddEquiv.symm_apply_eq]
      exact (regularVectorBundleKZeroAddEquiv_classOf _ _ F this).symm
    have hch : chK k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) (KZero.mk _ F) =
        ch (fieldChowSituation k) (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ F.obj) :=
      congrArg (ch (fieldChowSituation k) (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))) hθ
    change cap k _ (chK k _ (KZero.mk _ F) * toddTangent k _) (fundamentalClass k _) =
      ((eulerK k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) (KZero.mk _ F) : ℤ) : ℚ) •
        fundamentalClass k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
    rw [cap_point_congr k (c' := (r : AQ k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))))) ?_, cap_natCast, hχ,
      Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
    rw [toddTangent, mul_toddClass_apply_zero, hch]
    exact ch_classOf_apply_zero _ F.obj r
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h γ

/-- **Hirzebruch–Riemann–Roch, from Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch for `X → Spec k`**: for `X` smooth
and proper over `k` and `α ∈ K'₀(X)`, the pushforward to the point of
`(ch(α) · td(T_X)) ∩ [X]` is `χ(X, α) · [Spec k]`. -/
theorem hirzebruch_riemann_roch_of {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX]
    [IsProper sX]
    (hRR : RiemannRochFor k sX (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) sX (Category.comp_id sX))
    (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
        (Category.comp_id sX) (tau k sX α) =
      ((eulerK k sX α : ℤ) : ℚ) • fundamentalClass k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) := by
  rw [hRR α, tau_point, eulerK_pushforwardK]

end GRR
