/-!
# The Koszul identity for Chern characters

For `Q` finite locally free of constant rank `r` on `X`, with `λ_{-1}(Q^∨) = ∑_p (-1)^p [⋀^p Q^∨]`,

  `ch(λ_{-1}(Q^∨)) = c_r(Q) · td(Q)⁻¹`   in `∏_p A^p(X) ⊗ ℚ`  (`GRR.ch_koszul`).

The proof is by the splitting principle: for `V` with a filtration by invertible modules,
`λ_{-1}(V) = ∏ (1 - [L_i])` in `K₀(Vect X)`, and the rank-one case is `td(e^h) (1 - e^{-h}) = h`.
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Stacks.Chow Finset
open Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules (dualSheaf)

universe u

namespace GRR

/-! ### Exterior powers along an invertible submodule, in `K₀(Vect X)` -/

section KTheory

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-- `λ_{-1}(E) = ∑_{p ≤ r} (-1)^p [⋀^p E]` in `K₀(Vect X)`. -/
noncomputable def lambdaNegOne (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ) : VectorBundleKZero X :=
  ∑ p ∈ range (r + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ p •
    VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower E (p : ℤ))

/-- `[⋀^n E] = 0` for `n` above the rank of `E`. -/
theorem classOf_exteriorPower_eq_zero_of_lt (E : X.Modules) (r n : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} E r] (h : r < n) :
    VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower E (n : ℤ)) = 0 := by
  have h0 : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower E (n : ℤ)) 0 := by
    have := Scheme.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_exteriorPower E r n
    rwa [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt h] at this
  have hz := Stacks.WeilCohomology.isZero_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_zero _ h0
  rw [VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso hz.isoZero
    (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _ 0),
    VectorBundleKZero.classOf_zero]

/-- **Exterior powers of an extension by a module of rank one**: for `0 → N → V → Q → 0` with `N`
of rank one, `[⋀^{p+1} V] = [N] [⋀^p Q] + [⋀^{p+1} Q]`. -/
theorem classOf_exteriorPower_succ_of_rankOne {N V Q : X.Modules} (f : N ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ Q)
    (w : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} N 1] (m : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} Q m] (p : ℕ) :
    VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower V ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf X N *
          VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower Q (p : ℤ)) +
        VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower Q ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
  have hN : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} N :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree N 1
  have hQ : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} Q :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree Q m
  have hV : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} V :=
    GenuineChern.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_shortExact _ hS hN hQ
  have hΛ : ∀ (M : X.Modules) (n : ℕ),
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} M →
        AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
          (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower M (n : ℤ)) :=
    fun M n hM ↦ Scheme.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFree_exteriorPower M n hM
  rcases p with _ | k
  · have : Mono f := hS.mono_f
    have : Epi g := hS.epi_g
    have eV : VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower V ((0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
        VectorBundleKZero.classOf X V :=
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso
        (_root_.SheafOfModules.algebras _ V).exteriorPowerOneIso (hΛ V 1 hV)
    have eQ : VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower Q ((0 + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) =
        VectorBundleKZero.classOf X Q :=
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso
        (_root_.SheafOfModules.algebras _ Q).exteriorPowerOneIso (hΛ Q 1 hQ)
    rw [eV, eQ, Nat.cast_zero, VectorBundleKZero.classOf_exteriorPower_zero, mul_one]
    exact VectorBundleKZero.classOf_shortExact f g w hN hV hQ hS.exact
  · obtain ⟨φ, w', hS'⟩ := Scheme.Modules.shortExact_exteriorPower_of_rankOne f g w hS m k
    have : Mono φ := hS'.mono_f
    have : Epi (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPowerMap g ((1 + (k + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) := hS'.epi_g
    have h1N : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
        (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower N 1) := hΛ N 1 hN
    have hT := @AlgebraicGeometry.isFiniteLocallyFree_tensorObj _ _ _ h1N (hΛ Q (k + 1) hQ)
    have key := VectorBundleKZero.classOf_shortExact φ _ w' hT (hΛ V _ hV) (hΛ Q _ hQ) hS'.exact
    have e1N : VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower N 1) =
        VectorBundleKZero.classOf X N :=
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso
        (_root_.SheafOfModules.algebras _ N).exteriorPowerOneIso h1N
    have e2 : VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.tensorObj
          (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower N 1) (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower Q ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) =
        VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower N 1) *
          VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower Q ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) :=
      (VectorBundleKZero.classOf_mul _ _ h1N (hΛ Q (k + 1) hQ)).symm
    rw [e2, e1N, show 1 + (k + 1) = k + 1 + 1 by omega] at key
    exact key

/-- The alternating sum of a sequence `a` with `a_{p+1} = n b_p + b_{p+1}` and `a_0 = b_0`. -/
theorem sum_neg_one_pow_mul_eq {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b : ℕ → R) (n : R)
    (ha0 : a 0 = b 0) (ha : ∀ p, a (p + 1) = n * b p + b (p + 1)) (M : ℕ) :
    ∑ p ∈ range (M + 1), (-1 : R) ^ p * a p =
      (1 - n) * ∑ p ∈ range M, (-1 : R) ^ p * b p + (-1) ^ M * b M := by
  induction M with
  | zero => simp [ha0]
  | succ M ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, ha, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    ring

/-- **`λ_{-1}` of an extension by a module of rank one**: for `0 → N → V → Q → 0` with `N` of
rank one and `Q` of rank `m`, `λ_{-1}(V) = (1 - [N]) λ_{-1}(Q)`. -/
theorem lambdaNegOne_of_rankOne {N V Q : X.Modules} (f : N ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ Q) (w : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} N 1] (m : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} Q m] :
    lambdaNegOne V (m + 1) = (1 - VectorBundleKZero.classOf X N) * lambdaNegOne Q m := by
  have h := sum_neg_one_pow_mul_eq
    (fun p ↦ VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower V (p : ℤ)))
    (fun p ↦ VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower Q (p : ℤ)))
    (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X N)
    (by simp only [Nat.cast_zero, VectorBundleKZero.classOf_exteriorPower_zero])
    (classOf_exteriorPower_succ_of_rankOne f g w hS m) (m + 1)
  rw [classOf_exteriorPower_eq_zero_of_lt Q m (m + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self m), mul_zero,
    add_zero] at h
  simp only [lambdaNegOne, zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]
  exact h

/-- **`λ_{-1}` of a filtered module**: if `V` has a filtration with successive quotients `L_i`
of rank one, `λ_{-1}(V) = ∏_i (1 - [L_i])`. -/
theorem lambdaNegOne_of_hasQuotients : ∀ (r : ℕ) (V : X.Modules) (L : Fin r → X.Modules)
    [∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (L i) 1],
    HasQuotients X r V L →
      lambdaNegOne V r = ∏ i, (1 - VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (L i)) := by
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    intro V L _ _
    rw [lambdaNegOne, Finset.sum_range_one, pow_zero, one_smul, Nat.cast_zero,
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf_exteriorPower_zero, Fin.prod_univ_zero]
  | succ r ih =>
    intro V L _ h
    obtain ⟨N, eN, Q, f, g, w, hS, hQ⟩ := exists_bottom_of_hasQuotients r V L h
    have := isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_hasQuotients r Q _ hQ
    have hN1 : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} N 1 :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.of_iso eN.symm inferInstance
    have hN : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} N :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree N 1
    rw [lambdaNegOne_of_rankOne f g w hS r, ih Q _ hQ, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc,
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso eN hN]
    exact mul_comm _ _

/-- Pullback of `λ_{-1}`: `f^* λ_{-1}(E) = λ_{-1}(f^* E)`. -/
theorem pullback_lambdaNegOne {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (E : X.Modules)
    [hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] (r : ℕ) :
    VectorBundleKZero.pullback f (lambdaNegOne E r) =
      lambdaNegOne ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E) r := by
  rw [lambdaNegOne, lambdaNegOne, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  have hΛ : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
      (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower E (p : ℤ)) :=
    Scheme.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFree_exteriorPower E p hE
  rw [map_zsmul, VectorBundleKZero.pullback_classOf,
    VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso (VectorBundleKZero.pullbackExteriorPowerIso f E p)
      (isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackObj _ f)]

/-- Pullback of the class of a dual: `f^* [E^∨] = [(f^* E)^∨]`. -/
theorem pullback_classOf_dualSheaf {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (E : X.Modules)
    [hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] :
    VectorBundleKZero.pullback f (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf E)) =
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf Y (dualSheaf ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj E)) := by
  have hd : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (dualSheaf E)) := isFiniteLocallyFree_pullbackObj _ f
  rw [VectorBundleKZero.pullback_classOf]
  exact VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso (VectorBundleKZero.pullbackDualSheafIso f E
    (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree E)) hd

end KTheory

/-! ### Graded helpers -/

namespace GradedComplete

variable {R : Type*} [Ring R] [Module ℚ R] (G : GRR.GradedComplete R)

/-- Degreewise rescalings compose by multiplying the weights. -/
theorem weight_weight (w w' : ℕ → ℚ) (a : R) :
    G.weight w (G.weight w' a) = G.weight (fun n ↦ w n * w' n) a :=
  G.ext _ _ fun n ↦ by rw [comp_weight, comp_weight, comp_weight, smul_smul]

/-- The sign rescaling `(-1)^n` is an involution. -/
theorem weight_sign_sign (a : R) :
    G.weight (fun n ↦ (-1 : ℚ) ^ n) (G.weight (fun n ↦ (-1 : ℚ) ^ n) a) = a := by
  rw [weight_weight]
  conv_rhs => rw [← G.weight_one a]
  congr 1
  funext n
  rw [← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow]

/-- For `h` homogeneous of degree one, `e^{-x}` evaluated at `-h` is `e^x` evaluated at `h`. -/
theorem ev_neg_expNeg {h : R} (hh : G.IsHom 1 h) :
    G.ev (-h) expNeg = G.ev h (PowerSeries.exp ℚ) := by
  have hh' : G.IsHom 1 (-h) := fun p hp ↦ by rw [map_neg, hh p hp, neg_zero]
  refine G.ext _ _ fun n ↦ ?_
  rw [G.comp_ev_of_isHom hh', G.comp_ev_of_isHom hh, neg_pow, coeff_expNeg,
    PowerSeries.coeff_exp, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply]
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd n with hn | hn
  · rw [hn.neg_one_pow, hn.neg_one_pow, one_mul]
  · rw [hn.neg_one_pow, hn.neg_one_pow, neg_one_mul, map_neg, smul_neg, neg_div, neg_smul,
      neg_neg]

end GradedComplete

/-! ### Chern characters and Todd classes of duals -/

section Chow

variable (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX]

/-- The Todd class only depends on the Chern character. -/
theorem toddClass_eq_of_ch_eq {a b : VectorBundleKZero X} (h : ch C sX a = ch C sX b) :
    toddClass C sX a = toddClass C sX b := by
  simp only [toddClass, h]

/-- `ch(E^∨∨) = ch(E)`. -/
theorem ch_classOf_dualSheaf_dualSheaf (E : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] :
    ch C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf (dualSheaf E))) =
      ch C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) := by
  rw [ch_classOf_dualSheaf, ch_classOf_dualSheaf, GradedComplete.weight_sign_sign]

/-- `td(E^∨∨) = td(E)`. -/
theorem toddClass_classOf_dualSheaf_dualSheaf (E : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] :
    toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf (dualSheaf E))) =
      toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) :=
  toddClass_eq_of_ch_eq C sX (ch_classOf_dualSheaf_dualSheaf C sX E)

/-- **The Todd class of the dual is multiplicative on short exact sequences**:
`td(V^∨) = td(N^∨) td(Q^∨)` for `0 → N → V → Q → 0`. -/
theorem toddClass_classOf_dualSheaf_of_shortExact {N V Q : X.Modules} (f : N ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ Q)
    (w : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    [hN : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} N]
    [hQ : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} Q] :
    toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf V)) =
      toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf N)) *
        toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf Q)) := by
  have hV : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} V :=
    GenuineChern.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_shortExact _ hS hN hQ
  have : Mono f := hS.mono_f
  have : Epi g := hS.epi_g
  rw [← toddClass_add]
  refine toddClass_eq_of_ch_eq C sX ?_
  rw [map_add, ch_classOf_dualSheaf, ch_classOf_dualSheaf, ch_classOf_dualSheaf,
    ← GradedComplete.weight_add, ← map_add,
    ← VectorBundleKZero.classOf_shortExact f g w hN hV hQ hS.exact]

/-- **The rank-one Koszul identity**: `ch(1 - [L]) · td(L^∨) = -c₁(L)` for an invertible `L`. -/
theorem ch_one_sub_mul_toddClass_dualSheaf (L : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj X.ringCatSheaf.property L] :
    ch C sX (1 - VectorBundleKZero.classOf X L) *
        toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf L)) =
      -firstChernQ C sX L := by
  have hy := isHom_firstChernQ C sX L
  have hy0 : (chowGraded C sX).comp 0 (-firstChernQ C sX L) = 0 := by
    rw [map_neg, hy 0 zero_ne_one, neg_zero]
  have hdual : firstChernQ C sX (dualSheaf L) = -firstChernQ C sX L := by
    simp only [firstChernQ, TotalChowClass.firstChernTotal_dualSheaf, map_neg]
  rw [← (commute_toddClass_ch C sX _ _).eq, toddClass_classOf_invertible, hdual, map_sub, map_one,
    ch_classOf_invertible, ← GradedComplete.ev_neg_expNeg _ hy]
  exact (chowGraded C sX).ev_toddSeries_mul_one_sub_ev_expNeg hy0

/-- `c_0 = 1`. -/
theorem homComponent_zero_one :
    TotalChowClass.homComponent 0 (1 : TotalChowClass C sX) = 1 := by
  refine TotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ ?_
  rw [TotalChowClass.homComponent_apply]
  split_ifs with hp
  · rw [hp]
  · rw [TotalChowClass.one_apply_of_ne hp]

/-- **The top Chern class of an extension by an invertible module**: for `0 → N → V → Q → 0`
with `N` invertible and `Q` of rank `r`, `c_{r+1}(V) = c₁(N) c_r(Q)`. -/
theorem homComponent_totalChern_of_shortExact {N V Q : X.Modules} (f : N ⟶ V) (g : V ⟶ Q)
    (w : f ≫ g = 0) (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g w).ShortExact)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj X.ringCatSheaf.property N] (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} Q r]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} V (r + 1)] :
    TotalChowClass.homComponent (r + 1) (totalChern C sX V (r + 1)) =
      TotalChowClass.firstChernTotal C sX N *
        TotalChowClass.homComponent r (totalChern C sX Q r) := by
  have := isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_one_of_isInvertible N
  have hV' : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} V (1 + r) :=
    add_comm r 1 ▸ ‹_›
  have hW : totalChern C sX V (1 + r) = totalChern C sX N 1 * totalChern C sX Q r :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (chernTotal_shortExact C sX f g w hS 1 r)
  have hV : totalChern C sX V (r + 1) = totalChern C sX V (1 + r) :=
    totalChern_congr C sX (Iso.refl V) (by omega)
  have h0 : TotalChowClass.homComponent (r + 1) (totalChern C sX Q r) = 0 := by
    refine TotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ ?_
    rw [TotalChowClass.homComponent_apply]
    split_ifs with hp
    · subst hp
      exact totalChern_apply_of_lt C sX Q r (by omega)
    · rfl
  rw [hV, hW, totalChern_eq_one_add_firstChernTotal, add_mul, one_mul, map_add,
    TotalChowClass.homComponent_succ_mul_of_isHomogeneous_one
      (TotalChowClass.isHomogeneous_firstChernTotal C sX N), h0, zero_add]

/-- **The Koszul identity, dual form, for a filtered module**: if `V` has a filtration with
successive quotients of rank one, `ch(λ_{-1} V) · td(V^∨) = (-1)^r c_r(V)`. -/
theorem ch_lambdaNegOne_mul_toddClass_of_hasQuotients : ∀ (r : ℕ) (V : X.Modules)
    (L : Fin r → X.Modules)
    [∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (L i) 1]
    (h : HasQuotients X r V L),
    letI := isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_hasQuotients r V L h
    ch C sX (lambdaNegOne V r) * toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf V)) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ r • RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass
        (TotalChowClass.homComponent r (totalChern C sX V r)) := by
  intro r
  induction r with
  | zero =>
    intro V L _ h
    have := isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_hasQuotients 0 V L h
    have hV : IsZero V := h
    have hVF : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} V :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree V 0
    have hcl : VectorBundleKZero.classOf X V = 0 := by
      rw [VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso hV.isoZero hVF, VectorBundleKZero.classOf_zero]
    have htd : toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf V)) = 1 := by
      rw [← toddClass_zero C sX]
      refine toddClass_eq_of_ch_eq C sX ?_
      rw [ch_classOf_dualSheaf, hcl, map_zero, GradedComplete.weight_zero]
    have hl : lambdaNegOne V 0 = 1 := by
      rw [lambdaNegOne, Finset.sum_range_one, pow_zero, one_smul, Nat.cast_zero,
        VectorBundleKZero.classOf_exteriorPower_zero]
    rw [hl, map_one, one_mul, htd, totalChern_of_rank_zero, homComponent_zero_one, map_one,
      pow_zero, one_smul]
  | succ r ih =>
    intro V L _ h
    obtain ⟨N, eN, Q, f, g, w, hS, hQ⟩ := exists_bottom_of_hasQuotients r V L h
    have hQr := isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_hasQuotients r Q _ hQ
    have hN1 : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} N 1 :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.of_iso eN.symm inferInstance
    have hNi : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.sheaf.obj
        X.ringCatSheaf.property N :=
      Stacks.ModuleDescent.isInvertible_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_one X N hN1
    have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} N :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree N 1
    have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} Q :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree Q r
    have := isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_of_hasQuotients (r + 1) V L h
    have IH := ih Q (fun i ↦ L i.castSucc) hQ
    have hc : Commute (ch C sX (lambdaNegOne Q r))
        (toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf N))) :=
      (commute_toddClass_ch C sX _ _).symm
    rw [lambdaNegOne_of_rankOne f g w hS r, map_mul,
      toddClass_classOf_dualSheaf_of_shortExact C sX f g w hS,
      homComponent_totalChern_of_shortExact C sX f g w hS r]
    calc ch C sX (1 - VectorBundleKZero.classOf X N) * ch C sX (lambdaNegOne Q r) *
          (toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf N)) *
            toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf Q)))
        = (ch C sX (1 - VectorBundleKZero.classOf X N) *
            toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf N))) *
          (ch C sX (lambdaNegOne Q r) *
            toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf Q))) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (ch C sX (lambdaNegOne Q r)), hc.eq, mul_assoc, mul_assoc]
      _ = -firstChernQ C sX N * ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r • RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass
            (TotalChowClass.homComponent r (totalChern C sX Q r))) := by
          rw [ch_one_sub_mul_toddClass_dualSheaf, IH]
      _ = _ := by
          rw [map_mul, mul_smul_comm, neg_mul, pow_succ, mul_smul, neg_one_smul]
          rfl

/-! ### The splitting principle for rational classes -/

/-- **Pullback along a morphism with injective restriction of total classes is injective** on
`∏_p A^p ⊗ ℚ` (`ℚ` is flat over `ℤ`). -/
theorem pullbackAQ_injective {P : Scheme.{u}} (sP : P ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sP]
    (π : P ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType π] (hs : π ≫ sX = sP)
    (hres : Function.Injective (TotalChowClass.res π hs)) :
    Function.Injective (pullbackAQ C sP sX π hs) := by
  intro a b hab
  refine RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ ?_
  have hp := congrArg (fun c : RationalTotalChowClass C sP ↦ c p) hab
  simp only [pullbackAQ_apply] at hp
  have hρ : Function.Injective (chowCohomologyRestrictionOfEq C sP sX hs
      (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C) p) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro c hc
    have h1 : TotalChowClass.res π hs (TotalChowClass.single p c) = 0 := by
      refine TotalChowClass.ext fun q ↦ ?_
      rw [TotalChowClass.res_apply_eq_chowCohomologyRestrictionOfEq, TotalChowClass.zero_apply]
      rcases eq_or_ne q p with rfl | hq
      · rw [TotalChowClass.single_apply_same, hc]
      · rw [TotalChowClass.single_apply_of_ne hq, map_zero]
    have h2 := congrArg (fun t : TotalChowClass C sX ↦ t p) (hres (h1.trans (map_zero _).symm))
    simp only [TotalChowClass.single_apply_same, TotalChowClass.zero_apply] at h2
    exact h2
  have hQ : Function.Injective ((chowCohomologyRestrictionOfEq C sP sX hs
      (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (gysinSystemOfInvertible_isNaturalUnderBaseChangeIso C)
        p).toIntLinearMap.baseChange ℚ) := by
    rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_lTensor]
    exact Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _ hρ
  exact hQ hp

/-- **The splitting principle for rational classes** (Stacks 02UL): two classes in
`∏_p A^p(X) ⊗ ℚ` agree if their pullbacks agree along every `π : P ⟶ X` along which the `E_i`
acquire filtrations with invertible successive quotients. -/
theorem eq_of_pullbackAQ_eq_of_hasInvertibleFiltration {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (E : I → X.Modules) (r : I → ℕ)
    (hE : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (E i) (r i))
    {a b : RationalTotalChowClass C sX}
    (h : ∀ {P : Scheme.{u}} (sP : P ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sP] (π : P ⟶ X)
      [LocallyOfFiniteType π] (hs : π ≫ sX = sP),
      (∀ i, Stacks.WeilCohomology.HasInvertibleFiltration P
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback π).obj (E i)) (r i)) →
        pullbackAQ C sP sX π hs a = pullbackAQ C sP sX π hs b) :
    a = b := by
  obtain ⟨T, -, -, -, huniv, hfilt, -⟩ := exists_splittingMorphism_isProjective C sX I E r hE
  exact pullbackAQ_injective C sX T.sP T.π T.hsP
    (TotalChowClass.res_injective_of_universallyChowInjective T.π T.hsP _ T.relDim huniv)
    (h T.sP T.π T.hsP hfilt)

/-- **The Koszul identity, dual form**: for `V` finite locally free of rank `r`,
`ch(λ_{-1} V) · td(V^∨) = (-1)^r c_r(V)`, by the splitting principle. -/
theorem ch_lambdaNegOne_mul_toddClass (V : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    [hV : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} V r] :
    ch C sX (lambdaNegOne V r) * toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf V)) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ r • RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass
        (TotalChowClass.homComponent r (totalChern C sX V r)) := by
  have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} V :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree V r
  refine eq_of_pullbackAQ_eq_of_hasInvertibleFiltration C sX (I := Unit) (fun _ ↦ V)
    (fun _ ↦ r) (fun _ ↦ hV) fun {P} sP _ π _ hs hfilt ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hQ⟩ := exists_hasQuotients_of_hasInvertibleFiltration (hfilt ())
  have : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (L i) 1 :=
    fun i ↦ @isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_one_of_isInvertible _ (L i) (hL i)
  rw [map_mul, pullbackAQ_ch, pullbackAQ_toddClass, pullback_lambdaNegOne,
    pullback_classOf_dualSheaf, map_zsmul, pullbackAQ_ofTotalChowClass,
    TotalChowClass.res_homComponent, TotalChowClass.res_totalChern]
  exact ch_lambdaNegOne_mul_toddClass_of_hasQuotients C sP r _ L hQ

/-- The sign rescaling of a class homogeneous of degree `r` is multiplication by `(-1)^r`. -/
theorem signScale_eq_of_isHomogeneous {c : TotalChowClass C sX} {r : ℕ}
    (hc : c.IsHomogeneous r) : TotalChowClass.signScale c = (-1 : ℤ) ^ r • c := by
  refine TotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ ?_
  rw [TotalChowClass.signScale_apply, ← TotalChowClass.component_apply p ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r • c),
    map_zsmul, TotalChowClass.component_apply]
  rcases eq_or_ne p r with rfl | hp
  · rfl
  · rw [hc p hp, smul_zero, smul_zero]

/-- `ch(λ_{-1} E) = ∑_{p ≤ r} (-1)^p ch[⋀^p E]`. -/
theorem ch_lambdaNegOne (E : X.Modules) (r : ℕ) :
    ch C sX (lambdaNegOne E r) = ∑ p ∈ range (r + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ p •
      ch C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower E (p : ℤ))) := by
  rw [lambdaNegOne, map_sum]
  simp only [map_zsmul]

/-- **The Koszul identity, multiplied out**: for `Q` finite locally free of rank `r`,
`ch(λ_{-1} Q^∨) · td(Q) = c_r(Q)`. -/
theorem ch_lambdaNegOne_dualSheaf_mul_toddClass (Q : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    [hQ : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} Q r] :
    ch C sX (lambdaNegOne (dualSheaf Q) r) * toddClass C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X Q) =
      RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass
        (TotalChowClass.homComponent r (totalChern C sX Q r)) := by
  have hQd := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_dualSheaf Q r hQ
  have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} Q :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree Q r
  have key := ch_lambdaNegOne_mul_toddClass C sX (dualSheaf Q) r
  rw [toddClass_classOf_dualSheaf_dualSheaf, totalChern_dualSheaf,
    TotalChowClass.homComponent_signScale,
    signScale_eq_of_isHomogeneous C sX (TotalChowClass.isHomogeneous_homComponent r _), map_zsmul,
    smul_smul, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_smul] at key
  exact key

/-- **The Koszul identity for Chern characters**. Let `Q` be finite locally free of rank `r` on
`X`. Then

  `∑_{p=0}^{r} (-1)^p ch[⋀^p (Q^∨)] = c_r(Q) · td(-[Q])`   in `∏_p A^p(X) ⊗ ℚ`,

i.e. `ch(λ_{-1} Q^∨) = c_r(Q) td(Q)⁻¹`. Here `c_r(Q)` is the degree-`r` homogeneous component
`TotalChowClass.homComponent r (totalChern C sX Q r)` of the total Chern class of `Q` (the
bivariant `c_r` of Stacks 0B7H), viewed in `RationalTotalChowClass C sX` through
`RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass`; `GRR.ch_koszul'` states it with
`totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree C sX Q` instead. -/
theorem ch_koszul (Q : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} Q r] :
    ∑ p ∈ range (r + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ p •
        ch C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower (dualSheaf Q) (p : ℤ))) =
      RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass
          (TotalChowClass.homComponent r (totalChern C sX Q r)) *
        toddClass C sX (-VectorBundleKZero.classOf X Q) := by
  rw [← ch_lambdaNegOne, ← ch_lambdaNegOne_dualSheaf_mul_toddClass, mul_assoc,
    toddClass_mul_toddClass_neg, mul_one]

/-- `GRR.ch_koszul` with the top Chern class read off the total Chern class
`totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree` of Stacks 0ESW. -/
theorem ch_koszul' (Q : X.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} Q r] :
    haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree Q r
    ∑ p ∈ range (r + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ p •
        ch C sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (Scheme.Modules.exteriorPower (dualSheaf Q) (p : ℤ))) =
      RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass
          (TotalChowClass.homComponent r (totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree C sX Q)) *
        toddClass C sX (-VectorBundleKZero.classOf X Q) := by
  have := AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree Q r
  rw [totalChernOfFiniteLocallyFree_eq_totalChern C sX Q r]
  exact ch_koszul C sX Q r

end Chow

end GRR

/-!
# Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch: what is proved, and what remains

* `GRR.riemannRochFor_projectiveSpaceOver`: the Riemann–Roch formula for every projection
  `ℙⁿ_Y ⟶ Y`, `Y` smooth, separated and of finite type over a field — unconditional.
* `GRR.hirzebruch_riemann_roch_projectiveSpace`: Hirzebruch–Riemann–Roch on `ℙⁿ_k` — unconditional.
* `GRR.grothendieck_riemann_roch_of_closedImmersionFormula`: the Riemann–Roch formula for every
  projective morphism, assuming only the formula without tangent bundles
  (`GRR.ClosedImmersionFormula`) for closed immersions; this is a reduction, not the theorem.
* `GRR.hirzebruch_riemann_roch_of_closedImmersionFormula`: Hirzebruch–Riemann–Roch for a smooth
  projective `X`, under the same assumption.
* `GRR.isFiniteLocallyFree_tangentSheaf`: the tangent sheaf of a smooth scheme is finite locally
  free, so that `GRR.tangentClass` is its class.
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Stacks.Chow

universe u

namespace GRR

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]

/-- The tangent sheaf of a smooth scheme over `k` is finite locally free. -/
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_tangentSheaf {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsSmoothFT k sX] :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R := X.ringCatSheaf)
      (tangentSheaf k sX) := by
  have := Scheme.Hom.isFiniteLocallyFree_relativeDifferentials sX
  unfold tangentSheaf
  infer_instance

/-- The Riemann–Roch formula only depends on the morphism. -/
theorem RiemannRochFor.congr {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sY] {f g : X ⟶ Y} [IsProper f]
    [IsProper g] (h : f = g) (hf : f ≫ sY = sX) (hg : g ≫ sY = sX)
    (H : RiemannRochFor k sX sY f hf) : RiemannRochFor k sX sY g hg := by
  subst h
  exact H

/-- **Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch for the projections `ℙⁿ_Y ⟶ Y`**: for `Y` smooth, separated and
of finite type over `k` and every `α ∈ K'₀(ℙⁿ_Y)`,
`π_* ((ch(α) · td(T_{ℙⁿ_Y})) ∩ [ℙⁿ_Y]) = (ch(π_! α) · td(T_Y)) ∩ [Y]`. -/
theorem riemannRochFor_projectiveSpaceOver {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsSmoothFT k sY] (n : ℕ) :
    RiemannRochFor k ((projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) ≫ sY) sY (projectiveSpaceOver n Y ↘ Y) rfl :=
  riemannRochFor_projection_of k sY n (projectionPushforwardFormula k sY n)
    (projectionGeneration k sY n) (projectionTauFormula k sY n)

/-- **Grothendieck–Riemann–Roch for projective morphisms, assuming the formula without tangent
bundles for closed immersions.** This is a reduction: its hypothesis `hE` is not proved. -/
theorem grothendieck_riemann_roch_of_closedImmersionFormula
    (hE : ∀ {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX]
      [IsSmoothFT k sP] (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ sP = sX),
      ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX]
    [IsSmoothFT k sY] (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (hf : f ≫ sY = sX)
    (hproj : IsProjectiveMorphism f) :
    RiemannRochFor k sX sY f hf :=
  grothendieck_riemann_roch_of k hE (fun sY _ n ↦ projectionPushforwardFormula k sY n)
    (fun sY _ n ↦ projectionGeneration k sY n) (fun sY _ n ↦ projectionTauFormula k sY n)
    sX sY f hf hproj

/-- **Hirzebruch–Riemann–Roch on projective space** `ℙⁿ_k`: for every `α ∈ K'₀(ℙⁿ_k)`, the
pushforward to the point of `(ch(α) · td(T_{ℙⁿ_k})) ∩ [ℙⁿ_k]` is `χ(ℙⁿ_k, α) · [Spec k]`. -/
theorem hirzebruch_riemann_roch_projectiveSpace (n : ℕ)
    (α : CoherentKZero (projectiveSpaceOver n (Spec (.of k)))) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        ((projectiveSpaceOver n (Spec (.of k)) ↘ Spec (.of k)) ≫ 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
        (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) (Category.comp_id _)
        (tau k ((projectiveSpaceOver n (Spec (.of k)) ↘ Spec (.of k)) ≫ 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) α) =
      ((eulerK k ((projectiveSpaceOver n (Spec (.of k)) ↘ Spec (.of k)) ≫ 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) α :
        ℤ) : ℚ) • fundamentalClass k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) :=
  hirzebruch_riemann_roch_of k _
    (RiemannRochFor.congr k _ _ (Category.comp_id _).symm rfl (Category.comp_id _)
      (riemannRochFor_projectiveSpaceOver k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) n)) α

/-- **Hirzebruch–Riemann–Roch for a smooth projective scheme, assuming the formula without
tangent bundles for closed immersions.** This is a reduction: `hE` is not proved. -/
theorem hirzebruch_riemann_roch_of_closedImmersionFormula
    (hE : ∀ {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX]
      [IsSmoothFT k sP] (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ sP = sX),
      ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsProper sX]
    (hproj : IsProjectiveMorphism sX) (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX (𝟙 (Spec (.of k)))
        (Category.comp_id sX) (tau k sX α) =
      ((eulerK k sX α : ℤ) : ℚ) • fundamentalClass k (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) :=
  hirzebruch_riemann_roch_of k sX
    (grothendieck_riemann_roch_of_closedImmersionFormula k hE sX (𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) sX
      (Category.comp_id sX) hproj) α

end GRR

import Mathlib
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.RationalIntersection.ChernCharacterFundamentalClass
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ChernClassDerived.DerivedTensor
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ChernClassDerived.PerfectPowerSumChernCharacter
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.ChernClassDerived.PerfectChernProperties
import StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Chow.LocalizedChern.BabyCaseTensor
import GRR.ClosedImmersion

/-!
# The Chern character of perfect complexes

For `K ∈ D(𝒪_Y)` whose Chern classes are defined (Stacks 0F9E), `GRR.perfectCh C sY hK` is its
Chern character `ch(K) = (P_p(K)/p!)_p ∈ ∏_p A^p(Y) ⊗ ℚ`. It is invariant under isomorphism,
vanishes on zero objects, commutes with pullback (`res_g ch(K) = ch(Lg^*K)`), is `ch(M)` on a
finite locally free `M[0]`, and is multiplicative on derived tensor products (Stacks 0FAG).

**The bridge** `GRR.chK_mk_eq_perfectCh`: on a smooth `Y` over a field, `chK [F] = ch(F[0])` for
a coherent `F` (Remark 0FEU). `GRR.closedImmersionFormula_of_bundles` reduces
`GRR.ClosedImmersionFormula` to the classes of finite locally free modules.
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory Stacks.Chow
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u

namespace GRR

attribute [local instance 10000] HasDerivedCategory.standard

section Perfect

variable (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY]

/-- **The Chern character of a perfect complex** `K ∈ D(𝒪_Y)` whose Chern classes are defined
(Stacks 0F9E (2)): `ch(K) = (P_p(K)/p!)_{p ≥ 0} ∈ ∏_p A^p(Y) ⊗ ℚ`. -/
noncomputable def perfectCh {K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K) :
    RationalTotalChowClass C sY :=
  RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily (perfectChernCharacter C sY hK)

/-- `ch_p(K) = P_p(K)/p!`. -/
theorem perfectCh_apply {K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K) (p : ℕ) :
    perfectCh C sY hK p = ((p.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] perfectPowerSum C sY hK p p :=
  rfl

/-- **`ch(K)` depends only on the isomorphism class of `K`**: `K ≅ K'` gives `ch(K) = ch(K')`. -/
theorem perfectCh_congr {K K' : DerivedCategory Y.Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
    (hK' : HasDefinedChernClasses K') (e : K ≅ K') : perfectCh C sY hK = perfectCh C sY hK' :=
  RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ by
    rw [perfectCh_apply, perfectCh_apply, perfectPowerSum_congr C sY hK hK' e p]

/-- **`ch(0) = 0`**: the Chern character of a zero object vanishes. -/
theorem perfectCh_eq_zero {K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
    (h0 : Limits.IsZero K) : perfectCh C sY hK = 0 :=
  RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ by
    rw [perfectCh_apply, perfectPowerSum_of_isZero C sY hK h0 p, TotalChowClass.zero_apply,
      TensorProduct.tmul_zero, RationalTotalChowClass.zero_apply]

/-- **The Chern character commutes with pullback**: for `g : Y' ⟶ Y` locally of finite type,
`g^* ch(K) = ch(Lg^* K)`. -/
theorem pullbackAQ_perfectCh {Y' : Scheme.{u}} (sY' : Y' ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (hs : g ≫ sY = sY') {K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules}
    (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K) :
    pullbackAQ C sY' sY g hs (perfectCh C sY hK) = perfectCh C sY' (hK.derivedPullback g) :=
  RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ by
    rw [perfectCh_apply C sY' (hK.derivedPullback g) p,
      ← res_perfectPowerSum_derivedPullback C sY hK g hs (hK.derivedPullback g) p,
      TotalChowClass.res_apply_eq_chowCohomologyRestrictionOfEq]
    rfl

/-- `g^* ch(K) = ch(K')` for any `K' ≅ Lg^* K` whose Chern classes are defined. -/
theorem pullbackAQ_perfectCh_of_iso {Y' : Scheme.{u}} (sY' : Y' ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (hs : g ≫ sY = sY') {K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules}
    (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K) {K' : DerivedCategory Y'.Modules}
    (hK' : HasDefinedChernClasses K')
    (e : (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      g.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj K ≅ K') :
    pullbackAQ C sY' sY g hs (perfectCh C sY hK) = perfectCh C sY' hK' :=
  (pullbackAQ_perfectCh C sY sY' g hs hK).trans (perfectCh_congr C sY' _ hK' e)

/-- **`ch(M[0]) = ch(M)`** for a finite locally free module `M` placed in degree zero: the
Chern character of a perfect complex `K ≅ M[0]` is the Chern character of `[M] ∈ K₀(Vect Y)`. -/
theorem perfectCh_single {K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
    (M : Y.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} M]
    (e : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj M) :
    perfectCh C sY hK = ch C sY (VectorBundleKZero.classOf Y M) :=
  RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ by
    rw [perfectCh_apply, ch_apply, chernCharacterVectorBundle_classOf,
      perfectPowerSum_eq_powerSumOfFiniteLocallyFree C sY hK M e p]
    rfl

/-- **Remark 0FEU**: if `K ≅ E` for a bounded complex `E` of finite locally free modules, then
`ch(K) = ch(∑_n (-1)^n [E^n])`, the Chern character of the Euler characteristic of `E` in
`K₀(Vect Y)`. -/
theorem perfectCh_eq_ch_eulerCharComplex {K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules}
    (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K) {E : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ}
    (hE : Stacks.Perfect.BoundedLocallyFreeComplexes.boundedFiniteLocallyFreeComplex Y E)
    (e : K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj E) :
    perfectCh C sY hK =
      ch C sY (Stacks.Perfect.BoundedLocallyFreeComplexes.eulerCharComplex Y E) :=
  RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun p ↦ by
    rw [ch_apply, chernCharacterVectorBundle_apply, perfectCh_apply,
      perfectPowerSum_eq_powerSumKHom_eulerCharComplex C sY hK hE e.symm p]

end Perfect

namespace PerfectCh

/-- The components of an integer multiple of a total class. -/
theorem totalChowClass_zsmul_apply {C : ChowSituation.{u}} {Y : Scheme.{u}} {sY : Y ⟶ C.S}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (n : ℤ) (c : TotalChowClass C sY) (p : ℕ) :
    (n • c) p = n • c p :=
  rfl

/-- The lift `∑_{p ≤ m} P_p(K)/p!` of `ch(K)` below degree `m` has the components of `ch(K)` in
degrees at most `m`. -/
theorem rationalComponent_sum_perfectPowerSum (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] {K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules}
    (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K) (m : ℕ) {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ m) :
    RationalTotalChowClass.rationalComponent j
        (∑ p ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
          ((p.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] perfectPowerSum C sY hK p) =
      perfectCh C sY hK j := by
  rw [map_sum, perfectCh_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single j]
  · rfl
  · intro p _ hp
    rw [RationalTotalChowClass.rationalComponent_tmul,
      isHomogeneous_perfectPowerSum C sY hK p j (Ne.symm hp), TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  · intro hj'
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hj)) hj'

/-- `C(a + b, a) / (a + b)! = 1 / (a! b!)`. -/
theorem choose_div_factorial (a b : ℕ) :
    (((a + b).choose a : ℤ) : ℚ) * ((a + b).factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ =
      (a.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ * (b.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹ := by
  have h := Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (Nat.le_add_right a b)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at h
  have hc : (((a + b).choose a : ℕ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.choose_pos (Nat.le_add_right a b)).ne'
  have ha : (a.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast a.factorial_ne_zero
  have hb : (b.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast b.factorial_ne_zero
  rw [Int.cast_natCast, ← h, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, mul_inv, mul_inv, mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hc]

end PerfectCh

open PerfectCh in
/-- **The Chern character is multiplicative on derived tensor products** (Stacks 0FAG):
`ch(E ⊗^L F) = ch(E) · ch(F)` for `E`, `F ∈ D(𝒪_Y)` whose Chern classes are defined. -/
theorem perfectCh_derivedTensor (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] {E F : DerivedCategory Y.Modules} (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E)
    (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F)
    (hEF : HasDefinedChernClasses
      (((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor Y.sheaf).obj E).obj F)) :
    perfectCh C sY hEF = perfectCh C sY hE * perfectCh C sY hF := by
  refine RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun m ↦ ?_
  -- `rw` cannot see through the type of `hEF`, so the left side is unfolded by hand
  refine ((perfectCh_apply C sY hEF m).trans
    (congrArg (fun x : TotalChowClass C sY ↦ ((m.factorial : ℚ)⁻¹) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] x m)
      (perfectPowerSum_derivedTensor C sY hE hF hEF m))).trans ?_
  rw [RationalTotalChowClass.mul_apply_eq
      (fun j hj ↦ rationalComponent_sum_perfectPowerSum C sY hE m hj)
      (fun j hj ↦ rationalComponent_sum_perfectPowerSum C sY hF m hj), Finset.sum_mul, map_sum,
    TotalChowClass.sum_apply, TensorProduct.tmul_sum,
    Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha ↦ ?_
  have ham : a ≤ m := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp ha)
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single (m - a)]
  · rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, RationalTotalChowClass.rationalComponent_tmul,
      totalChowClass_zsmul_apply, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, zsmul_eq_mul]
    congr 1
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le ham
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact choose_div_factorial a b
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, RationalTotalChowClass.rationalComponent_tmul,
      ((isHomogeneous_perfectPowerSum C sY hE a).mul (isHomogeneous_perfectPowerSum C sY hF b)) m
        (by omega), TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) h

/-- `ch(K) = ch(E) · ch(F)` for any `K ≅ E ⊗^L F` whose Chern classes are defined. -/
theorem perfectCh_derivedTensor_of_iso (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] {E F K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules} (hE : HasDefinedChernClasses E)
    (hF : HasDefinedChernClasses F) (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
    (e : K ≅ ((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor Y.sheaf).obj E).obj F) :
    perfectCh C sY hK = perfectCh C sY hE * perfectCh C sY hF :=
  (perfectCh_congr C sY hK (hasDefinedChernClasses_derivedTensor hE hF) e).trans
    (perfectCh_derivedTensor C sY hE hF _)

/-- **The Chern classes of a coherent module placed in degree zero are defined**: on a smooth
`Y` over a field, `F[0]` is perfect (Stacks 0F8F) and `Y` is quasi-compact. -/
theorem hasDefinedChernClasses_single_coherent
    (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules Y.ringCatSheaf) :
    HasDefinedChernClasses ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj F.obj) := by
  have := compactSpace k sY
  have := isAffineHom_diagonal k sY
  obtain ⟨K₀, -, ⟨eK⟩, -, -, -⟩ :=
    exists_regularVectorBundleKZeroAddEquiv_symm_mk Y (isRegular k sY) F
  exact hasDefinedChernClasses_of_iso
    (hasDefinedChernClasses_of_compactSpace (fieldChowSituation k) sY K₀.obj K₀.property) eK

include k sY in
/-- **Every coherent module is a perfect complex with defined Chern classes**: on a smooth `Y`
over a field, a coherent `F` gives `K ≅ F[0]` with the Chern classes of `K` defined. -/
theorem exists_perfect_of_coherent (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules Y.ringCatSheaf) :
    ∃ (K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules) (_ : HasDefinedChernClasses K),
      Nonempty (K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj F.obj) :=
  ⟨_, hasDefinedChernClasses_single_coherent k sY F, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩

/-- **The bridge between `chK` and the Chern character of perfect complexes** (Remark 0FEU):
on a smooth `Y` over a field, `ch([F]) = ch(F[0])` for a coherent `F`, where the left side is
`GRR.chK` of the class of `F` in `K'₀(Y)` and the right side is the Chern character of any
`K ≅ F[0]` whose Chern classes are defined. -/
theorem chK_mk_eq_perfectCh (F : Stacks.SheafOfModules.CoherentModules Y.ringCatSheaf)
    {K : DerivedCategory Y.Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
    (e : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor Y.Modules 0).obj F.obj) :
    chK k sY (KZero.mk _ F) = perfectCh (fieldChowSituation k) sY hK := by
  have := compactSpace k sY
  have := isAffineHom_diagonal k sY
  obtain ⟨K₀, E, ⟨eK⟩, hE, ⟨eE⟩, hθ⟩ :=
    exists_regularVectorBundleKZeroAddEquiv_symm_mk Y (isRegular k sY) F
  have hθ' : (vectorBundleEquiv k sY).symm (KZero.mk _ F) =
      Stacks.Perfect.BoundedLocallyFreeComplexes.eulerCharComplex Y E := hθ
  rw [chK_eq_ch, hθ', perfectCh_eq_ch_eulerCharComplex (fieldChowSituation k) sY hK hE
    (e ≪≫ eK.symm ≪≫ eE.symm)]

/-- `ch(θ a) = ch(a)` for `a ∈ K₀(Vect Y)`, `θ : K₀(Vect Y) ≅ K'₀(Y)`. -/
theorem chK_vectorBundleEquiv (a : VectorBundleKZero Y) :
    chK k sY (vectorBundleEquiv k sY a) = ch (fieldChowSituation k) sY a := by
  rw [chK_eq_ch, AddEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

/-- **`ch(i_! θ[E]) = ch((i_*E)[0])`** for a closed immersion `i : X ⟶ P` of smooth schemes over
`k` and a finite locally free `E` on `X`: the left side of `GRR.ClosedImmersionFormula` at
`θ[E]` is the Chern character of any `K ≅ (i_*E)[0]` whose Chern classes are defined. -/
theorem chK_pushforwardK_classOf_eq_perfectCh {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP] (i : X ⟶ P)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (E : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E]
    {K : DerivedCategory P.Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
    (e : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor P.Modules 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E)) :
    haveI := compactSpace k sP
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
    chK k sP (pushforwardK i (vectorBundleEquiv k sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E))) =
      perfectCh (fieldChowSituation k) sP hK := by
  have := compactSpace k sP
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  obtain ⟨hcoh, hθ⟩ := vectorBundleEquiv_classOf k sX E
    (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree E)
  rw [hθ, pushforwardK_mk_of_isClosedImmersion]
  exact chK_mk_eq_perfectCh k sP _ hK e

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
  (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP]
  (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ sP = sX)

/-- **Reduction of `ClosedImmersionFormula` to vector bundles.** If for every finite locally free
`E` on `X`

  `ch(i_! θ[E]) ∩ [P] = i_* ((ch(E) · td(N_{X/P})⁻¹) ∩ [X])`,

`θ : K₀(Vect X) ≅ K'₀(X)`, then the formula holds for every `α ∈ K'₀(X)`: both sides are additive
in `α` and `θ` is onto. -/
theorem closedImmersionFormula_of_bundles
    (h : ∀ (E : X.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E],
      haveI := compactSpace k sP
      haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
      cap k sP (chK k sP (pushforwardK i (vectorBundleEquiv k sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E))))
          (fundamentalClass k sP) =
        rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi
          (cap k sX (ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) *
              toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i))
            (fundamentalClass k sX))) :
    ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi := by
  have := compactSpace k sP
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  let φ : VectorBundleKZero X →+ CHQ k sP :=
    (capFundamental k sP).comp ((chK k sP).comp ((pushforwardK i).comp
      (vectorBundleEquiv k sX).toAddMonoidHom))
  let ψ : VectorBundleKZero X →+ CHQ k sP :=
    (rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi).toAddMonoidHom.comp
      ((capFundamental k sX).comp
        ((AddMonoidHom.mulRight (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i))).comp
          (ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX).toAddMonoidHom))
  have hφψ : φ = ψ := VectorBundleKZero.addHom_ext fun M hM ↦ by
    have := Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_finiteLocallyFree M (hM := hM)
    exact h M
  intro α
  have hα := DFunLike.congr_fun hφψ ((vectorBundleEquiv k sX).symm α)
  simp only [φ, ψ, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom,
    AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply, capFundamental_apply, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe,
    AddMonoidHom.mulRight_apply, RingHom.toAddMonoidHom_eq_coe, AddMonoidHom.coe_ofClass] at hα
  rw [chK_eq_ch k sX]
  exact hα

end Bundles

the section at zero (`sectionAtZero`), `e : E ⟶ W` and `a : X' ⟶ W` the exceptional divisor and
the strict transform (`exceptionalInclusion`, `strictTransformInclusion`), `i' : 𝐏¹_X ⟶ W` the
closed immersion of Stacks 0FE9, `pr : 𝐏¹_X ⟶ X` (`lineProj`) and `Q = (i'_*(pr^*E))[0]` (`Q`).
This file proves items C0, C2–C5 of `notes/E_plan.md`: `GRR.isSmoothFT_blowupAtInfinity`,

/-- The two spellings of the pullback of modules along a morphism of schemes agree: both are left
adjoint to the pushforward. -/
noncomputable def modulePullbackIsoPullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom ≅ Scheme.Modules.pullback f :=
  Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq
    (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullbackPushforwardAdjunction f.toLRSHom.toShHom)
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)

/-- Pulling back along `g` a module pulled back along `p`, when `g ≫ p = 𝟙`, gives the module
back. -/
noncomputable def pullbackPullbackIsoOfCompEqId {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : X ⟶ Y} {p : Y ⟶ X}
    (h : g ≫ p = 𝟙 X) (E : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj E) ≅ E :=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g p).app E ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr h).app E ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackId X).app E

/-- **`j_*G` restricts to zero off its support**: for a closed immersion `j : P ⟶ W`, a module
`G` on `P` and `k : V ⟶ W` whose image misses that of `j`, `Lk^*((j_*G)[0]) = 0`. -/
theorem isZero_derivedPullback_singlePushforward_of_disjoint {W P V : Scheme.{u}} (j : P ⟶ W)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (k : V ⟶ W) (G : P.Modules)
    (hk : Disjoint (Set.range k.base) (Set.range j.base)) :
    IsZero ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      k.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor W.Modules 0).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj G))) := by
  let U : W.Opens := ⟨(Set.range j.base)ᶜ, j.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩
  have hU : IsZero ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      U.ι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor W.Modules 0).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj G))) := by
    refine isZero_derivedPullback_ofRestrict_compl _ _ j.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range ?_ _
      (Iso.refl _)
    intro x hx
    by_contra hrange
    have := subsingleton_stalk_pushforward_of_notMemRange' j G x hrange
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hx
    exact ha (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  exact isZero_derivedPullback_of_factors (IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac U.ι k (by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact fun _ hx => Set.disjoint_left.1 hk hx)) hU

end DeformationGeom

/-! ### C2: Tor-independent base change of a flat module -/

/-- **Tor-independent base change of a pushed-forward flat module** (Stacks 0E23). For a
cartesian square
```
Z' --i'--> X'
|g          |f
Z  --j---> X
```
with `j` a closed immersion, `Z` and `X'` Tor independent over `X`, and `G` a flat module on
`Z`, `Lf^*((j_*G)[0]) ≅ (i'_*(g^*G))[0]`. -/
noncomputable def derivedPullbackSinglePushforwardIsoOfTorIndependent {Z' X' Z X : Scheme.{u}}
    {i' : Z' ⟶ X'} {g : Z' ⟶ Z} {f : X' ⟶ X} {j : Z ⟶ X} (sq : IsPullback i' g f j)
    [IsClosedImmersion j] (h : TorIndependent j f) (G : Z.Modules)
    (hG : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (O := Z.sheaf) G) :
    (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor X.Modules 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward j).obj G)) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor X'.Modules 0).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj G)) := by
  haveI : IsClosedImmersion i' := MorphismProperty.of_isPullback sq.flip inferInstance
  have hiso := derivedBaseChangeIsoOfTorIndependent sq inferInstance h
    ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor Z.Modules 0).obj G)
  exact (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        f.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapIso
      (Stacks.Thickenings.derivedPushforwardSingleIso j.toLRSHom.toShHom
        j.isClosedEmbedding _).symm ≪≫
    @asIso _ _ _ _ _ hiso ≪≫
    (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPushforward
        i'.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapIso
      (Stacks.Cohomology.FlatSingleDerivedPullback.derivedPullbackSingleIso g.toLRSHom.toShHom
          G hG ≪≫
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso
          ((DeformationGeom.modulePullbackIsoPullback g).app G)) ≪≫
    Stacks.Thickenings.derivedPushforwardSingleIso i'.toLRSHom.toShHom i'.isClosedEmbedding _

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (i : X ⟶ P)

/-- The structure morphism `q : W ⟶ P` of the blowup at infinity `W = Bl_{∞(X)} 𝐏¹_P`. -/
abbrev proj : blowupAtInfinity i.ker ⟶ P :=
  modificationProjection sP (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)

/-- The section at zero `i₀ : P ⟶ W`, the inclusion of the fibre `W_0 ≅ P` over `0 ∈ 𝐏¹`. -/
abbrev sectionAtZero : P ⟶ blowupAtInfinity i.ker :=
  modificationSectionAtZero sP (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)
    (isIso_modificationFibreAtZeroProjection sP _
      (isIso_pullback_snd_blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP))

/-- `i₀` is a section of `q`. -/
theorem sectionAtZero_comp_proj : sectionAtZero sP i ≫ proj sP i = 𝟙 P :=
  modificationSectionAtZero_comp_projection sP _
    (isIso_pullback_snd_blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)

/-- `i₀` is a section of `q`, composed with a further morphism. -/
theorem sectionAtZero_comp_proj_assoc {Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : P ⟶ Z) :
    sectionAtZero sP i ≫ proj sP i ≫ h = h := by
  rw [← Category.assoc, sectionAtZero_comp_proj, Category.id_comp]

/-- `i₀` is a section of `W ⟶ P`, in the simp-normal form `q = blowupAtInfinityToBase`. -/
@[simp]
theorem sectionAtZero_comp_blowupAtInfinityToBase :
    sectionAtZero sP i ≫ blowupAtInfinityToBase i.ker = 𝟙 P := by
  rw [← modificationProjection_blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP]
  exact sectionAtZero_comp_proj sP i

/-- `i₀` is a section of `W ⟶ P`, composed with a further morphism. -/
@[simp]
theorem sectionAtZero_comp_blowupAtInfinityToBase_assoc {Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : P ⟶ Z) :
    sectionAtZero sP i ≫ blowupAtInfinityToBase i.ker ≫ h = h := by
  rw [← Category.assoc, sectionAtZero_comp_blowupAtInfinityToBase, Category.id_comp]

/-- The section at zero is a closed immersion: it is the base change of the zero section of
`𝐏¹_P`. -/
instance isClosedImmersion_sectionAtZero : IsClosedImmersion (sectionAtZero sP i) :=
  MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (P := @IsClosedImmersion)
    (isPullback_modificationSectionAtZero sP _
      (isIso_pullback_snd_blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)).flip inferInstance

/-- The inclusion `e : E ⟶ W` of the exceptional divisor, read as `E = W_∞ ×_P X`. -/
abbrev exceptionalInclusion :
    pullback (modificationProjectionAtInfinity sP
      (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)) i ⟶ blowupAtInfinity i.ker :=
  pullback.fst (modificationProjectionAtInfinity sP
      (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)) i ≫
    modificationInclusionAtInfinity sP (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)

/-- The exceptional divisor lies over `X`: `e ≫ q = (E ⟶ X) ≫ i`. -/
theorem exceptionalInclusion_comp_proj :
    exceptionalInclusion sP i ≫ proj sP i =
      pullback.snd (modificationProjectionAtInfinity sP
        (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)) i ≫ i := by
  rw [exceptionalInclusion, Category.assoc, ← pullback.condition]

/-- The exceptional divisor lies over `X`, composed with a further morphism. -/
theorem exceptionalInclusion_comp_proj_assoc {Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : P ⟶ Z) :
    exceptionalInclusion sP i ≫ proj sP i ≫ h =
      pullback.snd (modificationProjectionAtInfinity sP
        (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)) i ≫ i ≫ h := by
  rw [← Category.assoc, exceptionalInclusion_comp_proj, Category.assoc]

/-- The inclusion `a : X' ⟶ W` of the strict transform `X'` of `P` (inside `W_∞`). -/
abbrev strictTransformInclusion :
    (strictTransformIdealAtInfinity i.ker).subscheme ⟶ blowupAtInfinity i.ker :=
  strictTransformToFibreAtInfinity sP i ≫
    modificationInclusionAtInfinity sP (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)

variable [IsClosedImmersion i]

/-- The projection `pr : 𝐏¹_X ⟶ X`, with `X` read as the closed subscheme `V(ker i)`. -/
abbrev lineProj : relativeProjectiveLine i.ker.subscheme ⟶ X :=
  (relativeProjectiveLine i.ker.subscheme ↘ i.ker.subscheme) ≫ inv i.toImage

/-- `G = pr^*E` on `𝐏¹_X`. -/
abbrev G (E : X.Modules) : (relativeProjectiveLine i.ker.subscheme).Modules :=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullback (lineProj i)).obj E

/-- **The object `Q = (i'_*(pr^*E))[0]` of `D(𝒪_W)`**, the deformation of `i_*E` to the normal
cone: `i' : 𝐏¹_X ⟶ W` is the closed immersion of Stacks 0FE9 and `pr : 𝐏¹_X ⟶ X`. -/
abbrev Q (E : X.Modules) : DerivedCategory (blowupAtInfinity i.ker).Modules :=
  (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (blowupAtInfinity i.ker).Modules 0).obj
    ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker)).obj (G i E))

/-- `pr` restricted to the infinity section `X ⟶ 𝐏¹_X` is the identity. -/
theorem lineInfinitySection_comp_lineProj :
    (i.toImage ≫ lineInfinitySection i.ker.subscheme) ≫ lineProj i = 𝟙 X := by
  rw [lineProj, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (lineInfinitySection _), lineInfinitySection_comp,
    Category.id_comp, IsIso.hom_inv_id]

/-- The module `i'_*(pr^*E)` underlying `Q` is coherent when `E` is finite locally free and `P`
is locally Noetherian: `Q` is a coherent module placed in degree `0`. -/
theorem coherentModules_pushforward_G [IsLocallyNoetherian P] (E : X.Modules)
    [hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.coherentModules (blowupAtInfinity i.ker).ringCatSheaf
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker)).obj (G i E)) := by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian (blowupAtInfinity i.ker) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (blowupAtInfinityToBase i.ker)
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian (relativeProjectiveLine i.ker.subscheme) :=
    isLocallyNoetherian_of_isClosedImmersion (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker)
  have h1 := isCoherent_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isLocallyNoetherian (G i E)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.pullback_scheme _ _ hE)
  have h2 := (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckGroupAffine.isCoherent_iff_isCoherent' _).1 h1
  exact (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckGroupAffine.isCoherent_iff_isCoherent' _).2
    (isCoherent_pushforward_of_isClosedImmersion (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker) (G i E))

/-- The open immersion `c : b⁻¹(𝐀¹_P) ⟶ W` of the part of `W` over the affine chart of `𝐏¹_P`. -/
abbrev chartι :
    pullback (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP) (projectiveLineAffineChart sP) ⟶
      blowupAtInfinity i.ker :=
  pullback.fst (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP) (projectiveLineAffineChart sP)

/-- **`Q` on the chart `b⁻¹(𝐀¹_P)`**: the restriction of `Q` to the open `b⁻¹(𝐀¹_P) ⊆ W` is the
derived pullback of `(i_*E)[0]` along the flat morphism `b⁻¹(𝐀¹_P) ⟶ P`. Both are the pushforward
of the pullback of `E` to `𝐏¹_X ∩ b⁻¹(𝐀¹_P) = X ×_P b⁻¹(𝐀¹_P)` (flat base change). -/
def chartIso (E : X.Modules) :
    (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (chartι sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (Q i E) ≅
      (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor P.Modules 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E)) := by
  have sq := isPullback_lineToBlowupAtInfinity_affineChart sP i
  have sqc := (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker) (chartι sP i)).flip
  have : Flat (chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i) := flat_affineChartRestriction_blowupAtInfinity sP i
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback
      (chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom) :=
    preservesFiniteLimits_pullback_of_flat (chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i)
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback
      (chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom) :=
    RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.preservesFiniteColimits_modulePullback _
  letI : (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback
      (chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom).PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomologyOfExact _
  letI : PreservesFiniteLimits (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback
      (chartι sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom) :=
    preservesFiniteLimits_pullback_of_flat (chartι sP i)
  letI : PreservesFiniteColimits (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback
      (chartι sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom) :=
    RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.preservesFiniteColimits_modulePullback _
  letI : (RingedSpaceModuleAdjunction.modulePullback
      (chartι sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom).PreservesHomology :=
    Functor.preservesHomologyOfExact _
  refine derivedPullbackSingleIsoOfPreservesHomology (chartι sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker)).obj (G i E)) ≪≫
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso ((modulePullbackIsoPullback (chartι sP i)).app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker)).obj (G i E))) ≪≫ ?_
  refine ?_ ≪≫ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso
      ((modulePullbackIsoPullback (chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i)).app
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E)).symm ≪≫
    (derivedPullbackSingleIsoOfPreservesHomology (chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E)).symm
  refine (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso ?_
  refine (baseChangeIsoOfKernelAnnihilates sqc.w
      (kernelAnnihilatesPullbackPushforward_of_isPullback sqc)).app (G i E) ≪≫ ?_
  refine ?_ ≪≫ ((baseChangeIsoOfKernelAnnihilates sq.w.symm
      (kernelAnnihilatesPullbackPushforward_of_isPullback sq.flip)).app E).symm
  exact (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker)
      (chartι sP i))).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp
        (pullback.fst (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker) (chartι sP i)) (lineProj i)).app E)

end DeformationGeom

open DeformationGeom

/-! ### C0: the deformation space is smooth -/

/-- **`W` is smooth, separated and of finite type over `k`** (item C0): for a closed immersion
`i : X ⟶ P` of schemes smooth, separated and of finite type over `k`, the blowup
`W = Bl_{∞(X)} 𝐏¹_P` with its morphism `q ≫ sP : W ⟶ P ⟶ Spec k` is again one. `W` is the blowup
of `𝐏¹_P` (smooth over `k`) in the closed subscheme `∞(X) ≅ X` (smooth over `k`), hence smooth by
Stacks 0FUT; `q` is proper. -/
theorem isSmoothFT_blowupAtInfinity (k : Type u) [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}}
    (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP]
    (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ sP = sX) :
    IsSmoothFT k (proj sP i ≫ sP) := by
  have : IsNoetherian P := isNoetherian k sP
  refine ⟨?_, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
  have : Smooth ((i ≫ lineInfinitySection P) ≫ (relativeProjectiveLine P ↘ P) ≫ sP) := by
    rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (lineInfinitySection P), lineInfinitySection_comp,
      Category.id_comp, hi]
    infer_instance
  have h := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.smooth_blowUpToBase_comp
    ((relativeProjectiveLine P ↘ P) ≫ sP) (i ≫ lineInfinitySection P)
  have hker : (i ≫ lineInfinitySection P).ker = infinityCentreIdeal i.ker :=
    Scheme.Hom.ker_comp _ _
  rw [hker] at h
  rw [proj, modificationProjection_blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct, blowupAtInfinityToBase,
    Category.assoc]
  exact h

/-- A closed immersion of schemes smooth over `k` is a regular immersion (the hypothesis `hreg`
of `GRR.deformationExceptionalFibreIso`). -/
theorem DeformationGeom.isRegularImmersion_of_isSmoothFT (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX]
    [IsSmoothFT k sP] (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ sP = sX) :
    Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RegularIdealSheaf.IsRegularImmersion i := by
  have : Smooth (i ≫ sP) := by
    rw [hi]
    infer_instance
  exact Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.isRegularImmersion_of_smooth_of_smooth i sP

/-! ### C3: the zero fibre -/

/-- **`Q` restricted to the zero fibre is `i_*E`** (item C3): `L i₀^* Q ≅ (i_*E)[0]` for the
section at zero `i₀ : P ⟶ W`. The section factors as `σ : P ⟶ b⁻¹(𝐀¹_P)` followed by the open
immersion of the chart, `σ` is a section of the flat `b⁻¹(𝐀¹_P) ⟶ P`, and on the chart `Q` is the
pullback of `(i_*E)[0]` (`GRR.DeformationGeom.chartIso`). No hypothesis on `E` is needed. -/
def deformationZeroFibreIso {k : Type u} [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (E : X.Modules) :
    (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (sectionAtZero sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (Q i E) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor P.Modules 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E) := by
  let σ : P ⟶ pullback (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)
      (projectiveLineAffineChart sP) :=
    modificationSectionAtZeroToChart (C := fieldChowSituation k) (f := sP)
      (isIso_pullback_snd_blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP)
  have hσ : σ ≫ chartι sP i = sectionAtZero sP i := modificationSectionAtZeroToChart_fst _
  have h1 : (sectionAtZero sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom =
      σ.toLRSHom.toShHom ≫ (chartι sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom := by
    rw [← hσ]
    rfl
  have h2 : σ.toLRSHom.toShHom ≫ (chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom = 𝟙 _ := by
    have h : σ ≫ chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i = 𝟙 P := by
      rw [← Category.assoc, hσ, sectionAtZero_comp_proj]
    exact congrArg (fun f : P ⟶ P => f.toLRSHom.toShHom) h
  exact (eqToIso (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPullbackAlongIso.derivedPullback_eq_of_eq h1)).app
      (Q i E) ≪≫
    ((Stacks.DerivedPullback.Composition.derivedPullbackCompIsoCanonical σ.toLRSHom.toShHom
      (chartι sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom).app (Q i E)).symm ≪≫
    (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      σ.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapIso (chartIso sP i E) ≪≫
    (Stacks.DerivedPullback.Composition.derivedPullbackCompIsoCanonical σ.toLRSHom.toShHom
      (chartι sP i ≫ proj sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom).app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor P.Modules 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E)) ≪≫
    (eqToIso (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPullbackAlongIso.derivedPullback_eq_of_eq h2)).app
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor P.Modules 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E)) ≪≫
    (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedPullbackAlongIso.derivedPullbackIdIso _).app
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor P.Modules 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj E))

/-! ### C4: the exceptional divisor -/

/-- **`Q` restricted to the exceptional divisor is the zero section sheaf** (item C4): for
`e : E = W_∞ ×_P X ⟶ W`, `φ : E ≅ P̄ = 𝐏(𝒞 ⊕ 𝒪_X)` (`𝒞` the conormal sheaf), the zero section
`s : 𝐏(𝒪_X) ⟶ P̄` and `ρ : 𝐏(𝒪_X) ⟶ X`, `L e^* Q ≅ Lφ^*((s_*ρ^*E)[0])`. Both sides are the
pushforward of `E` along the vertex `X ⟶ E` of the normal cone: the left by Tor-independent base
change along `e` (Stacks 0FE9), the right by flat base change along `φ`, the vertex being the zero
section under `φ`. The conormal module is assumed of constant rank `r`. -/
def deformationExceptionalFibreIso {k : Type u} [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}}
    (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (hreg : Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.RegularIdealSheaf.IsRegularImmersion i) (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (conormalModule i) r]
    (E : X.Modules) [hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] :
    (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
        (exceptionalInclusion sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (Q i E) ≅
      (Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
          (exceptionalFibreIsoProjectiveCompletion sP i hreg).hom.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.projectiveCompletion
            (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf
              (VirtualNormalBundle.ofIsRegularImmersion i hreg).bundle)).Modules 0).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection
              (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf
                (VirtualNormalBundle.ofIsRegularImmersion i hreg).bundle))).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E))) := by
  have hker := ker_vertex_comp_exceptionalDivisorIsoProjectiveCompletion_hom i hreg r
  let θ := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.KerChart.isoOfKerEq _ _ hker
  have hθ : θ.hom ≫ ((normalConeZeroSection i ≫ normalConeToExceptionalDivisor i) ≫
      (exceptionalDivisorIsoProjectiveCompletion i hreg).hom) =
      Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf
        (VirtualNormalBundle.ofIsRegularImmersion i hreg).bundle) :=
    Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.KerChart.isoOfKerEq_hom_comp _ _ hker
  have sq : IsPullback ((normalConeZeroSection i ≫ normalConeToExceptionalDivisor i) ≫
        (isPullback_exceptionalDivisorToFibreAtInfinity sP i).isoPullback.hom) θ.inv
      (exceptionalFibreIsoProjectiveCompletion sP i hreg).hom
      (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf
        (VirtualNormalBundle.ofIsRegularImmersion i hreg).bundle)) := by
    refine IsPullback.of_vert_isIso ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← hθ, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    simp only [exceptionalFibreIsoProjectiveCompletion, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
      Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  have hρ : θ.inv ≫ bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) = 𝟙 X := by
    rw [← Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj
      (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheaf
        (VirtualNormalBundle.ofIsRegularImmersion i hreg).bundle), ← hθ]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc,
      exceptionalDivisorIsoProjectiveCompletion_hom_projection]
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using vertex_comp_exceptionalDivisorToCentre i
  have hG : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (G i E) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.isFlat_of_isFiniteLocallyFree _
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.pullback_scheme _ _ hE)
  have hρE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u}
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.isFlat_of_isFiniteLocallyFree _
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.pullback_scheme _ _ hE)
  exact derivedPullbackSinglePushforwardIsoOfTorIndependent
      (isPullback_vertex_lineToBlowupAtInfinity sP i)
      (torIndependent_lineToBlowupAtInfinity_exceptionalFibre sP i) _ hG ≪≫
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward _).mapIso
      (pullbackPullbackIsoOfCompEqId (lineInfinitySection_comp_lineProj i) E ≪≫
        (pullbackPullbackIsoOfCompEqId hρ E).symm)) ≪≫
    (derivedPullbackSinglePushforwardIsoOfTorIndependent sq (torIndependent_of_flat_right _ _) _
      hρE).symm

/-! ### C5: the strict transform -/

/-- **`Q` restricted to the strict transform vanishes** (item C5): `L a^* Q = 0` for the inclusion
`a : X' ⟶ W_∞ ⟶ W` of the strict transform of `P`, because `𝐏¹_X` misses `X'` (Stacks 0FE9). -/
theorem isZero_deformationStrictTransform {k : Type u} [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}}
    (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (E : X.Modules) :
    IsZero ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
      (strictTransformInclusion sP i).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (Q i E)) := by
  refine isZero_derivedPullback_singlePushforward_of_disjoint _ _ _ ?_
  rw [strictTransformInclusion, strictTransformToFibreAtInfinity_inclusion,
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι, Set.disjoint_iff]
  rintro _ ⟨hx, y, rfl⟩
  have hy : y ∈ ((strictTransformIdealAtInfinity i.ker).comap
      (lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker)).support := by
    rwa [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap]
  rwa [congrArg Scheme.IdealSheafData.support
    (comap_strictTransformIdealAtInfinity_lineToBlowupAtInfinity i.ker)] at hy

end GRR

/-!
# Specialization of the fundamental class in the deformation to the normal cone (item C6)

For a closed immersion `i : X ⟶ P`, `W` the blowup of `𝐏¹_P` in `∞(X)`, `i₀ : P ⟶ W` the section
at zero, `e : E = W_∞ ×_P X ⟶ W` and `a : X' ⟶ W`: if `P` is pure of dimension `n`, then
`(i₀)_*[P] = e_*[E] + a_*β` in `CH_*(W) ⊗ ℚ` (`GRR.exists_specialization_fundamentalClass`).
Stacks 0F9J gives `(i₀)_*[P]_n = (i_∞)_*[W_∞]_n`; Stacks 02RX on `W_∞ ∖ X' = E ∖ X'` writes
`[W_∞]_n - [E]_n` as a class from `X'`; `E` is pure of dimension `n`, being a Cartier divisor of
`W` whose generic points lie over `𝐀¹_P`.
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Stacks.Chow
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u

namespace GRR.Specialization

section Modification

/-- The section at zero `i₀ : X ⟶ W` of a modification of `X ×_S 𝐏¹_S` is a closed immersion. -/
instance isClosedImmersion_modificationSectionAtZero {X W S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (b : W ⟶ projectiveLineProduct f) (h : IsIso (modificationFibreAtZeroProjection f b)) :
    IsClosedImmersion (modificationSectionAtZero f b h) := by
  unfold modificationSectionAtZero
  infer_instance

variable (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {X W : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
  (b : W ⟶ projectiveLineProduct f) [IsProper b]
  (hA : IsIso (pullback.snd b (projectiveLineAffineChart f)))

omit [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsProper b] in
/-- The section at zero `i₀ : X ⟶ W` lies over the base. -/
theorem sectionAtZero_comp_structure :
    modificationSectionAtZero f b (isIso_modificationFibreAtZeroProjection f b hA) ≫
      modificationProjection f b ≫ f = f := by
  rw [← Category.assoc, modificationSectionAtZero_comp_projection f b hA, Category.id_comp]

/-- **Stacks 0F9J on a fundamental class**: `(i_∞)_*[W_∞]_n = (i₀)_*[X]_n` in `A_n(W)`, when
`dim_δ X ≤ n` and the fibre at infinity is an effective Cartier divisor. -/
theorem inclusionAtInfinity_pushforward_fundamentalChowClass (n : ℤ)
    (hX : schemeDeltaDimension C f ≤ (n : EInt))
    (hcart : Stacks.Divisors.IsEffectiveCartierDivisor
      (modificationInfinityBaseChange f b (𝟙 X)).ker) :
    properChowPushforward C (modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b ≫ modificationProjection f b ≫ f)
        (modificationProjection f b ≫ f) (modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b) rfl n
        (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _)
        (fundamentalChowClass C
          (modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b ≫ modificationProjection f b ≫ f) n) =
      properChowPushforward C f (modificationProjection f b ≫ f)
        (modificationSectionAtZero f b (isIso_modificationFibreAtZeroProjection f b hA))
        (sectionAtZero_comp_structure C f b hA) n (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _)
        (fundamentalChowClass C f n) := by
  have hT : schemeDeltaDimension C (𝟙 X ≫ f) ≤ (n : EInt) :=
    (schemeDeltaDimension_congr C (Category.id_comp f)).trans_le hX
  have h1 := chowPushforward_gysinCapOfLift C f b (𝟙 X) hA n
    (fundamentalChowClass C (𝟙 X ≫ f) n)
  rw [gysinCapOfLift_fundamentalChowClass C f b hA (𝟙 X) n hT hcart] at h1
  unfold chowPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion at h1
  -- transport along the isomorphism `W ×_X X ⟶ W`
  have h2 := congrArg (properChowPushforward C (modificationBaseChangeOver f b (𝟙 X))
    (modificationProjection f b ≫ f) (pullback.fst (modificationProjection f b) (𝟙 X)) rfl n
    (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _)) h1
  have hw : (pullback.fst (modificationProjectionAtInfinity f b) (𝟙 X) ≫
      modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b) ≫ modificationProjection f b ≫ f =
      modificationInfinityBaseChangeOver f b (𝟙 X) := by

        modificationInclusionAtInfinity f b)
      (modificationInfinityBaseChange_comp_fst f b (𝟙 X)) _ _ hw n _ _
