section Localization

variable (C : ChowSituation.{u})

/-- **Stacks 02RX on a fundamental class.** Let `e : E ⟶ V`, `a : Z ⟶ V` be closed immersions and
`m : N ⟶ V` an open immersion onto the complement of `Z` factoring through `E` by an open
immersion. Then `[V]_n = e_*[E]_n + a_*β` for some `β ∈ A_n(Z)`. -/
theorem exists_fundamentalChowClass_eq_add {V E Z N : Scheme.{u}}
    (sV : V ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sV]
    (e : E ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion e] (sE : E ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sE] (he : e ≫ sV = sE)
    (a : Z ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion a] (sZ : Z ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sZ] (ha : a ≫ sV = sZ)
    (m : N ⟶ V) [IsOpenImmersion m] (u : N ⟶ E) [IsOpenImmersion u] (hum : u ≫ e = m)
    (hcompl : Set.range a = (Set.range m)ᶜ) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ β : chowGroup C sZ n,
      fundamentalChowClass C sV n =
        chowPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion C sE sV e he n (fundamentalChowClass C sE n) +
          chowPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion C sZ sV a ha n β := by
  have hexact := exact_chowPushforward_chowGroupRestrict C sV (m ≫ sV) m rfl n sZ a ha hcompl
  have hu : u ≫ sE = m ≫ sV := by rw [← hum, Category.assoc, he]
  have hres : chowGroupRestrict C sV (m ≫ sV) m rfl n
      (fundamentalChowClass C sV n -
        chowPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion C sE sV e he n (fundamentalChowClass C sE n)) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, chowGroupRestrict_fundamentalChowClass_of_isOpenImmersion,
      chowPushforwardOfIsClosedImmersion,
      chowGroupRestrict_properChowPushforward_of_comp_eq C sE sV (m ≫ sV) e he m rfl u hu hum n,
      chowGroupRestrict_fundamentalChowClass_of_isOpenImmersion, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := (hexact _).mp hres
  exact ⟨β, by rw [hβ]; abel⟩

end Localization

section Rational

/-- On a Noetherian scheme all of whose irreducible components have `δ`-dimension `n`, the
rational fundamental class is `1 ⊗ [T]_n`, placed in degree `n`. -/
theorem rationalFundamentalClass_eq_of_deltaDimension (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (sT : T ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sT] [IsNoetherian T] {n : ℤ}
    (hT : ∀ V : irreducibleComponents T, deltaDimension C sT
      ⟨V, V.2.1, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents (V : Set T) V.2⟩ = n) :
    rationalFundamentalClass C sT =
      DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sT j) n
        ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ fundamentalChowClass C sT n) := by
  rw [rationalFundamentalClass_eq]
  by_cases hn : n ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sT).toFinset
  · refine Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem _ hn fun m _ hm => ?_
    rw [fundamentalChowClass_eq_zero_of_deltaDimension_eq C sT hT hm, TensorProduct.tmul_zero,
      map_zero]
  · have h0 : fundamentalChowClass C sT n = 0 := by
      rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_notMem_fundamentalClassDegrees C sT
        fun h => hn ((fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sT).mem_toFinset.2 h), map_zero]
    rw [h0, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m hm => ?_
    rw [fundamentalChowClass_eq_zero_of_deltaDimension_eq C sT hT (fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)),
      TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]

/-- `x + 1 ≤ 1` forces `x = 0` in `ℕ∞`. -/
theorem enat_eq_zero_of_add_one_le_one {x : ℕ∞} (h : x + 1 ≤ 1) : x = 0 := by
  induction x using ENat.recTopCoe with
  | top => simp at h
  | coe m =>
    have h' : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) ≤ ((1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) := by exact_mod_cast h
    have h'' : m + 1 ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast h'
    have hm : m = 0 := by omega
    rw [hm]
    rfl

end Rational

/-- The strict transform `X' ⊆ W_∞` is the complement of the image of the normal cone
`C_X P ⟶ W_∞` (Stacks 0FBH), which is `W_∞ ∖ X' = E ∖ X'`. -/
theorem range_strictTransformToFibreAtInfinity :
    Set.range (strictTransformToFibreAtInfinity f i) =
      (Set.range (normalConeToFibreAtInfinity i f))ᶜ := by
  ext w
  refine ⟨fun hw hm =>
    Set.disjoint_left.mp (disjoint_range_strictTransformToFibreAtInfinity f i) hw hm,
    fun hw => ?_⟩
  have h1 : w ∉ ((normalConeToFibreAtInfinity i f).opensRange : Set _) := by
    rwa [Scheme.Hom.coe_opensRange]
  rw [opensRange_normalConeToFibreAtInfinity] at h1
  have h2 : modificationInclusionAtInfinity f (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker f) w ∈
      ((strictTransformIdealAtInfinity i.ker).support : Set _) := by
    by_contra h
    exact h1 h
  rw [← Scheme.IdealSheafData.range_subschemeι] at h2
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h2
  refine ⟨y, (modificationInclusionAtInfinity f
    (blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker f)).isClosedEmbedding.injective ?_⟩
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, strictTransformToFibreAtInfinity_inclusion, hy]

end Range

/-- **The generic points of `W` have `δ = n + 1`** when every irreducible component of `P` has
`δ = n`: they lie over `𝐀¹_P`, which is flat of relative dimension one over `P`. -/
theorem relativeDimension_genericPoint_blowupAtInfinity {n : ℤ}
    (hP : ∀ V : irreducibleComponents P, deltaDimension C sP
      ⟨V, V.2.1, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents (V : Set P) V.2⟩ = n)
    {ξ : blowupAtInfinity i.ker} (hξ : ξ ∈ genericPoints (blowupAtInfinity i.ker)) :
    relativeDimension C.dimensionFunction (𝐪 ≫ sP) ξ = n + 1 := by
  have hcart := isEffectiveCartierDivisor_ker_modificationInfinityBaseChange_blowupAtInfinity
    i.ker sP (𝟙 P)
  have := flat_modificationAffineChartProjection sP 𝐛 (𝟙 P) 𝐡𝐀
  have hξ' : (inv (pullback.fst 𝐪 (𝟙 P))) ξ ∈
      genericPoints (modificationBaseChange sP 𝐛 (𝟙 P)) :=
    mem_genericPoints_target_of_isOpenImmersion (inv (pullback.fst 𝐪 (𝟙 P))) hξ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := genericPoints_subset_range_modificationAffineChartι C sP 𝐛 (𝟙 P) hcart hξ'
  have hcgen : c ∈ genericPoints (modificationAffineChart sP 𝐛 (𝟙 P)) :=
    mem_genericPoints_of_isOpenImmersion_apply (modificationAffineChartι sP 𝐛 (𝟙 P))
      (by rw [hc]; exact hξ')
  obtain ⟨V, hV⟩ := exists_irreducibleComponent_map_genericPoint
    (modificationAffineChartProjection sP 𝐛 (𝟙 P)) ⟨closure {c}, hcgen⟩
  have hδ := deltaDimension_irreducibleComponent_eq_add C
    (modificationAffineChartProjection sP 𝐛 (𝟙 P)) sP 1
    (relativeDimension_modificationAffineChartProjection sP 𝐛 (𝟙 P) 𝐡𝐀) ⟨closure {c}, hcgen⟩ V hV
  rw [hP V, deltaDimension_eq_of_isGenericPoint C _ _ c isGenericPoint_closure] at hδ
  have hcomp : modificationAffineChartProjection sP 𝐛 (𝟙 P) ≫ sP =
      modificationAffineChartι sP 𝐛 (𝟙 P) ≫ pullback.fst 𝐪 (𝟙 P) ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP := by
    have e : pullback.snd 𝐪 (𝟙 P) = pullback.fst 𝐪 (𝟙 P) ≫ 𝐪 := by
      rw [pullback.condition, Category.comp_id]
    dsimp only [modificationAffineChartProjection]

/-- **A point of coheight one in `W` has `δ = n`** when every irreducible component of `P` has
`δ = n`: it is an immediate specialization of a generic point of `W`, which has `δ = n + 1`. -/
theorem relativeDimension_of_coheight_eq_one {n : ℤ}
    (hP : ∀ V : irreducibleComponents P, deltaDimension C sP
      ⟨V, V.2.1, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents (V : Set P) V.2⟩ = n)
    {y : blowupAtInfinity i.ker} (hy : Order.coheight y = 1) :
    relativeDimension C.dimensionFunction (𝐪 ≫ sP) y = n := by
  obtain ⟨ξ, hyξ⟩ := not_isMax_iff.mp (Order.coheight_ne_zero.mp (by rw [hy]; exact one_ne_zero))
  have hξ0 : Order.coheight ξ = 0 := by
    have h := Order.coheight_add_one_le hyξ
    rw [hy] at h
    exact enat_eq_zero_of_add_one_le_one h
  have hξmax : IsMax ξ := Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp hξ0
  have hgen : ξ ∈ genericPoints (blowupAtInfinity i.ker) :=
    TopologicalSpace.mem_genericPoints_of_forall_specializes_eq fun z hz =>
      (hz.antisymm (hξmax hz)).eq
  -- in the specialization order `y < ξ` means `ξ ⤳ y`, `ξ ≠ y`
  have himm : TopologicalSpace.IsImmediateSpecialization ξ y := by
    refine ⟨hyξ.1, fun h => hyξ.2 (h ▸ le_rfl), fun z hξz hzy => ?_⟩
    by_contra hne
    push Not at hne
    have h1 : y < z := lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨hzy, fun h => hne.2 (hzy.antisymm h).eq⟩
    have h2 : z < ξ := lt_iff_le_not_ge.mpr ⟨hξz, fun h => hne.1 (hξz.antisymm h).eq.symm⟩
    have h3 := Order.coheight_add_one_le h1
    rw [hy] at h3
    have hz0 := enat_eq_zero_of_add_one_le_one h3
    exact (Order.coheight_ne_zero.mpr (not_isMax_iff.mpr ⟨ξ, h2⟩)) hz0
  have hstep := (deltaDimensionFunction C (𝐪 ≫ sP)).step_immediate himm
  rw [deltaDimensionFunction_apply, deltaDimensionFunction_apply,
    relativeDimension_genericPoint_blowupAtInfinity C sP i hP hgen] at hstep
  omega

/-- **The generic points of the components of `E = W_∞ ×_P X` have coheight one in `W`**: `E` is
the exceptional divisor, an effective Cartier divisor on `W`, so the local rings of `W` there have
dimension one. -/
theorem coheight_exceptional_eq_one {ζ : 𝐄} (hζ : ζ ∈ genericPoints 𝐄) :
    Order.coheight ((𝐞) ζ) = 1 := by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian (blowupAtInfinity i.ker) :=
    LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (𝐪 ≫ sP)
  have hsq := isPullback_exceptionalDivisorToFibreAtInfinity sP i
  have hgen : hsq.isoPullback.inv ζ ∈ genericPoints (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker).subscheme :=
    mem_genericPoints_target_of_isOpenImmersion hsq.isoPullback.inv hζ
  have hK := ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_one_of_isEffectiveCartierDivisor
    (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker) (isEffectiveCartierDivisor_exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker)
    (hsq.isoPullback.inv ζ) ⟨⟨closure {hsq.isoPullback.inv ζ}, hgen⟩, isGenericPoint_closure⟩
  have h1 : hsq.isoPullback.inv ≫ (exceptionalIdealAtInfinity i.ker).subschemeι = 𝐞 := by
    rw [← exceptionalDivisorToFibreAtInfinity_inclusion sP i, ← Category.assoc,
      IsPullback.isoPullback_inv_fst]
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, h1, ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight] at hK
  exact_mod_cast hK

/-- **`E` is pure of dimension `n`**: every irreducible component of `E = W_∞ ×_P X` has
`δ = n` when every irreducible component of `P` has `δ = n`. -/
theorem deltaDimension_exceptional {n : ℤ}
    (hP : ∀ V : irreducibleComponents P, deltaDimension C sP
      ⟨V, V.2.1, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents (V : Set P) V.2⟩ = n)
    (V : irreducibleComponents 𝐄) :
    deltaDimension C (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) ⟨V, V.2.1, isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents _ V.2⟩ = n := by
  have hgp := V.2.1.isGenericPoint_genericPoint (isClosed_of_mem_irreducibleComponents _ V.2)
  rw [deltaDimension_eq_of_isGenericPoint C _ _ _ hgp, relativeDimension_comp_closedImmersion]
  refine relativeDimension_of_coheight_eq_one C sP i hP (coheight_exceptional_eq_one C sP i ?_)
  change closure {_} ∈ irreducibleComponents _
  rw [hgp.def]
  exact V.2

/-- **Specialization of the fundamental class in the deformation to the normal cone** (item C6
of `notes/E_plan.md`). Let `i : X ⟶ P` be a closed immersion with `P` smooth, separated and of
finite type over `k` and of pure dimension `n`. Let `W` be the blowup of `𝐏¹_P` in `∞(X)`, with
`q : W ⟶ P`, the section at zero `i₀ : P ⟶ W`, the exceptional divisor
`e : E = W_∞ ×_P X ⟶ W_∞ ⟶ W` and the strict transform `a : X' ⟶ W_∞ ⟶ W`. Then there is
`β ∈ CH_*(X') ⊗ ℚ` with

  `(i₀)_*[P] = e_*[E] + a_*β`   in `CH_*(W) ⊗ ℚ`.

In Lean: `W = blowupAtInfinity i.ker`, `q = modificationProjection sP b`,
`i₀ = modificationSectionAtZero sP b _`, `e = pullback.fst (modificationProjectionAtInfinity sP b)
i ≫ modificationInclusionAtInfinity sP b` and `a = strictTransformToFibreAtInfinity sP i ≫
modificationInclusionAtInfinity sP b`, for `b = blowupAtInfinityToProjectiveLineProduct i.ker sP`
(the `GRR.DeformationGeom` abbreviations `sectionAtZero`, `exceptionalInclusion`,
`strictTransformInclusion`, `proj`). -/
theorem exists_specialization_fundamentalClass {n : ℕ} (hP : RelativeDimension sP n) :
    haveI := isNoetherian_of_quasiCompact_fieldChowSituation k (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP)
    ∃ β : CHQ k (𝐚 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP),
      rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sP (𝐪 ≫ sP)
          (Specialization.sectionAtZero_comp_structure (fieldChowSituation k) sP 𝐛 𝐡𝐀)
          (GRR.fundamentalClass k sP) =
        rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) (f := 𝐞) rfl
            (rationalFundamentalClass (fieldChowSituation k) (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP)) +
          rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) (𝐚 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) (f := 𝐚) rfl
            β := by
  have := isNoetherian_of_quasiCompact_fieldChowSituation k (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP)
  have := isNoetherian k sP
  have hPδ :=
    Stacks.WeilCohomology.deltaDimension_irreducibleComponent_of_relativeDimension k sP n hP
  have hPdim : schemeDeltaDimension (fieldChowSituation k) sP ≤ ((n : ℤ) : EInt) :=
    Stacks.WeilCohomology.schemeDeltaDimension_le_of_forall_irreducibleComponent
      (C := fieldChowSituation k) sP hPδ
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ :=
    Specialization.exists_sectionAtZero_pushforward_eq (fieldChowSituation k) sP i n hPdim
  refine ⟨DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) (𝐚 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) j)
    (n : ℤ) ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ β), ?_⟩
  rw [GRR.fundamentalClass,
    Specialization.rationalFundamentalClass_eq_of_deltaDimension (fieldChowSituation k) sP hPδ,
    Specialization.rationalFundamentalClass_exceptional k sP i hP,
    rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul, rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul,
    rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul, hβ, TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add]

end GRR

/-!
# The closed immersion formula in the core case (item C7)

For a closed immersion `i : X ⟶ P` of smooth schemes over `k`, `P` pure of dimension `n` and the
conormal module of constant rank `r`, `GRR.closedImmersionFormula_core_of` proves
`ch(i_! θ[E]) ∩ [P] = i_*((ch(E) · td(N)⁻¹) ∩ [X])` for every vector bundle `E`, from the
zero-section formula on `𝐏(𝒞 ⊕ 𝒪_X)` (item B5) and `[N] = [𝒞^∨]` (item R5), both hypotheses.
The proof deforms `(i_*E)[0]` to `Q = (i'_*pr^*E)[0]` on `W = Bl_{∞(X)} 𝐏¹_P` and specializes
`(i₀)_*[P] = e_*[E] + a_*β` (items C3–C6 of `notes/E_plan.md`).
-/

/-- Proper pushforward along the identity is the identity. -/
theorem pushforward_id {A : Scheme.{u}} (sA : A ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sA]
    (x : DirectSum ℤ fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sA j) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sA (f := 𝟙 A) (Category.id_comp sA) x = x := by
  have h : rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sA (f := 𝟙 A) (Category.id_comp sA) =
      LinearMap.id :=
    rationalChowHomology_linearMap_ext C sA fun j q α => by
      rw [rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul, properChowPushforward_id]
      rfl
  rw [h, LinearMap.id_apply]

/-- Proper pushforward along equal morphisms. -/
theorem pushforward_congr_hom {A B : Scheme.{u}} (sA : A ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sA]
    (sB : B ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sB] {f g : A ⟶ B} [IsProper f] [IsProper g] (h : f = g)
    (hf : f ≫ sB = sA) (hg : g ≫ sB = sA)
    (x : DirectSum ℤ fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sA j) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sB hf x = rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sB hg x := by
  subst h
  rfl

/-- Proper pushforward on `CH_*(-) ⊗ ℚ` is functorial, for schemes locally of finite type. -/
theorem pushforward_comp {A B D : Scheme.{u}} (sA : A ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sA]
    (sB : B ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sB] (sD : D ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sD]
    {f : A ⟶ B} [IsProper f] {g : B ⟶ D} [IsProper g] (hf : f ≫ sB = sA) (hg : g ≫ sD = sB)
    (hfg : (f ≫ g) ≫ sD = sA) (x : DirectSum ℤ fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sA j) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sD hfg x =
      rationalProperChowPushforward C sB sD hg (rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sB hf x) := by
  have h : rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sD hfg =
      (rationalProperChowPushforward C sB sD hg).comp
        (rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sB hf) := by
    refine rationalChowHomology_linearMap_ext C sA fun j q α ↦ ?_
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul,
      rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul, rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul]
    congr 2
    exact (DFunLike.congr_fun (properChowPushforward_comp C sA sB sD f g hf hg j
      (properPushforwardDescends _ _ _ _ _ _) (properPushforwardDescends _ _ _ _ _ _)) α).symm
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h x

/-- **`u_*[A] = [B]` for an isomorphism `u : A ⟶ B`** of Noetherian schemes. -/
theorem pushforward_rationalFundamentalClass_of_isIso {A B : Scheme.{u}} (sA : A ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sA] [IsNoetherian A] (sB : B ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sB]
    [IsNoetherian B] (f : A ⟶ B) [IsIso f] (hf : f ≫ sB = sA) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sB hf (rationalFundamentalClass C sA) =
      rationalFundamentalClass C sB := by
  have hpush : ∀ d (hfac : ProperPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence C sA sB f hf d),
      properChowPushforward C sA sB f hf d hfac (fundamentalChowClass C sA d) =
        fundamentalChowClass C sB d :=
    fun d hfac ↦ properChowPushforward_fundamentalChowClass_of_isIso C sA sB f hf d hfac
  set g : ℤ → DirectSum ℤ fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sB j := fun d =>
    DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sB j) d
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ fundamentalChowClass C sB d) with hg
  rw [rationalFundamentalClass_eq, rationalFundamentalClass_eq, map_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ d ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sA).toFinset,
      rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sB hf
          (DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sA j) d
            ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ fundamentalChowClass C sA d)) = g d := by
    intro d _
    rw [rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul, hpush]
  have hvanA : ∀ d ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sA).toFinset ∪
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sB).toFinset,
      d ∉ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sA).toFinset → g d = 0 := by
    intro d _ hd
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hd
    have h0 : fundamentalChowClass C sA d = 0 := by
      rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_notMem_fundamentalClassDegrees C sA hd,
        map_zero]
    rw [hg]
    dsimp only
    rw [← hpush d (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _), h0, map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero,
      map_zero]
  have hvanB : ∀ d ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sA).toFinset ∪
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sB).toFinset,
      d ∉ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sB).toFinset → g d = 0 := by
    intro d _ hd
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hd
    rw [hg]
    dsimp only
    rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_notMem_fundamentalClassDegrees C sB hd,
      map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_left hvanA,
    ← Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_right hvanB]

end Pushforward

/-- **The projection formula** `f_*(f^* c ∩ γ) = c ∩ f_* γ` for a proper `f`, with no smoothness
assumed on its source or target. -/
theorem pushforward_cap_pullbackAQ (f : A ⟶ B) [IsProper f] (hf : f ≫ sB = sA) (c : AQ k sB)
    (γ : CHQ k sA) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sA sB hf
        (cap k sA (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sA sB f hf c) γ) =
      cap k sB c (rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sA sB hf γ) :=
  rationalProperChowPushforward_totalRationalChowCap_pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sA sB f hf
    (bddBelow_relativeDimension_field k sA) (bddBelow_relativeDimension_field k sB) c γ

/-- The zero class caps every class to zero. -/
theorem cap_zero_apply (γ : CHQ k sA) : cap k sA 0 γ = 0 := by
  simp only [cap, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

/-- The projective completion `𝐏(𝒞 ⊕ 𝒪_X)` of a vector bundle of constant rank on a smooth `X`
is smooth, separated and of finite type over `k`. -/
theorem isSmoothFT_completion (𝒞 : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} 𝒞] (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒞 r] :
    IsSmoothFT k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) :=
  haveI : Smooth (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞) :=
    Stacks.Chow.smooth_bundleProj (completionModule 𝒞) r

/-- `s_*(ρ^*E)` is coherent on `𝐏(𝒞 ⊕ 𝒪_X)` for a finite locally free `E` on `X`, `s` the zero
section and `ρ : 𝐏(𝒪_X) ⟶ X`. -/
theorem coherentModules_pushforward_zeroSection {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒞 : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} 𝒞]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian (projectiveCompletion 𝒞)] (E : X.Modules)
    [hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] :
    Stacks.SheafOfModules.coherentModules (projectiveCompletion 𝒞).ringCatSheaf
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E)) := by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian (bundle (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)) :=
    isLocallyNoetherian_of_isClosedImmersion (zeroSection 𝒞)
  have h1 := isCoherent_of_isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isLocallyNoetherian
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.pullback_scheme _ _ hE)
  have h2 := (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckGroupAffine.isCoherent_iff_isCoherent' _).1 h1
  exact (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckGroupAffine.isCoherent_iff_isCoherent' _).2
    (isCoherent_pushforward_of_isClosedImmersion (zeroSection 𝒞) _)

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
  (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP] (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i]
  (hi : i ≫ sP = sX)

/-- The conormal bundle `𝒞 = 𝒩^∨` of `i`, where `𝒩 = (conormalModule i)^∨` is the normal bundle
of `i` as a regular immersion: the exceptional divisor of the deformation to the normal cone is
`𝐏(𝒞 ⊕ 𝒪_X)` (`Stacks.Chow.exceptionalFibreIsoProjectiveCompletion`). -/
abbrev conormalBundle : X.Modules :=
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := (isNoetherian k sX).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  dualSheaf (VirtualNormalBundle.ofIsRegularImmersion i
    (DeformationGeom.isRegularImmersion_of_isSmoothFT k sX sP i hi)).bundle

/-- `𝒞` has the rank of the conormal module. -/
theorem isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_conormalBundle (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (conormalModule i) r] :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      (conormalBundle k sX sP i hi) r :=
  Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_dualSheaf _ r
    (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_dualSheaf
      (conormalModule i) r inferInstance)

/-- `𝐏(𝒞 ⊕ 𝒪_X)` is smooth, separated and of finite type over `k`. -/
theorem isSmoothFT_conormalCompletion (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (conormalModule i) r] :
    IsSmoothFT k (projectiveCompletionProj (conormalBundle k sX sP i hi) ≫ sX) :=
  haveI := isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_conormalBundle k sX sP i hi r
  isSmoothFT_completion k sX _ r

end Conormal

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
  (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP] (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i]
  (hi : i ≫ sP = sX)

/-- **The closed immersion formula in the core case** (item C7 of `notes/E_plan.md`). Let
`i : X ⟶ P` be a closed immersion of smooth separated schemes of finite type over `k`, with `P`
pure of dimension `n` and the conormal module of constant rank `r`. Let `𝒞` be the conormal
bundle (`GRR.ClosedFormulaCore.conormalBundle`), `π : P̄ = 𝐏(𝒞 ⊕ 𝒪_X) ⟶ X`, `s` its zero section
and `ρ : 𝐏(𝒪_X) ⟶ X`. Assume the zero-section formula (item B5)

  `π_*(ch(K) ∩ [P̄]) = (ch(E) · td(-[𝒞^∨])) ∩ [X]`  for `K ≅ (s_*ρ^*E)[0]`,

and `[N_{X/P}] = [𝒞^∨]` (item R5). Then for every finite locally free `E` on `X`

  `ch(i_! θ[E]) ∩ [P] = i_*((ch(E) · td(N_{X/P})⁻¹) ∩ [X])`. -/
theorem closedImmersionFormula_core_of {n : ℕ} (hP : RelativeDimension sP n) (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (conormalModule i) r]
    (hB5 : haveI := ClosedFormulaCore.isSmoothFT_conormalCompletion k sX sP i hi r
      ∀ (E : X.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E]
        {K : DerivedCategory (projectiveCompletion 𝐂).Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
        (_ : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝐂)).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E))),
        rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) (𝛑 ≫ sX) sX rfl
            (cap k (𝛑 ≫ sX) (perfectCh (fieldChowSituation k) _ hK)
              (fundamentalClass k (𝛑 ≫ sX))) =
          cap k sX (ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) *
              toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf 𝐂)))
            (fundamentalClass k sX))
    (hR5 : normalClass k sP i = VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf 𝐂))
    (E : X.Modules) [hE : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E] :
    haveI := compactSpace k sP
    haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
    cap k sP (chK k sP (pushforwardK i (vectorBundleEquiv k sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E))))
        (fundamentalClass k sP) =
      rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi
        (cap k sX (ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) *
            toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i))
          (fundamentalClass k sX)) := by
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X := (isNoetherian k sX).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  have := compactSpace k sP
  have hW : IsSmoothFT k (𝐪 ≫ sP) := isSmoothFT_blowupAtInfinity k sX sP i hi
  have := ClosedFormulaCore.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_conormalBundle k sX sP i hi r
  have hPb : IsSmoothFT k (𝛑 ≫ sX) := ClosedFormulaCore.isSmoothFT_conormalCompletion k sX sP i hi r
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian (projectiveCompletion 𝐂) :=
    (isNoetherian k (𝛑 ≫ sX)).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  have := isNoetherian k (𝛑 ≫ sX)
  have := isNoetherian_of_quasiCompact_fieldChowSituation k (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP)
  -- `Q = (i'_*pr^*E)[0]` on `W` and `(s_*ρ^*E)[0]` on `P̄` have defined Chern classes (C1)
  have hQ : HasDefinedChernClasses (Q i E) :=
    hasDefinedChernClasses_single_coherent k (𝐪 ≫ sP) ⟨_, coherentModules_pushforward_G i E⟩
  have hK : HasDefinedChernClasses ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (projectiveCompletion 𝐂).Modules 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝐂)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E))) :=
    hasDefinedChernClasses_single_coherent k (𝛑 ≫ sX)
      ⟨_, ClosedFormulaCore.coherentModules_pushforward_zeroSection 𝐂 E⟩
  -- the zero fibre (C3, A2, A4): `ch(i_! θ[E]) = i₀^* ch(Q)`
  have h₀ : 𝐢₀ ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP = sP := sectionAtZero_comp_proj_assoc sP i sP
  have hA1 : chK k sP (pushforwardK i (vectorBundleEquiv k sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E))) =
      pullbackAQ 𝐂𝐇 sP (𝐪 ≫ sP) 𝐢₀ h₀ (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) hQ) := by
    rw [pullbackAQ_perfectCh]
    exact chK_pushforwardK_classOf_eq_perfectCh k sX sP i E _ (deformationZeroFibreIso sP i E)
  -- `γ = q_*(i₀)_*γ`, as `i₀ ≫ q = 𝟙`
  have hA2 : ∀ γ : CHQ k sP, γ =
      rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) sP (f := 𝐪) rfl
        (rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 sP (𝐪 ≫ sP) (f := 𝐢₀) h₀ γ) := by
    intro γ
    rw [← ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_comp 𝐂𝐇 sP (𝐪 ≫ sP) sP (f := 𝐢₀) (g := 𝐪) h₀ rfl
        (by rw [sectionAtZero_comp_proj, Category.id_comp]),
      ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_congr_hom 𝐂𝐇 sP sP (sectionAtZero_comp_proj sP i) _
        (Category.id_comp sP),
      ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_id]
  -- the specialization (C6): `(i₀)_*[P] = e_*[E] + a_*β`
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ : ∃ β : CHQ k (𝐚 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP),
      rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 sP (𝐪 ≫ sP) (f := 𝐢₀) h₀ (fundamentalClass k sP) =
        rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) (f := 𝐞) rfl
            (rationalFundamentalClass 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP)) +
          rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 (𝐚 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) (f := 𝐚) rfl β :=
    exists_specialization_fundamentalClass k sP i hP
  -- the strict transform term vanishes (C5, A1, A2)
  have hB : rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) sP (f := 𝐪) rfl
      (cap k (𝐪 ≫ sP) (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) hQ)
        (rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 (𝐚 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) (f := 𝐚) rfl β)) = 0 := by
    rw [← ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_cap_pullbackAQ k (𝐚 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) 𝐚 rfl
        (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) hQ) β, pullbackAQ_perfectCh,
      perfectCh_eq_zero 𝐂𝐇 _ _ (isZero_deformationStrictTransform sP i E),
      ClosedFormulaCore.cap_zero_apply, map_zero, map_zero]
  -- the exceptional divisor term: `e^* ch(Q) = φ^* ch(s_*ρ^*E)` (C4, A2)
  have hφ : (𝛗).hom ≫ 𝛑 ≫ sX = 𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP := by
    rw [exceptionalFibreIsoProjectiveCompletion_hom_projection_assoc,
      exceptionalInclusion_comp_proj_assoc, hi]
  have hpull : pullbackAQ 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) 𝐞 rfl (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) hQ) =
      pullbackAQ 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝛑 ≫ sX) (𝛗).hom hφ (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝛑 ≫ sX) hK) :=
    (pullbackAQ_perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) 𝐞 rfl hQ).trans
      (pullbackAQ_perfectCh_of_iso 𝐂𝐇 (𝛑 ≫ sX) (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝛗).hom hφ hK
        (hQ.derivedPullback 𝐞)
        (deformationExceptionalFibreIso sP i
          (DeformationGeom.isRegularImmersion_of_isSmoothFT k sX sP i hi) r E).symm).symm
  -- transport along `e ≫ q = φ ≫ π ≫ i`, `φ_*[E] = [P̄]`, then B5 and R5
  have heq : 𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 = (𝛗).hom ≫ 𝛑 ≫ i := by
    rw [exceptionalInclusion_comp_proj,
      exceptionalFibreIsoProjectiveCompletion_hom_projection_assoc]
  have hπi : (𝛑 ≫ i) ≫ sP = 𝛑 ≫ sX := by rw [Category.assoc, hi]
  have hφi : ((𝛗).hom ≫ 𝛑 ≫ i) ≫ sP = 𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP := by
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hi, hφ]
  have h1 := ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_cap_pullbackAQ k (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) 𝐞 rfl
    (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) hQ) (rationalFundamentalClass 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP))
  have h2 := ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_comp 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) sP (f := 𝐞) (g := 𝐪)
    rfl rfl (Category.assoc _ _ _)
    (cap k (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (pullbackAQ 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) 𝐞 rfl
      (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) hQ)) (rationalFundamentalClass 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP)))
  have h3 := ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_congr_hom 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) sP heq
    (Category.assoc _ _ _) hφi
    (cap k (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (pullbackAQ 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝛑 ≫ sX) (𝛗).hom hφ
      (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝛑 ≫ sX) hK)) (rationalFundamentalClass 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP)))
  have h4 := ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_comp 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝛑 ≫ sX) sP
    (f := (𝛗).hom) (g := 𝛑 ≫ i) hφ hπi hφi
    (cap k (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (pullbackAQ 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝛑 ≫ sX) (𝛗).hom hφ
      (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝛑 ≫ sX) hK)) (rationalFundamentalClass 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP)))
  have h5 := ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_comp 𝐂𝐇 (𝛑 ≫ sX) sX sP (f := 𝛑) (g := i) rfl hi hπi
  have h6 := ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_cap_pullbackAQ k (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝛑 ≫ sX) (𝛗).hom hφ
    (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝛑 ≫ sX) hK) (rationalFundamentalClass 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP))
  have h7 : rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝛑 ≫ sX) hφ
      (rationalFundamentalClass 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP)) = fundamentalClass k (𝛑 ≫ sX) :=
    ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_rationalFundamentalClass_of_isIso 𝐂𝐇 _ _ (𝛗).hom hφ
  have hC : rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) sP (f := 𝐪) rfl
      (cap k (𝐪 ≫ sP) (perfectCh 𝐂𝐇 (𝐪 ≫ sP) hQ)
        (rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP) (𝐪 ≫ sP) (f := 𝐞) rfl
          (rationalFundamentalClass 𝐂𝐇 (𝐞 ≫ 𝐪 ≫ sP)))) =
      rationalProperChowPushforward 𝐂𝐇 sX sP hi
        (cap k sX (ch 𝐂𝐇 sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) *
            toddClass 𝐂𝐇 sX (-normalClass k sP i)) (fundamentalClass k sX)) := by
    rw [← h1, ← h2, hpull, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, hB5 E hK (Iso.refl _), hR5]
  -- assembly: `ch(i_!θ[E]) ∩ [P] = q_*(ch(Q) ∩ (e_*[E] + a_*β))`
  rw [hA1]
  refine (hA2 _).trans ?_
  rw [ClosedFormulaCore.pushforward_cap_pullbackAQ k sP (𝐪 ≫ sP) 𝐢₀ h₀, hβ, map_add, map_add, hC,
    hB, add_zero]

/-- **`GRR.ClosedImmersionFormula` in the core case**, from the zero-section formula (B5) and
`[N_{X/P}] = [𝒞^∨]` (R5): `GRR.closedImmersionFormula_core_of` for every vector bundle, extended
to `K'₀(X)` by `GRR.closedImmersionFormula_of_bundles`. -/
theorem closedImmersionFormula_of_zeroSectionFormula {n : ℕ} (hP : RelativeDimension sP n)
    (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} (conormalModule i) r]
    (hB5 : haveI := ClosedFormulaCore.isSmoothFT_conormalCompletion k sX sP i hi r
      ∀ (E : X.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E]
        {K : DerivedCategory (projectiveCompletion 𝐂).Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
        (_ : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝐂)).obj
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E))),
        rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) (𝛑 ≫ sX) sX rfl
            (cap k (𝛑 ≫ sX) (perfectCh (fieldChowSituation k) _ hK)
              (fundamentalClass k (𝛑 ≫ sX))) =
          cap k sX (ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) *
              toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf 𝐂)))
            (fundamentalClass k sX))
    (hR5 : normalClass k sP i = VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf 𝐂)) :
    ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi :=
  closedImmersionFormula_of_bundles k sX sP i hi fun E _ ↦
    closedImmersionFormula_core_of k sX sP i hi hP r hB5 hR5 E

end GRR

/-!
# Riemann–Roch for the zero section of `P̄ = 𝐏(𝒞 ⊕ 𝒪_X)`

`X` smooth over a field, `𝒞` finite locally free of rank `r`, `π : P̄ ⟶ X`, zero section
`s : 𝐏(𝒪_X) ⟶ P̄`, `ρ = π ∘ s` (an isomorphism), Koszul module `ℰ = π^*𝒞 ⊗ 𝒪(-1)`. Items B0–B5
of `notes/E_plan.md`: `P̄` is smooth (`GRR.isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion`); `ch(s_*𝒪) =
ch(λ_{-1}ℰ)` (`GRR.perfectCh_pushforward_zeroSection_unit`); `ch(λ_{-1}ℰ) td([ℰ^∨]) ∩ [P̄] =
s_*[𝐏(𝒪_X)]`, i.e. `c_r(ℰ) ∩ [P̄] = (-1)^r s_*[𝐏(𝒪_X)]`, by uniqueness in the projective bundle
formula (`GRR.cap_topClass_fundamentalClass`);
`s^*[ℰ^∨] = ρ^*[𝒞^∨]` (`GRR.pullback_zeroSection_classOf_dual_koszulModule`); and
`π_*(ch(s_*ρ^*E) ∩ [P̄]) = (ch(E) · td(-[𝒞^∨])) ∩ [X]` (`GRR.zeroSection_formula`).
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Stacks.Chow
open Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion (projectiveCompletion projectiveCompletionProj zeroSection
  koszulModule completionModule
  vectorBundleZeroSection_comp_toCompletion_comp_projectiveCompletionProj)
open Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules (dualSheaf)
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u

namespace GRR

attribute [local instance 10000] HasDerivedCategory.standard

section Geometry

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒞 : X.Modules)
  [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} 𝒞]
  (r : ℕ) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒞 r]

include r in
theorem ZeroSectionRR.smooth_projectiveCompletionProj : Smooth (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞) :=
  Stacks.Chow.smooth_bundleProj (completionModule 𝒞) r

theorem ZeroSectionRR.smooth_bundleProj_unitModule (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    Smooth (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)) :=
  haveI : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) (0 + 1) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_unit X
  Stacks.Chow.smooth_bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) 0

include r in
/-- **B0**: the projective completion of a vector bundle on a smooth `X` is smooth. -/
theorem isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion (k : Type u) [Field k] (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsSmoothFT k sX] : IsSmoothFT k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) :=
  haveI := ZeroSectionRR.smooth_projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 r
  { smooth := inferInstance
    isSeparated := inferInstance
    quasiCompact := inferInstance }

/-- `𝐏(𝒪_X)` is smooth when `X` is. -/
theorem ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] :
    IsSmoothFT k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) :=
  haveI := ZeroSectionRR.smooth_bundleProj_unitModule X
  { smooth := inferInstance
    isSeparated := inferInstance
    quasiCompact := inferInstance }

include 𝒞 r in
/-- `ρ : 𝐏(𝒪_X) ⟶ X` is an isomorphism. -/
theorem ZeroSectionRR.isIso_bundleProj_unitModule [IsLocallyNoetherian X] :
    IsIso (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)) := by
  have hker := Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.ker_vectorBundleZeroSection_comp_toCompletion (E := 𝒞) r
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ : ∃ θ : bundle (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≅ X,
      θ.hom ≫ (Scheme.Modules.vectorBundleLiftZero 𝒞 ≫ Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.toCompletion 𝒞) =
        zeroSection 𝒞 :=
    ⟨_, Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.KerChart.isoOfKerEq_hom_comp _ _ hker⟩
  have h : bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) = θ.hom := by
    rw [← Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞, ← hθ]
    simp only [Category.assoc,
      vectorBundleZeroSection_comp_toCompletion_comp_projectiveCompletionProj,
      Category.comp_id]
  rw [h]
  infer_instance

/-- `s^*𝒪_{P̄}(1) ≅ 𝒪`. -/
noncomputable def ZeroSectionRR.pullbackTwistIso :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj (bundleTwist (completionModule 𝒞)) ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit (bundle (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)).ringCatSheaf :=
  haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.isInvertible_unit X.presheaf X.ringCatSheaf.2
  GenuineChern.bundleEmbeddingTwistIso (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.completionSnd 𝒞) ≪≫
    (GenuineChern.bundleTwistIsoOfRankOne (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)).symm ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitIso _

/-- `s^*π^*𝒞 ≅ ρ^*𝒞`. -/
noncomputable def ZeroSectionRR.pullbackPullbackIso (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj M) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj M :=
  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (zeroSection 𝒞) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).app M ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr
      (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).app M

/-- `s^*ℰ ≅ ρ^*𝒞` for the Koszul module `ℰ = π^*𝒞 ⊗ 𝒪(1)^∨`. -/
noncomputable def ZeroSectionRR.pullbackKoszulModuleIso :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj (koszulModule 𝒞) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj 𝒞 :=
  haveI : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      (bundleTwist (completionModule 𝒞)) 1 :=
    isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_one_of_isInvertible _
  haveI : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
      (bundleTwist (completionModule 𝒞)) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _ 1
  Stacks.Chow.pullbackTensorObjIso (zeroSection 𝒞) _ _ ≪≫
    ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor _).mapIso
      (ZeroSectionRR.pullbackPullbackIso 𝒞 𝒞)).app _ ≪≫
    ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.sheafTensor _).obj _).mapIso
      (VectorBundleKZero.pullbackDualSheafIso (zeroSection 𝒞) _
          (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree _) ≪≫
        Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheafIsoOfIso
          (ZeroSectionRR.pullbackTwistIso 𝒞).symm ≪≫
        Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.unitDualIso _) ≪≫
    Stacks.Chow.tensorObjUnitIso _ _

include r in
/-- **B4**: `s^*[ℰ^∨] = ρ^*[𝒞^∨]` in `K₀(Vect 𝐏(𝒪_X))`. -/
theorem pullback_zeroSection_classOf_dual_koszulModule :
    VectorBundleKZero.pullback (zeroSection 𝒞)
        (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ (dualSheaf (koszulModule 𝒞))) =
      VectorBundleKZero.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))
        (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf 𝒞)) := by
  have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (koszulModule 𝒞) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _ r
  rw [pullback_classOf_dualSheaf, pullback_classOf_dualSheaf]
  have := pullbackPreservesRank_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (koszulModule 𝒞) r (zeroSection 𝒞)
  have hd := Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_dualSheaf
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj (koszulModule 𝒞)) r inferInstance
  exact VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso
    (Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules.dualSheafIsoOfIso
      (ZeroSectionRR.pullbackKoszulModuleIso 𝒞).symm)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _ r)

end Geometry

/-! ### B1: the Koszul resolution of the zero section -/

section Koszul

namespace ZeroSectionRR

variable {Y : Scheme.{u}} {F : DerivedCategory Y.Modules} {ℰ : Y.Modules} (r : ℕ)
  [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} ℰ r]
  (R : ExteriorPowerResolution F ℰ)

theorem isStrictlyGE_complex : R.complex.IsStrictlyGE (-(r : ℤ)) :=
  (CochainComplex.isStrictlyGE_iff _ _).2 fun m hm ↦ R.isZero_X_of_lt r m hm

omit [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} ℰ r] in
theorem isStrictlyLE_complex : R.complex.IsStrictlyLE 0 :=
  (CochainComplex.isStrictlyLE_iff _ _).2 fun m hm ↦ R.isZero_of_pos m hm

include r in
/-- An exterior-power resolution is a bounded complex of finite locally free modules. -/
theorem boundedFiniteLocallyFreeComplex_complex :
    Stacks.Perfect.BoundedLocallyFreeComplexes.boundedFiniteLocallyFreeComplex Y R.complex :=
  ⟨⟨(CochainComplex.plus_iff _ _).2 ⟨_, isStrictlyGE_complex r R⟩,
      (CochainComplex.minus_iff _).2 ⟨_, isStrictlyLE_complex R⟩⟩, fun i ↦ by
    have := R.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_X r i
    have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R.complex.X i) :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _
        (exteriorPowerRanks r i)
    exact Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree _⟩

/-- Reindexing `∑_{-r ≤ i ≤ 0} f(i)` as `∑_{p ≤ r} f(-p)`. -/
theorem sum_Icc_neg_eq_sum_range {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℤ → M) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc (-(r : ℤ)) 0, f i = ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (r + 1), f (-(p : ℤ)) := by
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun p : ℕ ↦ -(p : ℤ)) (fun i ↦ (-i).toNat) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro p hp
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hp
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc]
    omega
  · intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hi
    rw [Finset.mem_range]
    omega
  · intro p _
    simp only [neg_neg, Int.toNat_natCast]
  · intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hi
    rw [Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by omega), neg_neg]
  · intro p _
    rfl

/-- **The Euler characteristic of an exterior-power resolution** is `λ_{-1}(ℰ)`. -/
theorem eulerCharComplex_complex :
    Stacks.Perfect.BoundedLocallyFreeComplexes.eulerCharComplex Y R.complex = lambdaNegOne ℰ r := by
  rw [Stacks.Perfect.BoundedLocallyFreeComplexes.eulerCharComplex_eq_sum Y R.complex _ _
    (isStrictlyGE_complex r R) (isStrictlyLE_complex R), sum_Icc_neg_eq_sum_range, lambdaNegOne]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ ↦ ?_
  have := R.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_X r (-(p : ℤ))
  rw [Int.negOnePow_neg, Int.coe_negOnePow_natCast,
    VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso (R.termIso p)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _
        (exteriorPowerRanks r (-(p : ℤ))))]

end ZeroSectionRR

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒞 : X.Modules)
  [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} 𝒞]
  (r : ℕ) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒞 r]
  (C : ChowSituation.{u}) (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX]

/-- **B1**: the Chern character of `s_*𝒪` is that of the Koszul complex,
`ch(s_*𝒪) = ch(λ_{-1}(ℰ))`, `ℰ = π^*𝒞 ⊗ 𝒪(-1)`. -/
theorem perfectCh_pushforward_zeroSection_unit
    (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (projectiveCompletion 𝒞).Modules 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (bundle (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)).ringCatSheaf)))) :
    perfectCh C (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) hK =
      ch C (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (lambdaNegOne (koszulModule 𝒞) r) := by
  have R := Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.koszulResolutionZeroSection 𝒞 r
  rw [perfectCh_eq_ch_eulerCharComplex C _ hK
      (ZeroSectionRR.boundedFiniteLocallyFreeComplex_complex r R) R.iso.some.symm,
    ZeroSectionRR.eulerCharComplex_complex r R]

end Koszul

/-! ### B1 twisted by a vector bundle -/

section KoszulTensor

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒞 : X.Modules)
  [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} 𝒞]
  (r : ℕ) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒞 r]
  (E : X.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E]

namespace ZeroSectionRR

/-- The Koszul complex tensored with `π^*E`. -/
noncomputable def koszulTensorComplex {F : DerivedCategory (projectiveCompletion 𝒞).Modules}
    (R : ExteriorPowerResolution F (koszulModule 𝒞)) :
    CochainComplex (projectiveCompletion 𝒞).Modules ℤ :=
  ((tensorRightMod (projectiveCompletion 𝒞)
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj R.complex

variable {F : DerivedCategory (projectiveCompletion 𝒞).Modules}
  (R : ExteriorPowerResolution F (koszulModule 𝒞))

theorem isStrictlyGE_koszulTensorComplex :
    (koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 E R).IsStrictlyGE (-(r : ℤ)) := by
  have := isStrictlyGE_complex r R
  unfold koszulTensorComplex
  infer_instance

theorem isStrictlyLE_koszulTensorComplex : (koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 E R).IsStrictlyLE 0 := by
  have := isStrictlyLE_complex R
  unfold koszulTensorComplex
  infer_instance

include r in
theorem boundedFiniteLocallyFreeComplex_koszulTensorComplex :
    Stacks.Perfect.BoundedLocallyFreeComplexes.boundedFiniteLocallyFreeComplex _
      (koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 E R) :=
  ⟨⟨(CochainComplex.plus_iff _ _).2 ⟨_, isStrictlyGE_koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 r E R⟩,
      (CochainComplex.minus_iff _).2 ⟨_, isStrictlyLE_koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 E R⟩⟩, fun i ↦ by
    have := R.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_X r i
    have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R.complex.X i) :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _
        (exteriorPowerRanks r i)
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.isFiniteLocallyFree_tensorObj (R.complex.X i)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E)⟩

include r in
/-- The Euler characteristic of the twisted Koszul complex is `λ_{-1}(ℰ) · [π^*E]`. -/
theorem eulerCharComplex_koszulTensorComplex :
    Stacks.Perfect.BoundedLocallyFreeComplexes.eulerCharComplex _ (koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 E R) =
      lambdaNegOne (koszulModule 𝒞) r *
        VectorBundleKZero.classOf _
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E) := by
  rw [Stacks.Perfect.BoundedLocallyFreeComplexes.eulerCharComplex_eq_sum _ _ _ _
      (isStrictlyGE_koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 r E R) (isStrictlyLE_koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 E R),
    ← eulerCharComplex_complex r R,
    Stacks.Perfect.BoundedLocallyFreeComplexes.eulerCharComplex_eq_sum _ R.complex _ _
      (isStrictlyGE_complex r R) (isStrictlyLE_complex R), Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ ?_
  have := R.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_X r i
  have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (R.complex.X i) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _
      (exteriorPowerRanks r i)
  rw [smul_mul_assoc, VectorBundleKZero.classOf_mul _ _
    (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree _)
    (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree _)]
  rfl

/-- `(s_*𝒪) ⊗ π^*E ≅ s_*(ρ^*E)`: the projection formula for `s`. -/
noncomputable def pushforwardUnitTensorIso :
    (tensorRightMod (projectiveCompletion 𝒞)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit (bundle (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)).ringCatSheaf)) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E) :=
  ((pushforwardTensorIso (zeroSection 𝒞)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E)).app _).symm ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).mapIso
      (unitTensorIso _ ≪≫ pullbackPullbackIso 𝒞 E)

/-- The twisted Koszul complex represents `s_*(ρ^*E)`: tensoring with `π^*E` is exact. -/
noncomputable def koszulTensorIso
    (R : ExteriorPowerResolution ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (bundle (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)).ringCatSheaf)))
      (koszulModule 𝒞)) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 E R) ≅
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E)) :=
  ((tensorRightMod (projectiveCompletion 𝒞)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E)).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.app
        R.complex).symm ≪≫
    (tensorRightMod (projectiveCompletion 𝒞)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E)).mapDerivedCategory.mapIso
        R.iso.some ≪≫
    ((tensorRightMod (projectiveCompletion 𝒞)
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj
        E)).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).app _ ≪≫
    (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso (pushforwardUnitTensorIso 𝒞 E)

end ZeroSectionRR

variable (C : ChowSituation.{u}) (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX]

/-- **B1 twisted by `E`**: `ch(s_*ρ^*E) = ch(λ_{-1}(ℰ)) · ch(π^*E)`. -/
theorem perfectCh_pushforward_zeroSection {K : DerivedCategory (projectiveCompletion 𝒞).Modules}
    (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
    (e : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E))) :
    perfectCh C (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) hK =
      ch C (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (lambdaNegOne (koszulModule 𝒞) r) *
        ch C (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E)) := by
  have R := Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.koszulResolutionZeroSection 𝒞 r
  rw [perfectCh_eq_ch_eulerCharComplex C _ hK
      (ZeroSectionRR.boundedFiniteLocallyFreeComplex_koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 r E R)
      (e ≪≫ (ZeroSectionRR.koszulTensorIso 𝒞 E R).symm),
    ZeroSectionRR.eulerCharComplex_koszulTensorComplex 𝒞 r E R, map_mul]

end KoszulTensor

/-! ### B5, from B3 -/

section Formula

namespace ZeroSectionRR

/-- Pushforward along equal morphisms. -/
theorem rationalProperChowPushforward_congr_hom {C : ChowSituation.{u}} {A B : Scheme.{u}}
    (sA : A ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sA] (sB : B ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sB]
    {f g : A ⟶ B} [IsProper f] [IsProper g] (h : f = g) (hf : f ≫ sB = sA) (hg : g ≫ sB = sA)
    (γ : DirectSum ℤ fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sA j) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sB hf γ = rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sB hg γ := by
  subst h
  rfl

/-- **`u_*[A] = [B]` for an isomorphism `u : A ⟶ B`.** -/
theorem rationalProperChowPushforward_fundamentalClass_of_isIso (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {A B : Scheme.{u}} (sA : A ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sB : B ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sA]
    [IsSmoothFT k sB] (f : A ⟶ B) [IsIso f] (hf : f ≫ sB = sA) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sA sB hf (fundamentalClass k sA) =
      fundamentalClass k sB := by
  have := isNoetherian k sA
  have := isNoetherian k sB
  set C := fieldChowSituation k
  have hpush : ∀ d (hfac : ProperPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence C sA sB f hf d),
      properChowPushforward C sA sB f hf d hfac (fundamentalChowClass C sA d) =
        fundamentalChowClass C sB d :=
    fun d hfac ↦ properChowPushforward_fundamentalChowClass_of_isIso C sA sB f hf d hfac
  set g : ℤ → CHQ k sB := fun d =>
    DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sB j) d
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ fundamentalChowClass C sB d) with hg
  rw [fundamentalClass, fundamentalClass, rationalFundamentalClass_eq,
    rationalFundamentalClass_eq, map_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ d ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sA).toFinset,
      rationalProperChowPushforward C sA sB hf
          (DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sA j) d
            ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ fundamentalChowClass C sA d)) = g d := by
    intro d _
    rw [rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul, hpush]
  have hvanA : ∀ d ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sA).toFinset ∪
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sB).toFinset,
      d ∉ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sA).toFinset → g d = 0 := by
    intro d _ hd
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hd
    have h0 : fundamentalChowClass C sA d = 0 := by
      rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_notMem_fundamentalClassDegrees C sA hd,
        map_zero]
    rw [hg]
    dsimp only
    rw [← hpush d (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _), h0, map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero,
      map_zero]
  have hvanB : ∀ d ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sA).toFinset ∪
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sB).toFinset,
      d ∉ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sB).toFinset → g d = 0 := by
    intro d _ hd
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hd
    rw [hg]
    dsimp only
    rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_notMem_fundamentalClassDegrees C sB hd,
      map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_left hvanA,
    ← Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_right hvanB]

end ZeroSectionRR

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX]
  (𝒞 : X.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} 𝒞]
  (r : ℕ) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒞 r]
  (E : X.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E]

namespace ZeroSectionRR

/-- `ch(s_*ρ^*E) = (td(-[ℰ^∨]) · ch(π^*E)) · (ch(λ_{-1}ℰ) · td([ℰ^∨]))`. -/
theorem perfectCh_eq_mul {K : DerivedCategory (projectiveCompletion 𝒞).Modules}
    (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
    (e : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E))) :
    perfectCh (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) hK =
      (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
          (-VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ (dualSheaf (koszulModule 𝒞))) *
        ch (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E))) *
      (ch (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
          (lambdaNegOne (koszulModule 𝒞) r) *
        toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
          (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ (dualSheaf (koszulModule 𝒞)))) := by
  rw [perfectCh_pushforward_zeroSection 𝒞 r E (fieldChowSituation k) sX hK e]
  set x := ch (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
    (lambdaNegOne (koszulModule 𝒞) r)
  set y := ch (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E))
  set t := toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
    (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ (dualSheaf (koszulModule 𝒞)))
  set t' := toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
    (-VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ (dualSheaf (koszulModule 𝒞)))
  have hc1 : Commute y x := (Commute.all _ _).map _
  have hc2 : Commute t' (x * y) :=
    (commute_toddClass_ch _ _ _ _).mul_right (commute_toddClass_ch _ _ _ _)
  have h1 : t' * t = 1 := toddClass_neg_mul_toddClass _ _ _
  calc x * y = x * y * (t' * t) := by rw [h1, mul_one]
    _ = t' * (x * y) * t := by rw [← mul_assoc, ← hc2.eq]
    _ = t' * y * (x * t) := by
        rw [← hc1.eq]
        simp only [mul_assoc]

/-- The projection formula along `ρ`, in `cap` form. -/
theorem rationalProperChowPushforward_cap_pullbackAQ_bundleProj
    (b : AQ k sX) (γ : CHQ k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)) :
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) sX rfl
        (cap k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)
          (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) sX
            (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)) rfl b) γ) =
      cap k sX b (rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) sX rfl γ) :=
  rationalProperChowPushforward_totalRationalChowCap_pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) _ sX _ rfl
    (bddBelow_relativeDimension_field k _) (bddBelow_relativeDimension_field k sX) b γ

include r in
/-- `π_* s_* = ρ_*`. -/
theorem pushforward_pushforward_zeroSection
    (y : CHQ k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)) :
    haveI := isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion 𝒞 r k sX
    haveI := ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule k sX
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) sX rfl
        (rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
          (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
          (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX) y) =
      rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) sX rfl y := by
  have := isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion 𝒞 r k sX
  have := ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule k sX
  rw [← rationalProperChowPushforward_comp k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)
      (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) sX (zeroSection 𝒞) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)
      (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX) rfl
      (by rw [Category.assoc,
        Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc])]
  exact ZeroSectionRR.rationalProperChowPushforward_congr_hom _ _
    (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞) _ rfl y

include 𝒞 r in
/-- `ρ_*(ρ^* b ∩ [𝐏(𝒪_X)]) = b ∩ [X]`. -/
theorem pushforward_cap_pullbackAQ_fundamentalClass_bundleProj (b : AQ k sX) :
    haveI := ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule k sX
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) sX rfl
        (cap k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)
          (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) sX
            (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)) rfl b)
          (fundamentalClass k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX))) =
      cap k sX b (fundamentalClass k sX) := by
  have := ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule k sX
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X := (isNoetherian k sX).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  have := ZeroSectionRR.isIso_bundleProj_unitModule 𝒞 r
  rw [ZeroSectionRR.rationalProperChowPushforward_cap_pullbackAQ_bundleProj,
    ZeroSectionRR.rationalProperChowPushforward_fundamentalClass_of_isIso k _ sX _ rfl]

end ZeroSectionRR

/-- **B5 from B3**: the zero-section formula
`π_*(ch(s_*ρ^*E) ∩ [P̄]) = (ch(E) · td(-[𝒞^∨])) ∩ [X]`, given
`(ch(λ_{-1}ℰ) · td([ℰ^∨])) ∩ [P̄] = s_*[𝐏(𝒪_X)]` (B3). -/
theorem zeroSection_formula_of
    (hB3 : haveI := isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion 𝒞 r k sX
      haveI := ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule k sX
      cap k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
          (ch (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
              (lambdaNegOne (koszulModule 𝒞) r) *
            toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
              (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ (dualSheaf (koszulModule 𝒞))))
          (fundamentalClass k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)) =
        rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
          (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
          (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX)
          (fundamentalClass k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)))
    {K : DerivedCategory (projectiveCompletion 𝒞).Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
    (e : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E))) :
    haveI := isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion 𝒞 r k sX
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) sX rfl
        (cap k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (perfectCh (fieldChowSituation k) _ hK)
          (fundamentalClass k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX))) =
      cap k sX (ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) *
          toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf 𝒞)))
        (fundamentalClass k sX) := by
  have := isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion 𝒞 r k sX
  have := ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule k sX
  have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} (koszulModule 𝒞) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _ r
  rw [ZeroSectionRR.perfectCh_eq_mul k sX 𝒞 r E hK e, cap_mul, Module.End.mul_apply, hB3,
    ← rationalProperChowPushforward_cap_pullbackAQ k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)
      (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (zeroSection 𝒞)
      (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX)]
  have hG : VectorBundleKZero.pullback (zeroSection 𝒞) (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)).obj E)) =
      VectorBundleKZero.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))
        (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) := by
    rw [VectorBundleKZero.pullback_classOf, VectorBundleKZero.pullback_classOf]
    exact VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso (ZeroSectionRR.pullbackPullbackIso 𝒞 E)
      (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree _)
  rw [map_mul, pullbackAQ_toddClass, pullbackAQ_ch, map_neg,
    pullback_zeroSection_classOf_dual_koszulModule 𝒞 r, hG, ← map_neg,
    ← pullbackAQ_toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) sX
      (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)) rfl,
    ← pullbackAQ_ch (fieldChowSituation k) (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) sX
      (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X)) rfl, ← map_mul,
    ZeroSectionRR.pushforward_pushforward_zeroSection k sX 𝒞 r,
    ZeroSectionRR.pushforward_cap_pullbackAQ_fundamentalClass_bundleProj k sX 𝒞 r,
    (commute_toddClass_ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX _ _).eq]

end Formula
