/-! ### Degree casts -/

theorem chowGroupCast_chowGroupCast (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] {a b c : ℤ} (h₁ : a = b) (h₂ : b = c) (x : chowGroup C sY a) :
    chowGroupCast C sY h₂ (chowGroupCast C sY h₁ x) = chowGroupCast C sY (h₁.trans h₂) x := by
  subst h₁ h₂
  rfl

theorem properChowPushforward_chowGroupCast (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (sZ : Z ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sZ]
    (f : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper f] (hf : f ≫ sZ = sY) {a b : ℤ} (h : a = b)
    (ha : ProperPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence C sY sZ f hf a)
    (hb : ProperPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence C sY sZ f hf b)
    (x : chowGroup C sY a) :
    properChowPushforward C sY sZ f hf b hb (chowGroupCast C sY h x) =
      chowGroupCast C sZ h (properChowPushforward C sY sZ f hf a ha x) := by
  subst h
  rfl

theorem properChowPushforward_congr_hom (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (sZ : Z ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sZ]
    {f g : Y ⟶ Z} [IsProper f] [IsProper g] (e : f = g) (hf : f ≫ sZ = sY) (hg : g ≫ sZ = sY)
    (a : ℤ) (ha : ProperPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence C sY sZ f hf a)
    (hb : ProperPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence C sY sZ g hg a)
    (x : chowGroup C sY a) :
    properChowPushforward C sY sZ f hf a ha x = properChowPushforward C sY sZ g hg a hb x := by
  subst e
  rfl

/-! ### Uniqueness in the projective space bundle formula -/

section Uniqueness

-- `LocallyOfFiniteType π` is the instance argument `bundlePullback` is stated with.
set_option linter.overlappingInstances false

variable (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {P U : Scheme.{u}} (sU : U ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sU]
  (sP : P ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sP] (π : P ⟶ U) [LocallyOfFiniteType π] [Flat π]
  [IsProper π] (hsP : π ≫ sU = sP) (n : ℕ) (hπ : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension π n)
  (ξ : ChernCapOperator C sP)

/-- A class `y = ∑_i ξ^i ∩ π^*β_i` with `π_*(ξ^{n-i} ∩ y) = 0` for all `i ≤ n` is zero (the
downward induction of Stacks 02TX). -/
theorem eq_zero_of_pushforward_capPow_bundleMap
    (htop : ∀ (k : ℤ) (α : chowGroup C sU k),
      bundleProjection C sU sP π hsP n hπ ξ n k k (by ring) α = α) (k : ℤ)
    (β : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), chowGroup C sU (k + (i : ℕ)))
    (hkey : ∀ (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n),
      properChowPushforward C sP sU π hsP (k + i)
          (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper C sP sU π hsP _)
          (capPow C sP ξ (n - i) (k + n) (k + i) (by push_cast [hi]; ring)
            (bundleMap C sU sP π hsP n hπ ξ k β)) = 0) :
    β = 0 := by
  have hterm : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ n),
      properChowPushforward C sP sU π hsP (k + m)
          (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper C sP sU π hsP _)
          (capPow C sP ξ (n - m) (k + n) (k + m) (by push_cast [hm]; ring)
            (bundleTerm C sU sP π hsP n hπ ξ k i (β i))) =
        bundleProjection C sU sP π hsP n hπ ξ ((i : ℕ) + (n - m)) (k + (i : ℕ)) (k + m)
          (by push_cast [hm]; ring) (β i) := by
    intro i m hm
    simp only [bundleTerm, bundleProjection, AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
    rw [capPow_capPow]
  have hexp : ∀ {s s' : ℕ} (e : s = s') (a b : ℤ) (h : a + n = b + s) (x : chowGroup C sU a),
      bundleProjection C sU sP π hsP n hπ ξ s a b h x =
        bundleProjection C sU sP π hsP n hπ ξ s' a b (e ▸ h) x := by
    intro s s' e a b h x; subst e; rfl
  have step : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), (∀ i' : Fin (n + 1), (i : ℕ) < i' → β i' = 0) → β i = 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have hle : (i : ℕ) ≤ n := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp i.isLt
    have h0 := hkey i hle
    rw [bundleMap_apply, map_sum, map_sum] at h0
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ hterm j i hle] at h0
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun j _ hj ↦ ?_) (by simp)] at h0
    · rw [hexp (show (i : ℕ) + (n - i) = n by omega)] at h0
      rw [← htop (k + (i : ℕ)) (β i)]
      exact h0
    · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (Fin.val_ne_of_ne hj) with hlt | hgt
      · exact bundleProjection_eq_zero_of_lt C sU sP π hsP n hπ ξ _ (by omega) _ _ _ _
      · rw [hi j hgt, map_zero]
  have all : ∀ d : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), n - d ≤ (i : ℕ) → β i = 0 := by
    intro d
    induction d with
    | zero =>
      intro i hi
      exact step i fun i' hi' ↦ absurd i'.isLt (by omega)
    | succ d ih =>
      intro i hi
      by_cases h : n - d ≤ (i : ℕ)
      · exact ih i h
      · exact step i fun i' hi' ↦ ih i' (by omega)
  funext i
  exact all n i (by omega)

/-- **Uniqueness for classes killed by `ξ`**: on a projective bundle (02TW, 02TX), a class `y`
with `ξ ∩ y = 0` and `π_* y = 0` is zero. -/
theorem eq_zero_of_capOnChow_eq_zero_of_pushforward_eq_zero
    (htop : ∀ (k : ℤ) (α : chowGroup C sU k),
      bundleProjection C sU sP π hsP n hπ ξ n k k (by ring) α = α)
    (hsurj : ∀ k : ℤ, Function.Surjective (bundleMap C sU sP π hsP n hπ ξ k))
    (a : ℤ) (y : chowGroup C sP a)
    (hξ : ∀ (d : ℤ) (hd : a = d + 1), ξ.capOnChow C sP d (chowGroupCast C sP hd y) = 0)
    (hpush : properChowPushforward C sP sU π hsP a
      (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper C sP sU π hsP a) y = 0) :
    y = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k : ℤ, a = k + n := ⟨a - n, by ring⟩
  obtain ⟨β, rfl⟩ := hsurj k y
  suffices hβ : β = 0 by rw [hβ, map_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_pushforward_capPow_bundleMap C sU sP π hsP n hπ ξ htop k β fun i hi ↦ ?_
  rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hi with rfl | hlt
  · rw [capPow_congr C sP ξ (Nat.sub_self i), capPow_zero_apply,
      properChowPushforward_chowGroupCast C sP sU π hsP _
        (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper C sP sU π hsP _), hpush,
      map_zero]
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, n - i = j + 1 := ⟨n - i - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [capPow_congr C sP ξ hj, capPow_succ_apply, hξ (k + n - 1) (by ring), map_zero, map_zero]

end Uniqueness

/-! ### The top Chern class of `ℰ` capped with `[P̄]` -/

section TopClass

variable (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX]
  (𝒞 : X.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} 𝒞]
  (r : ℕ) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒞 r]

/-- `ξ ∩ s_* z = 0`: `𝒪(1)` is trivial along the zero section. -/
theorem capOnChow_pushforward_zeroSection (d : ℤ)
    (z : chowGroup C (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) (d + 1)) :
    (completionTwistCap C sX 𝒞).capOnChow C _ d
      (properChowPushforward C (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)
        (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (zeroSection 𝒞)
        (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX) (d + 1)
        (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper C _ _ _ _ _) z) = 0 := by
  have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible _ _
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj (bundleTwist (completionModule 𝒞))) :=
    isInvertible_presheaf_modulePullback _ _
  rw [← properChowPushforward_invCap C _ _ (zeroSection 𝒞) _ (bundleTwist (completionModule 𝒞)) d z,
    GRR.invCap_capOnChow_eq_zero_of_iso C _ _ (pullbackTwistIso 𝒞) d z, map_zero]

include r in
/-- `π_* s_* [𝐏(𝒪_X)]_m = [X]_m`. -/
theorem pushforward_pushforward_fundamentalChowClass [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (m : ℤ)
    (h₁ : ProperPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence C (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) sX
      (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞) rfl m)
    (h₂ : ProperPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence C
      (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
      (zeroSection 𝒞)
      (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX) m) :
    properChowPushforward C (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) sX (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞) rfl m
        h₁ (properChowPushforward C (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)
          (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (zeroSection 𝒞)
          (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX) m h₂
          (fundamentalChowClass C (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) m)) =
      fundamentalChowClass C sX m := by
  have := isIso_bundleProj_unitModule 𝒞 r
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (properChowPushforward_comp C
    (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) sX
    (zeroSection 𝒞) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)
    (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX) rfl m h₂ h₁)
    (fundamentalChowClass C (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) m)
  rw [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at h
  rw [h, properChowPushforward_congr_hom C _ sX
      (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞) _ rfl m _
      (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper C _ _ _ _ _),
    properChowPushforward_fundamentalChowClass_of_isIso]

include r in
/-- **The top Chern class of `ℰ` on `[P̄]`, degreewise**: `c_r(ℰ) ∩ π^*[X]_m = (-1)^r s_*[X']_m`. -/
theorem chernCap_koszulModule_completionPullback_fundamentalChowClass [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [Flat (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞)]
    (m : ℤ) :
    GenuineChern.chernCap C r (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (koszulModule 𝒞) (m + r)
        (Fin.last r) (completionPullback C sX 𝒞 r m (fundamentalChowClass C sX m)) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r) • chowGroupCast C (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
        (show m = m + r - r by ring)
        (properChowPushforward C (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)
          (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (zeroSection 𝒞)
          (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX) m
          (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper C _ _ _ _ _)
          (fundamentalChowClass C (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) m)) := by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine eq_zero_of_capOnChow_eq_zero_of_pushforward_eq_zero C sX
    (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞) rfl r
    (relativeDimension_projectiveCompletionProj' 𝒞 r) (completionTwistCap C sX 𝒞)
    (fun k α ↦ projectiveBundle_projection_self (completionModule 𝒞) r C sX k α)
    (fun k ↦ (projectiveBundle_formula (completionModule 𝒞) r C sX k).2) (m + r - r) _ ?_ ?_
  · intro d hd
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, capOnChow_chernCap_koszulModule_bundlePullback C sX 𝒞 r m d hd,
      map_zsmul, map_zsmul, chowGroupCast_chowGroupCast,
      ← properChowPushforward_chowGroupCast C _ _ (zeroSection 𝒞) _ _ _
        (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper C _ _ _ _ _),
      capOnChow_pushforward_zeroSection, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  · rw [map_sub, pushforward_chernCap_tensorDual_bundlePullback C sX _ _ rfl r
        (relativeDimension_projectiveCompletionProj' 𝒞 r) _ 𝒞 _
        (isLocallyProjectiveTower_bundle (completionModule 𝒞) r) (Iso.refl _) m,
      map_zsmul, properChowPushforward_chowGroupCast C _ _ _ _ _
        (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper C _ _ _ _ _),
      pushforward_pushforward_fundamentalChowClass C sX 𝒞 r m, sub_self]

end TopClass

/-! ### Rational classes -/

section Rational

/-- Changing the structure morphism of a Chern class cap along an equality. -/
theorem chernCap_heq_of_eq (C : ChowSituation.{u}) (r : ℕ) {T : Scheme.{u}} {q q' : T ⟶ C.S}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType q] [LocallyOfFiniteType q'] (h : q = q') (F : T.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} F r] (a : ℤ)
    (j : Fin (r + 1)) {x : chowGroup C q a} {x' : chowGroup C q' a} (hx : x ≍ x') :
    GenuineChern.chernCap C r q F a j x ≍ GenuineChern.chernCap C r q' F a j x' := by
  subst h
  cases hx
  rfl

/-- **Capping with `c_r(F) ∈ A^r(T)` is the top Chern class operation `c_r(F) ∩ -`.** -/
theorem chowCohomologyCap_totalChern_heq (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (sT : T ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sT] (F : T.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} F r] (a : ℤ)
    (x : chowGroup C sT a) :
    chowCohomologyCap C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) sT (r : ℤ) (totalChern C sT F r r) a x ≍
      GenuineChern.chernCap C r sT F a (Fin.last r) x := by
  have := pullbackPreservesRank_of_isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank F r (𝟙 T)
  refine (chowCohomologyCap_heq_idRule_ofGysinSystem C _ sT _ _ a x).trans ?_
  rw [← TotalChowClass.op_apply]
  refine (heq_of_eq (op_totalChern_apply C sT F r (𝟙 T) a (Fin.last r) _)).trans ?_
  have : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      ((𝟭 T.Modules).obj F) r :=
    inferInstanceAs (AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} F r)
  rw [GenuineChern.chernCap_congr C _ r ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackId T).app F)]
  exact chernCap_heq_of_eq C r (Category.id_comp sT) F a (Fin.last r)
    (chowGroupCongr_heq C _ a x)

/-- `c_r(F) ∩ -` on a generator, through the total cap action. -/
theorem cap_topChern_of_tmul (k : Type u) [Field k] {T : Scheme.{u}} (sT : T ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sT] (F : T.Modules) (r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} F r] (a : ℤ) (q : ℚ)
    (x : chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) sT a) :
    cap k sT (RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass
        (TotalChowClass.homComponent r (totalChern (fieldChowSituation k) sT F r)))
        (DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) sT j) a (q ⊗ₜ x)) =
      DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) sT j) (a - r)
        (q ⊗ₜ GenuineChern.chernCap (fieldChowSituation k) r sT F a (Fin.last r) x) := by
  rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ]
  unfold cap
  rw [totalRationalChowCap_lof_eq_sum_range (fieldChowSituation k) _ sT 0
      (relativeDimension_fieldChowSituation_nonneg k sT) _ a _ (a.toNat + r) (by omega),
    Finset.sum_eq_single r]
  · rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of, RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily_symm_apply,
      RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass_apply, rationalChowCap_of_tmul, one_mul]
    refine of_tmul_eq_of_tmul_of_heq (fieldChowSituation k) sT rfl q ?_
    rw [TotalChowClass.homComponent_apply, ite_eq_left rfl]
    exact chowCohomologyCap_totalChern_heq (fieldChowSituation k) sT F r a x
  · intro p _ hp
    rw [RationalTotalChowClass.ofFamily_symm_apply, RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass_apply,
      TotalChowClass.homComponent_apply, ite_eq_right hp, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero,
      LinearMap.zero_apply]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)) h

/-- `cap` is additive in the class. -/
theorem cap_zsmul_apply (k : Type u) [Field k] {T : Scheme.{u}} (sT : T ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sT] (n : ℤ) (c : AQ k sT) (x : CHQ k sT) :
    cap k sT (n • c) x = n • cap k sT c x := by
  unfold cap
  rw [map_zsmul, map_zsmul]
  rfl

-- `LocallyOfFiniteType p` is the instance argument `bundlePullback` is stated with.
set_option linter.overlappingInstances false in
/-- **`p^*[Y] = [P]`** for the rational fundamental classes of a flat `p : P ⟶ Y` of relative
dimension `n` between smooth schemes. -/
theorem rationalChowMap_bundlePullback_fundamentalClass' (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {Y P : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sY] (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsSmoothFT k sP] (p : P ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [Flat p] (hsP : p ≫ sY = sP) (n : ℕ)
    (hπ : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension p n) :
    rationalChowMap (fieldChowSituation k) sP sY (fun e => e + n)
        (fun e => bundlePullback (fieldChowSituation k) sY sP p hsP n hπ e)
        (fundamentalClass k sY) =
      fundamentalClass k sP := by
  set C := fieldChowSituation k
  have := isNoetherian k sY
  have := isNoetherian k sP
  have hfund : ∀ e : ℤ, bundlePullback C sY sP p hsP n hπ e (fundamentalChowClass C sY e) =
      fundamentalChowClass C sP (e + n) :=
    fun e => flatPullbackChow_fundamentalChowClass_smooth sY sP p hsP n hπ e
  set g : ℤ → CHQ k sP := fun d =>
    DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sP j) d
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ fundamentalChowClass C sP d) with hg
  have hvanP : ∀ d ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sP).toFinset ∪
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sY).toFinset.image (· + (n : ℤ)),
      d ∉ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sP).toFinset → g d = 0 := by
    intro d _ hd
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hd
    rw [hg]
    dsimp only
    rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_notMem_fundamentalClassDegrees C sP hd,
      map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
  have hcast : ∀ a b : ℤ, a = b → fundamentalChowClass C sP a = 0 →
      fundamentalChowClass C sP b = 0 := by
    rintro a b rfl h
    exact h
  have hvanY : ∀ d ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sP).toFinset ∪
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sY).toFinset.image (· + (n : ℤ)),
      d ∉ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sY).toFinset.image (· + (n : ℤ)) → g d = 0 := by
    intro d _ hd
    have he : d - n ∉ fundamentalClassDegrees C sY := fun h =>
      hd (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨d - n, (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset _).mpr h, by ring⟩)
    have h0 : fundamentalChowClass C sY (d - n) = 0 := by
      rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_notMem_fundamentalClassDegrees C sY he,
        map_zero]
    have h1 : fundamentalChowClass C sP (d - n + n) = 0 := by
      rw [← hfund, h0, map_zero]
    rw [hg]
    dsimp only
    rw [hcast _ _ (by ring) h1, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]
  rw [fundamentalClass, fundamentalClass, rationalFundamentalClass_eq,
    rationalFundamentalClass_eq, map_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ e ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sY).toFinset,
      rationalChowMap C sP sY (fun e => e + n)
          (fun e => bundlePullback C sY sP p hsP n hπ e)
          (DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sY j) e
            ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ fundamentalChowClass C sY e)) = g (e + n) := by
    intro e _
    rw [rationalChowMap_of_tmul, hfund]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm,
    ← Finset.sum_image (f := g) (fun a _ b _ h => by simpa using h),
    Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_right hvanY,
    ← Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_left hvanP]

end Rational

end ZeroSectionRR

/-! ### B3 -/

section B3

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} (𝒞 : X.Modules)
  [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} 𝒞]
  (r : ℕ) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} 𝒞 r]
  (k : Type u) [Field k] (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX]

/-- **B3, top Chern class form**: `c_r(ℰ) ∩ [P̄] = (-1)^r s_*[𝐏(𝒪_X)]` for the Koszul module
`ℰ = π^*𝒞 ⊗ 𝒪(-1)`. -/
theorem ZeroSectionRR.cap_topChern_koszulModule_fundamentalClass :
    haveI := isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion 𝒞 r k sX
    haveI := ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule k sX
    cap k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
        (RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass (TotalChowClass.homComponent r
          (totalChern (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (koszulModule 𝒞) r)))
        (fundamentalClass k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)) =
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r) • rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
        (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX)
        (fundamentalClass k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)) := by
  have := isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion 𝒞 r k sX
  have := ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule k sX
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian X := (isNoetherian k sX).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  have := Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.flat_projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 r
  have := Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.locallyOfFiniteType_projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 r
  have := isNoetherian k sX
  have := isNoetherian k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)
  set g : ℤ → CHQ k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) := fun m =>
    DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ =>
        ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) j) m
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ properChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
        (zeroSection 𝒞)
        (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX) m
        (properPushforwardFactorsThroughRationalEquivalence_of_isProper _ _ _ _ _ _)
        (fundamentalChowClass (fieldChowSituation k)
          (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) m)) with hg
  -- the terms of `c_r(ℰ) ∩ π^*[X]`
  have hterm : ∀ m : ℤ,
      cap k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
        (RationalTotalChowClass.ofTotalChowClass (TotalChowClass.homComponent r
          (totalChern (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (koszulModule 𝒞) r)))
        (rationalChowMap (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) sX
          (fun e => e + r)
          (fun e => bundlePullback (fieldChowSituation k) sX (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
            (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞) rfl r (relativeDimension_projectiveCompletionProj' 𝒞 r) e)
          (DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k) sX j) m
            ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ fundamentalChowClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX m))) =
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r) • g m := by
    intro m
    rw [rationalChowMap_of_tmul, ZeroSectionRR.cap_topChern_of_tmul,
      ZeroSectionRR.chernCap_koszulModule_completionPullback_fundamentalChowClass
        (fieldChowSituation k) sX 𝒞 r m, TensorProduct.tmul_smul, map_zsmul, hg]
    congr 1
    exact of_tmul_eq_of_tmul_of_heq _ _ (by ring) 1 (chowGroupCast_heq _ _ _ _)
  have hinv : ∀ {A : Type u} [AddCommGroup A] (y : A),
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r) • ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r) • y = y := by
    intro A _ y
    rw [smul_smul, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_smul]
  -- outside the degrees of `[X]`, the terms vanish
  have hzeroD : ∀ m ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite (fieldChowSituation k) sX).toFinset ∪
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)).toFinset,
      m ∉ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite (fieldChowSituation k) sX).toFinset →
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r) • g m = 0 := by
    intro m _ hm
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hm
    have h0 : fundamentalChowClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX m = 0 := by
      rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_notMem_fundamentalClassDegrees
        (fieldChowSituation k) sX hm, map_zero]
    have h := ZeroSectionRR.chernCap_koszulModule_completionPullback_fundamentalChowClass
      (fieldChowSituation k) sX 𝒞 r m
    rw [h0, map_zero, map_zero] at h
    have h' := congrArg (fun y ↦ ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r) • y) h
    simp only [smul_zero] at h'
    rw [hinv, eq_comm, AddEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff] at h'
    rw [hg]
    dsimp only
    rw [h', TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]
  -- outside the degrees of `[𝐏(𝒪_X)]`, the terms vanish
  have hzeroD' : ∀ m ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite (fieldChowSituation k) sX).toFinset ∪
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)).toFinset,
      m ∉ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)).toFinset →
        ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r) • g m = 0 := by
    intro m _ hm
    rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset] at hm
    rw [hg]
    dsimp only
    rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_notMem_fundamentalClassDegrees
      (fieldChowSituation k) (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) hm,
      map_zero, map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero, smul_zero]
  rw [← ZeroSectionRR.rationalChowMap_bundlePullback_fundamentalClass' k sX
      (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞) rfl r
      (relativeDimension_projectiveCompletionProj' 𝒞 r)]
  unfold fundamentalClass
  rw [rationalFundamentalClass_eq, rationalFundamentalClass_eq, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum,
    Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ ↦ hterm m]
  have hterm' : ∀ m ∈ (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite (fieldChowSituation k)
      (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)).toFinset,
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r) • rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
        (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX)
        (DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ => ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup (fieldChowSituation k)
          (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) j) m
          ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ fundamentalChowClass (fieldChowSituation k)
            (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) m)) = ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r) • g m := by
    intro m _
    rw [rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm', Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_left hzeroD,
    ← Finset.sum_subset Finset.subset_union_right hzeroD']

/-- **B3**: `(ch(λ_{-1}ℰ) · td([ℰ^∨])) ∩ [P̄] = s_*[𝐏(𝒪_X)]` in `CH_*(P̄) ⊗ ℚ`, the class
`ch(λ_{-1}ℰ) · td([ℰ^∨])` being `(-1)^r c_r(ℰ)` (`GRR.ch_lambdaNegOne_mul_toddClass`). -/
theorem cap_topClass_fundamentalClass :
    haveI := isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion 𝒞 r k sX
    haveI := ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule k sX
    cap k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
        (ch (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
            (lambdaNegOne (koszulModule 𝒞) r) *
          toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
            (VectorBundleKZero.classOf _ (dualSheaf (koszulModule 𝒞))))
        (fundamentalClass k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)) =
      rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k)
        (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX)
        (Stacks.ProjectiveCompletion.zeroSection_comp_projectiveCompletionProj_assoc 𝒞 sX)
        (fundamentalClass k (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X) ≫ sX)) := by
  have := isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion 𝒞 r k sX
  have := ZeroSectionRR.isSmoothFT_bundleProj_unitModule k sX
  rw [ch_lambdaNegOne_mul_toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) _ (koszulModule 𝒞) r,
    ZeroSectionRR.cap_zsmul_apply,
    ZeroSectionRR.cap_topChern_koszulModule_fundamentalClass 𝒞 r k sX,
    smul_smul, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_smul]

/-- **Riemann–Roch for the zero section of `P̄ = 𝐏(𝒞 ⊕ 𝒪_X)`** (item B5 of `notes/E_plan.md`).
Let `X` be smooth, separated and of finite type over a field `k`, `𝒞` finite locally free of
constant rank `r`, `π : P̄ ⟶ X` the projective completion, `s : 𝐏(𝒪_X) ⟶ P̄` the zero section and
`ρ = π ∘ s : 𝐏(𝒪_X) ⟶ X`. For `E` finite locally free on `X` and any `K ≅ (s_*ρ^*E)[0]` whose
Chern classes are defined,

  `π_*(ch(K) ∩ [P̄]) = (ch(E) · td(-[𝒞^∨])) ∩ [X]`   in `CH_*(X) ⊗ ℚ`,

where `ch(K)` is the Chern character of the perfect complex `K` (`GRR.perfectCh`). -/
theorem zeroSection_formula (E : X.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E]
    {K : DerivedCategory (projectiveCompletion 𝒞).Modules} (hK : HasDefinedChernClasses K)
    (e : K ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward (zeroSection 𝒞)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (bundleProj (Stacks.Ample.unitModule X))).obj E))) :
    haveI := isSmoothFT_projectiveCompletion 𝒞 r k sX
    rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) sX rfl
        (cap k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX) (perfectCh (fieldChowSituation k) _ hK)
          (fundamentalClass k (projectiveCompletionProj 𝒞 ≫ sX))) =
      cap k sX (ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) *
          toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-VectorBundleKZero.classOf X (dualSheaf 𝒞)))
        (fundamentalClass k sX) :=
  zeroSection_formula_of k sX 𝒞 r E (cap_topClass_fundamentalClass 𝒞 r k sX) hK e

end B3

end GRR

/-!
# Reduction of the closed immersion formula to its core case

`GRR.closedImmersionFormula_of_core` deduces `GRR.ClosedImmersionFormula` for every closed
immersion of smooth schemes over a field from `GRR.CoreClosedImmersionFormula`, the case of pure
dimensions and conormal sheaf of constant rank `r ≥ 1` (item F of `notes/E_plan.md`). Source and
target are cut into their open and closed parts of constant dimension (R1, R2); the codimension
zero case goes through the zero section of `𝐏¹_P` (R3). The normal class is identified with the
one of Part C by `GRR.normalClass_eq_classOf_dualSheaf_bundle` (R5).
-/

open AlgebraicGeometry CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits Stacks.Chow
open Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.ReflexiveModules (dualSheaf dualSheafIsoOfIso toDoubleDual)
open scoped TensorProduct

universe u

noncomputable section

namespace GRR

section Core

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]

/-- **The core case of `GRR.ClosedImmersionFormula`** (item C7 of `notes/E_plan.md`). For every
closed immersion `i : X ⟶ P` of smooth separated schemes of finite type over `k` with `X`
nonempty, `P` smooth of pure relative dimension `n`, `X` smooth of pure relative dimension `m`,
and the conormal sheaf `Stacks.Chow.conormalModule i` finite locally free of constant rank
`r ≥ 1` with `n = m + r`, and for every finite locally free `E` on `X`,

  `ch(i_! θ[E]) ∩ [P] = i_*((ch(E) · td(N_{X/P})⁻¹) ∩ [X])`.

Stacks' `RelativeDimension` follows from `SmoothOfRelativeDimension` by
`GRR.ClosedImmersionReduce.relativeDimension_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension`; the rank of
`GRR.conormalSheaf` is `GRR.isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_conormalSheaf_iff`, and the normal class
of Part C is `GRR.normalClass_eq_classOf_dualSheaf_bundle`. -/
def CoreClosedImmersionFormula : Prop :=
  ∀ {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX]
    [IsSmoothFT k sP] (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ sP = sX) (n m r : ℕ)
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n sP] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension m sX] [Nonempty X]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
      (Stacks.Chow.conormalModule i) r],
    1 ≤ r → n = m + r →
    ∀ (E : X.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E],
      haveI := compactSpace k sP
      haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
      cap k sP (chK k sP (pushforwardK i (vectorBundleEquiv k sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E))))
          (fundamentalClass k sP) =
        rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi
          (cap k sX (ch (fieldChowSituation k) sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E) *
              toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i))
            (fundamentalClass k sX))

end Core

namespace ClosedImmersionReduce

/-! ### The two sides of the formula -/

section Sides

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
  (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP] (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i]

/-- The left side `α ↦ ch(i_! α) ∩ [P]` of `GRR.ClosedImmersionFormula`. -/
def lhs : CoherentKZero X →+ CHQ k sP :=
  haveI := compactSpace k sP
  haveI : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  (PerfectCh.capFundamental k sP).comp ((chK k sP).comp (pushforwardK i))

variable (hi : i ≫ sP = sX)

/-- The right side `α ↦ i_*((ch(α) · td(N)⁻¹) ∩ [X])` of `GRR.ClosedImmersionFormula`. -/
def rhs : CoherentKZero X →+ CHQ k sP :=
  (rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi).toAddMonoidHom.comp
    ((PerfectCh.capFundamental k sX).comp
      ((AddMonoidHom.mulRight (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i))).comp
        (chK k sX)))

theorem lhs_apply [IsLocallyNoetherian P] [CompactSpace P] (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    lhs k sP i α = cap k sP (chK k sP (pushforwardK i α)) (fundamentalClass k sP) :=
  rfl

theorem rhs_apply (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    rhs k sX sP i hi α = rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP hi
      (cap k sX (chK k sX α * toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i))
        (fundamentalClass k sX)) :=
  rfl

theorem closedImmersionFormula_iff :
    ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi ↔ lhs k sP i = rhs k sX sP i hi :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ AddMonoidHom.ext h, fun h α ↦ DFunLike.congr_fun h α⟩

theorem lhs_eq_rhs (h : ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi) (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    lhs k sP i α = rhs k sX sP i hi α :=
  DFunLike.congr_fun ((closedImmersionFormula_iff k sX sP i hi).1 h) α

theorem closedImmersionFormula_of_lhs_eq_rhs (h : ∀ α, lhs k sP i α = rhs k sX sP i hi α) :
    ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi :=
  (closedImmersionFormula_iff k sX sP i hi).2 (AddMonoidHom.ext h)

/-- It suffices to compare the two sides on the classes `θ[E]` of finite locally free modules. -/
theorem closedImmersionFormula_of_lhs_eq_rhs_bundles
    (h : ∀ (E : X.Modules) [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} E],
      lhs k sP i (vectorBundleEquiv k sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E)) =
        rhs k sX sP i hi (vectorBundleEquiv k sX (VectorBundleKZero.classOf X E))) :
    ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi := by
  refine closedImmersionFormula_of_lhs_eq_rhs k sX sP i hi fun α ↦ ?_
  have hφψ : (lhs k sP i).comp (vectorBundleEquiv k sX).toAddMonoidHom =
      (rhs k sX sP i hi).comp (vectorBundleEquiv k sX).toAddMonoidHom :=
    VectorBundleKZero.addHom_ext fun M hM ↦ by
      have := Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_finiteLocallyFree M (hM := hM)
      simp only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom]
      exact h M
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun hφψ ((vectorBundleEquiv k sX).symm α)
  simpa only [AddMonoidHom.comp_apply, AddEquiv.coe_toAddMonoidHom,
    AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using this

/-- The formula only depends on the morphism, not on how it is written. -/
theorem closedImmersionFormula_congr {f : X ⟶ P} [IsClosedImmersion f] (hfi : f = i)
    (hf : f ≫ sP = sX) (h : ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP f hf) :
    ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi := by
  subst hfi
  exact h

end Sides

theorem cap_zero (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] : cap k sX 0 = 0 := by
  simp only [cap, map_zero]

theorem cap_one (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] : cap k sX 1 = 1 :=
  totalRationalChowCap_one (fieldChowSituation k) sX

/-! ### Composites -/

section Composition

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X P Q : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
  (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sQ : Q ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP]
  [IsSmoothFT k sQ] (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (j : P ⟶ Q) [IsClosedImmersion j]
  (hi : i ≫ sP = sX) (hj : j ≫ sQ = sP)

include hj in
/-- **Normal classes of a composite**: `td(N_{X/Q})⁻¹ = i^* td(N_{P/Q})⁻¹ · td(N_{X/P})⁻¹`, from
`td(T_X) = i^* td(T_P) · td(N_{X/P})⁻¹` for `i`, `j` and `i ≫ j`. -/
theorem toddClass_neg_normalClass_comp :
    toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sQ (i ≫ j)) =
      pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi
          (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sP (-normalClass k sQ j)) *
        toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sX (-normalClass k sP i) := by
  have hij : (i ≫ j) ≫ sQ = sX := by rw [Category.assoc, hj, hi]
  have hA : pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sQ (i ≫ j) hij (toddTangent k sQ) =
      pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi
        (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sP sQ j hj (toddTangent k sQ)) := by
    rw [toddTangent, pullbackAQ_toddClass, pullbackAQ_toddClass, pullbackAQ_toddClass,
      VectorBundleKZero.pullback_eq_pullbackRingHom, VectorBundleKZero.pullback_eq_pullbackRingHom,
      VectorBundleKZero.pullback_eq_pullbackRingHom, VectorBundleKZero.pullbackRingHom_comp_apply]
  have hu : IsUnit (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sQ (i ≫ j) hij (toddTangent k sQ)) := by
    rw [toddTangent, pullbackAQ_toddClass]
    exact isUnit_toddClass _ _ _
  refine hu.mul_left_cancel ?_
  rw [← toddTangent_eq k sX sQ (i ≫ j) hij, toddTangent_eq k sX sP i hi,
    toddTangent_eq k sP sQ j hj, map_mul, hA, mul_assoc]

/-- `(i ≫ j)_*((ch α · td(N_{X/Q})⁻¹) ∩ [X])
  = j_*(td(N_{P/Q})⁻¹ ∩ i_*((ch α · td(N_{X/P})⁻¹) ∩ [X]))`. -/
theorem rhs_comp (hij : (i ≫ j) ≫ sQ = sX) (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    rhs k sX sQ (i ≫ j) hij α =
      rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sP sQ hj
        (cap k sP (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sP (-normalClass k sQ j))
          (rhs k sX sP i hi α)) := by
  have hcomm : Commute (chK k sX α) (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi
      (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sP (-normalClass k sQ j))) := by
    rw [chK_eq_ch, pullbackAQ_toddClass]
    exact (commute_toddClass_ch _ _ _ _).symm
  rw [rhs_apply, rhs_apply, rationalProperChowPushforward_comp k sX sP sQ i j hi hj hij,
    toddClass_neg_normalClass_comp k sX sP sQ i j hi hj, ← mul_assoc, hcomm.eq, mul_assoc,
    cap_mul k sX (pullbackAQ (fieldChowSituation k) sX sP i hi
      (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sP (-normalClass k sQ j))), Module.End.mul_apply,
    rationalProperChowPushforward_cap_pullbackAQ k sX sP i hi]

/-- `j_*((ch(i_! α) · td(N_{P/Q})⁻¹) ∩ [P]) = j_*(td(N_{P/Q})⁻¹ ∩ (ch(i_! α) ∩ [P]))`. -/
theorem rhs_pushforwardK [IsLocallyNoetherian P] [CompactSpace P] (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    rhs k sP sQ j hj (pushforwardK i α) =
      rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sP sQ hj
        (cap k sP (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sP (-normalClass k sQ j))
          (lhs k sP i α)) := by
  have hcomm : Commute (chK k sP (pushforwardK i α))
      (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sP (-normalClass k sQ j)) := by
    rw [chK_eq_ch]
    exact (commute_toddClass_ch _ _ _ _).symm
  rw [rhs_apply, lhs_apply, hcomm.eq, cap_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]

theorem lhs_comp [IsLocallyNoetherian P] [CompactSpace P] (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    lhs k sQ (i ≫ j) α = lhs k sQ j (pushforwardK i α) := by
  have := compactSpace k sQ
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian Q := (isNoetherian k sQ).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  rw [lhs_apply, lhs_apply, pushforwardK_comp_of_isClosedImmersion i j, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply]

/-- With the formula for `i`, the right side of `j` at `i_! α` is the right side of `i ≫ j`. -/
theorem rhs_pushforwardK_eq [IsLocallyNoetherian P] [CompactSpace P]
    (hij : (i ≫ j) ≫ sQ = sX) (hI : ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi) (α : CoherentKZero X) :
    rhs k sP sQ j hj (pushforwardK i α) = rhs k sX sQ (i ≫ j) hij α := by
  rw [rhs_pushforwardK, lhs_eq_rhs k sX sP i hi hI α, rhs_comp k sX sP sQ i j hi hj hij]

end Composition

end ClosedImmersionReduce

section Composition

open ClosedImmersionReduce

variable (k : Type u) [Field k] {X P Q : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
  (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sQ : Q ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP]
  [IsSmoothFT k sQ] (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (j : P ⟶ Q) [IsClosedImmersion j]
  (hi : i ≫ sP = sX) (hj : j ≫ sQ = sP)

/-- **The formula is stable under composition** of closed immersions of smooth schemes. -/
theorem closedImmersionFormula_comp (hij : (i ≫ j) ≫ sQ = sX)
    (hI : ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi) (hJ : ClosedImmersionFormula k sP sQ j hj) :
    ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sQ (i ≫ j) hij := by
  have := compactSpace k sP
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  refine closedImmersionFormula_of_lhs_eq_rhs k sX sQ (i ≫ j) hij fun α ↦ ?_
  rw [lhs_comp, lhs_eq_rhs k sP sQ j hj hJ, rhs_pushforwardK_eq k sX sP sQ i j hi hj hij hI]

/-- **Cancellation**: the formula for `i ≫ j` and for `j` gives the one for `i`, when
`j_* : CH_*(P) ⊗ ℚ → CH_*(Q) ⊗ ℚ` is injective. -/
theorem closedImmersionFormula_of_comp (hij : (i ≫ j) ≫ sQ = sX)
    (hIJ : ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sQ (i ≫ j) hij) (hJ : ClosedImmersionFormula k sP sQ j hj)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) sP sQ hj)) :
    ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi := by
  have := compactSpace k sP
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian P := (isNoetherian k sP).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  refine closedImmersionFormula_of_lhs_eq_rhs k sX sP i hi fun α ↦ ?_
  have h1 := lhs_eq_rhs k sX sQ (i ≫ j) hij hIJ α
  rw [lhs_comp, lhs_eq_rhs k sP sQ j hj hJ, rhs_pushforwardK,
    rhs_comp k sX sP sQ i j hi hj hij] at h1
  have h3 := congrArg (cap k sP (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sP (normalClass k sQ j)))
    (hinj h1)
  have h4 : ∀ x, cap k sP (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sP (normalClass k sQ j))
      (cap k sP (toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sP (-normalClass k sQ j)) x) = x := fun x ↦ by
    rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← cap_mul, toddClass_mul_toddClass_neg, cap_one,
      Module.End.one_apply]
  rwa [h4, h4] at h3

end Composition

/-! ### Empty source -/

/-- Sections of a module over an open containing no point are trivial. -/
theorem subsingleton_sections {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) (O : X.Opens)
    (hO : ∀ x : X, x ∉ O) : Subsingleton Γ(M, O) :=
  ⟨fun _ _ ↦ (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M).section_ext (U := Opposite.op O)
    fun x hx ↦ absurd hx (hO x)⟩

theorem isZero_of_isEmpty {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsEmpty X] (M : X.Modules) : IsZero M := by
  refine (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).2 (Scheme.Modules.hom_ext _ _ fun T ↦ ?_)
  have hs : Subsingleton Γ(M, T) := subsingleton_sections M T fun x ↦ isEmptyElim x
  ext s
  exact @Subsingleton.elim _ hs _ _

/-- The formula holds trivially for an empty source. -/
theorem closedImmersionFormula_of_isEmpty (k : Type u) [Field k] {X P : Scheme.{u}}
    (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (sP : P ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sX] [IsSmoothFT k sP]
    (i : X ⟶ P) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hi : i ≫ sP = sX) [IsEmpty X] :
    ClosedImmersionFormula k sX sP i hi := by
  refine (closedImmersionFormula_iff k sX sP i hi).2 (KZero.hom_ext fun F ↦ ?_)
  have hF : IsZero F :=
    IsZero.of_full_of_faithful_of_isZero (coherentInclusion X) F (isZero_of_isEmpty F.obj)
  rw [KZero.mk_eq_zero_of_isZero hF, map_zero, map_zero]

/-! ### Open and closed pieces -/

section Clopen

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]

/-- An open and closed subscheme of a smooth scheme is smooth. -/
theorem isSmoothFT_ι {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sY] (V : Y.Opens)
    [IsClosedImmersion V.ι] : IsSmoothFT k (V.ι ≫ sY) where
  smooth := inferInstance
  isSeparated := inferInstance
  quasiCompact := by
    have := compactSpace k sY
    have hV : IsClosed (V : Set Y) := by
      have := V.ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
      rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι] at this
    have : CompactSpace V := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hV.isCompact
    exact (quasiCompact_iff_compactSpace (V.ι ≫ sY)).mpr this

/-- The normal class of an open and closed immersion vanishes: `td(N)⁻¹ = 1`. -/
theorem toddClass_neg_normalClass_of_isOpenImmersion {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (sZ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sZ] [IsSmoothFT k sY] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    [IsClosedImmersion f] (hf : f ≫ sY = sZ) :
    toddClass (fieldChowSituation k) sZ (-normalClass k sY f) = 1 := by
  have hsm : Smooth (f ≫ sY) := by rw [hf]; infer_instance
  have hS := Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.conormalShortComplex_shortExact f sY hsm
  have hg : IsIso (Stacks.ConormalSequenceRight.conormalShortComplex f sY).g :=
    Scheme.Hom.isIso_relativeDifferentialsMap_of_isOpenImmersion f sY (f ≫ sY) (𝟙 _) (by simp)
  have hz : IsZero (conormalSheaf k sY f) := hS.isIso_g_iff.mp hg
  have hC := isFiniteLocallyFree_conormalSheaf k sZ sY f hf
  have hcl : VectorBundleKZero.classOf Z (conormalSheaf k sY f) = 0 := by
    rw [VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso hz.isoZero
      (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree _),
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf_zero]
  have hch : ch (fieldChowSituation k) sZ (normalClass k sY f) = 0 := by
    rw [normalClass, normalSheaf, ch_classOf_dualSheaf, hcl, map_zero]
    refine RationalTotalChowClass.ext fun n ↦ ?_
    rw [chowGraded_weight_apply, RationalTotalChowClass.zero_apply, smul_zero]
  rw [toddClass, map_neg, hch, neg_zero, GradedComplete.toddOf_zero]

/-- On a Noetherian scheme `[T] = ∑_{n ∈ S} 1 ⊗ [T]_n` for any finite set `S` of degrees
containing those of the irreducible components. -/
theorem rationalFundamentalClass_eq_sum_of_subset (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {T : Scheme.{u}}
    (sT : T ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sT] [IsNoetherian T] (S : Finset ℤ)
    (hS : (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sT).toFinset ⊆ S) :
    rationalFundamentalClass C sT = ∑ n ∈ S, DirectSum.of (fun j : ℤ ↦ ℚ ⊗[ℤ] chowGroup C sT j) n
      ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ fundamentalChowClass C sT n) := by
  rw [rationalFundamentalClass_eq]
  refine Finset.sum_subset hS fun n _ hn ↦ ?_
  rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalCycle_eq_zero_of_notMem_fundamentalClassDegrees C sT
    fun h ↦ hn ((fundamentalClassDegrees_finite C sT).mem_toFinset.2 h), map_zero,
    TensorProduct.tmul_zero, map_zero]

/-- **The fundamental cycle of a disjoint union**: `[Y]_n = V_*[V]_n + W_*[W]_n` in `A_n(Y)` for a
decomposition `Y = V ⊔ W` into open and closed subschemes. -/
theorem fundamentalChowClass_eq_add (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ C.S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (V W : Y.Opens) (hVW : Disjoint (V : Set Y) W)
    (hcov : (V : Set Y) ∪ W = Set.univ) [IsClosedImmersion V.ι] [IsClosedImmersion W.ι] (n : ℤ) :
    fundamentalChowClass C sY n =
      properChowPushforward C (V.ι ≫ sY) sY V.ι rfl n (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _)
          (fundamentalChowClass C (V.ι ≫ sY) n) +
        properChowPushforward C (W.ι ≫ sY) sY W.ι rfl n (properPushforwardDescends C _ _ _ _ _)
          (fundamentalChowClass C (W.ι ≫ sY) n) := by
  rw [fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalChowClass, fundamentalChowClass, properChowPushforward_mk,
    properChowPushforward_mk, ← map_add, properPushforward_fundamentalCycle_of_isClosedImmersion,
    properPushforward_fundamentalCycle_of_isClosedImmersion]
  congr 1
  exact cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_eq_add_of_isOpenImmersion_pieces C sY (𝟙 Y) V.ι W.ι V.ι
    W.ι (Category.comp_id _) (Category.comp_id _)
    (by rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι, Scheme.Opens.range_ι]; exact hVW)
    (by rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι, Scheme.Opens.range_ι]; exact hcov) n

/-- **The fundamental class of a disjoint union**: `[Y] = V_*[V] + W_*[W]` in `CH_*(Y) ⊗ ℚ`. -/
theorem fundamentalClass_eq_add {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sY]
    (V W : Y.Opens) (hVW : Disjoint (V : Set Y) W) (hcov : (V : Set Y) ∪ W = Set.univ)
    [IsClosedImmersion V.ι] [IsClosedImmersion W.ι] :
    haveI := isSmoothFT_ι k sY V
    haveI := isSmoothFT_ι k sY W
    fundamentalClass k sY =
      rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) (V.ι ≫ sY) sY rfl
          (fundamentalClass k (V.ι ≫ sY)) +
        rationalProperChowPushforward (fieldChowSituation k) (W.ι ≫ sY) sY rfl
          (fundamentalClass k (W.ι ≫ sY)) := by
  have := isSmoothFT_ι k sY V
  have := isSmoothFT_ι k sY W
  have := isNoetherian k sY
  have := isNoetherian k (V.ι ≫ sY)
  have := isNoetherian k (W.ι ≫ sY)
  obtain ⟨S, h1, h2, h3⟩ : ∃ S : Finset ℤ,
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite (fieldChowSituation k) sY).toFinset ⊆ S ∧
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite (fieldChowSituation k) (V.ι ≫ sY)).toFinset ⊆ S ∧
      (fundamentalClassDegrees_finite (fieldChowSituation k) (W.ι ≫ sY)).toFinset ⊆ S :=
    ⟨_ ∪ _ ∪ _, Finset.subset_union_left.trans Finset.subset_union_left,
      Finset.subset_union_right.trans Finset.subset_union_left, Finset.subset_union_right⟩
  simp only [fundamentalClass]
  rw [rationalFundamentalClass_eq_sum_of_subset (fieldChowSituation k) sY S h1,
    rationalFundamentalClass_eq_sum_of_subset (fieldChowSituation k) (V.ι ≫ sY) S h2,
    rationalFundamentalClass_eq_sum_of_subset (fieldChowSituation k) (W.ι ≫ sY) S h3, map_sum,
    map_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ ↦ ?_
  rw [rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul (fieldChowSituation k) (V.ι ≫ sY) sY rfl,
    rationalProperChowPushforward_of_tmul (fieldChowSituation k) (W.ι ≫ sY) sY rfl,
    fundamentalChowClass_eq_add (fieldChowSituation k) sY V W hVW hcov n, TensorProduct.tmul_add,
    map_add]

/-- The restriction of `V_* M` to `V` is `M`. -/
def restrictPushforwardIso {Y : Scheme.{u}} (V : Y.Opens) (M : (V : Scheme.{u}).Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj M) ≅ M :=
  (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorAdjCounitIso V.ι).app M

/-- **`V_* M` vanishes on a disjoint open `W`.** -/
theorem isZero_restrict_pushforward {Y : Scheme.{u}} {V W : Y.Opens} (h : Disjoint V W)
    (M : (V : Scheme.{u}).Modules) :
    IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj M)) := by
  refine (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).2 (Scheme.Modules.hom_ext _ _ fun T ↦ ?_)
  have hs : Subsingleton Γ(M, V.ι ⁻¹ᵁ (W.ι ''ᵁ T)) := subsingleton_sections M _ fun x hx ↦ by
    obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ := hx
    have h1 : V.ι x ∈ (W : Set Y) := by rw [← ht, ← Scheme.Opens.range_ι]; exact ⟨t, rfl⟩
    have h2 : V.ι x ∈ (V : Set Y) := by rw [← Scheme.Opens.range_ι]; exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact h.le_bot (show V.ι x ∈ V ⊓ W from ⟨h2, h1⟩)
  ext s
  exact @Subsingleton.elim _ hs _ _

/-- **`V_* F` is finite locally free** for `F` finite locally free and `V` open and closed. -/
theorem isFiniteLocallyFree_pushforward_ι {Y : Scheme.{u}} (V : Y.Opens)
    (hV : IsClosed (V : Set Y)) (F : (V : Scheme.{u}).Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u} F] :
    AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.{u, u, u}
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj F) := by
  let W : Y.Opens := ⟨(V : Set Y)ᶜ, hV.isOpen_compl⟩
  have hVW : Disjoint V W := by
    rw [disjoint_iff]
    ext x
    simp [W]
  refine Stacks.Modules.isFiniteLocallyFree_localGenerators_of_iSup_eq_top _
    (fun b : Bool ↦ Bool.rec W V b) ?_ fun b ↦ ?_
  · rw [iSup_bool_eq]
    ext x
    simp [W]
  · cases b
    · have := isFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank_zero_of_isZero (isZero_restrict_pushforward hVW F)
      exact AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.isFiniteLocallyFree _ 0
    · exact AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFree.of_iso
        (restrictPushforwardIso V F).symm

end Clopen

section OpenClosed

open ClosedImmersionReduce

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]

/-- **R1: the formula for an open and closed immersion** `V ⟶ Y` of a smooth scheme. -/
theorem closedImmersionFormula_ι {Y : Scheme.{u}} (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSmoothFT k sY]
    (V : Y.Opens) [IsClosedImmersion V.ι] :
    haveI := isSmoothFT_ι k sY V
    ClosedImmersionFormula k (V.ι ≫ sY) sY V.ι rfl := by
  have := isSmoothFT_ι k sY V
  have hV : IsClosed (V : Set Y) := by
    have := V.ι.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range
    rwa [Scheme.Opens.range_ι] at this
  let W : Y.Opens := ⟨(V : Set Y)ᶜ, hV.isOpen_compl⟩
  have : IsClosedImmersion W.ι := IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion W.ι
    (by rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]; exact V.isOpen.isClosed_compl)
  have := isSmoothFT_ι k sY W
  have := compactSpace k sY
  have : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := (isNoetherian k sY).toIsLocallyNoetherian
  have hVW : Disjoint V W := by
    rw [disjoint_iff]
    ext x
    simp [W]
  refine closedImmersionFormula_of_bundles k (V.ι ≫ sY) sY V.ι rfl fun F hF ↦ ?_
  have := isFiniteLocallyFree_pushforward_ι V hV F
  have hθ : vectorBundleEquiv k sY
      (VectorBundleKZero.classOf Y ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj F)) =
      pushforwardK V.ι (vectorBundleEquiv k (V.ι ≫ sY) (VectorBundleKZero.classOf V F)) := by
    obtain ⟨cF, hF'⟩ := vectorBundleEquiv_classOf k (V.ι ≫ sY) F
      (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree F)
    obtain ⟨cG, hG'⟩ := vectorBundleEquiv_classOf k sY ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj F)
      (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree _)
    rw [hF', hG', pushforwardK_mk_of_isClosedImmersion]
    rfl
  have hzW : IsZero ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj F)) :=
    (isZero_restrict_pushforward hVW F).of_iso
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback W.ι).app _).symm
  have hV' : VectorBundleKZero.classOf V
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback V.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj F)) =
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf V F :=
    VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso
      (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback V.ι).app _).symm ≪≫ restrictPushforwardIso V F)
      (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree _)
  have hW' : VectorBundleKZero.classOf W
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback W.ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward V.ι).obj F)) = 0 := by
    rw [VectorBundleKZero.classOf_eq_of_iso hzW.isoZero
      (Stacks.StalkFreeBridge.finiteLocallyFree_isFiniteLocallyFree _),
      VectorBundleKZero.classOf_zero]
  rw [← hθ, chK_vectorBundleEquiv,
    toddClass_neg_normalClass_of_isOpenImmersion k (V.ι ≫ sY) sY V.ι rfl, mul_one,
    fundamentalClass_eq_add k sY V W disjoint_compl_right (Set.union_compl_self _), map_add,
    ← rationalProperChowPushforward_cap_pullbackAQ k (V.ι ≫ sY) sY V.ι rfl,
    ← rationalProperChowPushforward_cap_pullbackAQ k (W.ι ≫ sY) sY W.ι rfl,
    pullbackAQ_ch (fieldChowSituation k) (V.ι ≫ sY) sY V.ι rfl,
    pullbackAQ_ch (fieldChowSituation k) (W.ι ≫ sY) sY W.ι rfl,
    VectorBundleKZero.pullback_classOf V.ι, VectorBundleKZero.pullback_classOf W.ι, hV', hW',
    map_zero, cap_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero, add_zero]

end OpenClosed
